games.raw: Yes, this game has been built with AI. As a software engineer for over 15 years, I wanted to see how far I could push AI to bring my idea to life. I built the initial prototype myself, but have used AI extensively to turn the prototype into a fully functional game that looks and feels the way I imagined. This is still months of work with over 50 hours of playtesting to bring it to life. AI has come a long way, and game development is evolving fast. This game would never have left the prototype stage without it. Please consider giving it a chance.

a.sum: Says the game was built extensively with AI but does not specify which content.

games.raw: Generative AI was used during development for much of the current artwork and parts of the game's writing. This includes adaptation text, ship descriptions, story and flavor text. It was also used for the German localization and parts of the Danish localization. The game does not use live generative AI, connect to an LLM service, or generate content while you play. I am currently rewriting some of the text in my own voice and reviewing the visuals. My goal is for every part of the game to feel consistent with its world, whether it began as human-made or AI-assisted work. The current artwork used on the Steam store is placeholder material. I hope to work with an artist on the final store art and, if possible, bring some of that work into the game as well.

games.raw: PatchWorld includes optional generative AI tools that players can use to create custom content for their worlds and devices. Players can generate images, 360° skyboxes, 3D meshes, and audio samples by entering text prompts using in-game tools such as the GenieBox device or scripting blocks. Each generation is initiated directly by the player and takes a short amount of time to complete. Generated content can be used to decorate worlds, create sound effects, and build custom musical instruments. By default, all generated content remains private to the creator and is only shared with others if the player chooses to publish their world. Generative AI features are entirely optional and are designed to support creativity, experimentation, and collaborative world-building.

a.sum: Optional player-driven generation of images, skyboxes, 3D meshes and audio from prompts.

games.raw: s[TOR-Y]telling uses large language models to generate text-based character interactions and narrative responses during gameplay. Players can run the included Llama model locally on compatible hardware, or choose optional Cloud AI. Technical Implementation & Privacy: Local AI generation runs on the player’s device and supports offline single-player. Cloud AI requires an internet connection and uses credits. In Cloud mode, prompts and relevant conversation context are sent through a relay operated by Curious Biped to external AI providers via OpenRouter for generation and content safety checks. Safety & Moderation: We have implemented a multi-layered safety strategy to ensure a safe experience: Model-Level Guardrails: The included local model is an Instruct model with built-in safety measures. Cloud AI uses external models with additional content safety checks performed by our relay. System-Level Directives: All prompts include an additional safety layer to prevent sexual violence, pedophilia, minor abuse/exploitation, explicit sexual behavior, or hate speech. Gameplay Integration: While the primary Visual Novel is hand-authored, the results of your sandbox evaluations influence the story's trajectory. The AI serves as a tool for narrative exploration, bridging the gap between open-ended analysis and cinematic storytelling. Generative AI was also used in the process of creating the game static assets (images, text, and music).

a.sum: LLM-generated character interactions and narrative during play; static assets also AI-assisted.

games.raw: Dust & Diamonds is a 100% solo project. The idea for this game came to me a few days after my son was born — my first child. I was celebrating with my cousin and bet him I could build something like Motherload in two weeks. As you've probably guessed, I lost that bet spectacularly. I'm writing this almost a year later, and my son turns one in a few days. I have a degree in computer game engineering, but I live in a small town with no game studios — so I drive a pallet jack around a warehouse by day and build this game after hours. I can't afford to hire an artist or a composer. To bring this world to life at all, I turned to generative AI tools. I'm not going to hide that. How does the game use AI? Graphics (2D): A significant portion of the visual assets — character portraits, environment elements, buildings — was generated using AI, then manually retouched, edited, and assembled by me in the engine into a cohesive style with a parallax system. Music and sound: The musical tracks in the game were generated by AI. Fittingly, this ties directly into the game's lore — the "Relics of the Old World" (our 21st century) collected by the goblins are canonically works created by AI before the great cataclysm, carrying the lost wisdom of humanity. What's mine in this game is the design: how the economy works, how water behaves in a flooded shaft, when a ceiling collapses, what the old man says across the counter. I came up with each of these systems, wrote them out, tested them, and reworked them a dozen times until they behaved the way I wanted. I'm just a regular guy who had an idea for a game about digging in the dirt and was stubborn enough to see it through. Thank you for your understanding and support.

Game design, economy, water and collapse systems, and dialogue are described as the developer's own work. No runtime or live AI generation is mentioned.

games.raw: We don’t particularly like using AI. Unfortunately, we are a small indie studio made of programmers and designers who are currently somewhere between “making a game” and “having existential crises”. So, for now, we use AI to help us with some parts of our daily work and to bring some of our music, ideas, and inspirations to life. But don’t worry, we haven’t handed over the steering wheel to the robots just yet. Our project, its identity, and its originality are still created and directed by us. AI is simply one of the tools helping us survive the development process while our budget is busy pretending it doesn’t exist. As soon as we have the resources to replace AI with our own human made work, we absolutely intend to do so. Until then, we’re just a bunch of indie developers trying to make something cool before our refrigerators become purely decorative objects.

a.sum: The developer states they use AI for unspecified parts of daily work and to bring music, ideas, and inspirations to life, while project identity and direction remain human-led. games.raw: I wrote most of this game’s code myself, with AI assistance on a small portion. I developed the characters and the game’s world, set the overall mood and visual style, and described the content and composition I wanted for the images. I also selected and revised the AI-generated results. The promotional images and concept trailers on the Steam store page were also made with the help of generative AI. I wrote the entire story, directed every scene, and designed all player interactions. I also designed each level’s core concept, design intent, techniques, and pacing. I set the constraints and used a constraint satisfaction problem (CSP) solver to generate a vast pool of candidate levels in advance, rather than having generative AI produce them directly. I playtested and selected from the candidates, refining the constraints along the way until I arrived at the final levels. Each level has exactly one solution and can be solved without guessing. Translations into languages other than Chinese currently use AI assistance. If any of this still bothers you, I understand. If you give the game a try, I believe the best parts of the experience come from a bit of old-fashioned craft, even if it’s a little rough around the edges. — Onovich

games.raw: Some visual assets in Dead Hand (card illustrations, backgrounds and character art) as well as some musical elements were created with the assistance of AI generation tools (ComfyUI), then refined and integrated into the game. AI coding tools (Claude Code) assisted development. Game design is stated to be entirely human-made. No runtime or live generation is mentioned.

games.raw: The game was created by a solo developer with the help of AI tools to bring the game to life. Every piece of content—art, music, story, and code—has been personally reviewed, curated, and directed by me to ensure it fits the game's vision and quality standards.

a.sum: Solo developer says AI tools helped create the game. The disclosure claims all art, music, story, and code were reviewed, curated, and directed by the developer. It does not say whether content is pre-generated or generated live, or which assets fall under each category.

games.raw: This game uses generative AI during development to create some visual art assets, such as plants, scenery, animals, and UI. It does not generate text or other content in real time while you play.

games.raw: This game was made by a two-person team specializing in storytelling. The entire narrative, all gameplay systems, UI, animations, core sound and game design were built entirely by our team. AI was used to generate some of audio and graphical assets due to the limited resources. Scenario was originally written in Ukrainian language, so translations might have minor mistakes. Thank you for your understanding.

a.sum: The developer states that AI was used to generate some audio and graphical assets, without specifying which ones or whether generation happens at runtime. The narrative, gameplay systems, UI, animations, core sound, and game design are said to be human-made. The Ukrainian-to-English translation is noted as possibly imperfect, but the disclosure does not say AI was used for it.

games.raw: Generative AI was used to assist in the creation of game assets, which were subsequently modified, optimized, and finalized by human professionals.

a.sum: The developer says generative AI assisted in creating game assets, which human professionals then modified, optimized, and finalized. The asset types are not specified, and the text describes only pre-generated assets, with no runtime generation mentioned.

games.raw: AI tools were used to help create the game’s soundtrack by generating the initial instrumental stems and raw audio elements. Those materials were then brought into Logic Pro, where the developer manually arranged, remixed, edited, and mastered them into the final tracks.

a.sum: AI tools generated initial instrumental stems and raw audio elements for the game's soundtrack. The developer then manually arranged, remixed, edited, and mastered these in Logic Pro to create the final tracks. No live or in-game generation is mentioned.

games.raw: Some visual assets in this game were generated using AI. As a one‑person developer, I use these tools to accelerate production, but all images are reviewed, refined, and finalized by me to maintain a consistent artistic direction.

a.sum: Some visual assets (images, scope not specified) were generated with AI during development. The developer reviewed, refined, and finalized all of them. No live or in-game generation is mentioned.

games.raw: We poured our heart into designing Widget Idle. Generative AI was not a substitute for its creative direction. We believe generative AI can be a valuable tool for independent developers, but we won't pretend that this is a settled issue. To help consumers make an informed decision, here is how GenAI was used: TEXT Guidance Text: AI-assisted baseline, heavily revised by us. Localization: AI-assisted translation followed by extensive human revision. MUSIC All in-game tracks were produced with generative AI. They are curated, edited, and revised by us. This made it possible for us to deliver 70+ vetted tracks to our players within our means.

a.sum: Widget Idle discloses generative AI use for guidance text (AI-assisted baseline, heavily revised by humans), localization (AI-assisted translation with extensive human revision), and all in-game music (generated with AI, then curated, edited, and revised by the developers). All described content is produced before release; no live or runtime generation is mentioned.

games.raw: Spaceship models and some sound effects have been developed with the use of AI.

games.raw: During the development of this game, generative AI tools were used as a supportive resource for technical and creative tasks. This allowed me as a solo developer to streamline my technical workflow and focus more on the core gameplay, environmental puzzles, and the unique atmospheric feel of the project. Every piece of AI-assisted logic or visual concept has been manually reviewed, adapted, and implemented by me to ensure it fits perfectly within the game's overall design.

a.sum: The developer declares generative AI use during development: assisting with structuring complex C# scripts and providing visual reference images for world-building and character design. All AI-assisted logic and visual concepts were manually reviewed, adapted, and implemented by the developer. No live or in-game generation is mentioned.

games.raw: This game uses generative AI tools during development to assist with creating some art assets: - 2D artwork: ability/skill icons, equipment/item icons, concept art, in-game UI/HUD elements, and some promotional/store artwork (capsule images, key art). - 3D assets: some item and world prop models created with generative 3D tools. Remaining art, animation, and audio come from licensed asset packs or were created by the developer.

a.sum: The developer discloses use of generative AI during development for 2D art (ability/skill and item icons, concept art, in-game UI/HUD elements, promotional/store art such as capsule images and key art) and for some 3D item and world prop models. All AI-assisted assets are reviewed, curated, and edited by the developer. No content is generated at runtime; all assets are fixed and pre-generated. Other art, animation, and audio come from licensed asset packs or the developer.

games.raw: Generative AI helped produce some of the game's artwork and music. The developer selects these assets and redraws, edits or trims them as needed before using them in the game.

games.raw: I'm a solo developer with 30 years of engineering experience. In those 30 years, many new tools have been invented to help developers, including IDEs, garbage collection, YouTube tutorials, asset stores, and, recently, generative & agentic AI tools. Wherever a tool helps me do more, better, and faster, I embrace it. AI has been used to varying degrees in almost every aspect of this game's development, including software engineering, art, translation, ideation, research, and promotion.

a.sum: Developer declares AI use to varying degrees across nearly all development: software engineering (code), art (unspecified type), translation (localization), ideation, research, and promotion. No live or in-game generated content is mentioned, and the pre- vs. live-generation distinction is not stated.

games.raw: Some visual assets in Singularity Echoes and on this store page were created with generative AI tools during development, then reviewed and edited by the developer. This includes artwork for buildings, celestial bodies, and the Earth strategic map, as well as menu and store marketing imagery. Gameplay systems, UI logic, balance, and narrative text were implemented by the development team. The game does not use generative AI to create new content during play and does not connect to third-party AI services while you are playing.

games.raw: Some images used in the game’s development and promotional materials were initially generated with the assistance of AI tools. AI was used only as a production aid to speed up early visual exploration and reduce iteration time. games.raw: AI tools were used to assist with localization into certain languages. AI-generated imagery was also used as reference material and inspiration during the art creation process.

games.raw: Some sound effects and voice related audio assets were created or assisted using generative AI tools. These assets are used as part of the game's horror atmosphere and enemy audio design. The game does not generate AI content in real time during gameplay.

games.raw: Part of visual make with AI

games.raw: As with most VTT systems, users are welcome to import assets made anywhere. Phroller makes it easier than ever. You can just drag the image or model files into the VTT directly from your browser or file system! I want to encourage supporting real artists where we can though. As such I do my best to collaborate with real creatives on the vast Phroller libraries. Each one of the assets in the library has a field showing the artist behind it. If you like their work, please consider checking them out. Many of them are open for commissions as well! However, I cannot guarantee that assets or part of those assets were created with no AI use at all. A large amount of the assets are made before 2022 though, so we should be safe there. games.raw: Uncertainty regarding AI-generated plugins: This game heavily relies on a large quantity of third-party RPG Maker MZ plugins. Most of these plugins do not have AI disclosure. games.raw: Operation: Horumus is a "vibe coding" experiment. Most of the game's content — code, game design, pixel art, sound effects, procedural music, narrative writing, and all four language localizations (English, Korean, Japanese, Simplified Chinese) — was developed with extensive use of generative AI tools, under the developer's direction. Every creative and technical decision was made by the developer, and all AI-generated output was reviewed and curated before inclusion. No AI is invoked during gameplay. The game runs entirely offline and makes no calls to external AI services. This is a parody experiment, and the use of AI is part of the experiment itself. We disclose it here so you can decide whether that approach is interesting to you.

All output was reviewed and curated by the developer. No AI runs during gameplay, and the game makes no external AI calls.

games.raw: In the development of BABY PEAK, we utilized artificial intelligence as a supportive tool to enhance our creative vision. Routine Tasks & Optimization: We employed AI tools to handle repetitive technical tasks, such as optimizing small code snippets and organizing data, to increase our workflow efficiency. Human-Driven Craftsmanship: All core game design, level architecture, visual identity, and gameplay balancing are entirely the result of our team’s manual work and creativity. In short, AI did not act as the "creator" of this game; instead, it served as a digital assistant to help us bring our unique ideas to life more efficiently.

No content is generated during play, and nothing a player does is sent to an AI system.

All background music and sound effects are licensed free commercial assets downloaded from authorized resource websites; no generative AI was used for audio production. Source code was written with coding assistant tools.

a.sum: Developer discloses AI use for initial generation of some in-game art, heavily revised by hand; AI-assisted game text and localization drafts, fully proofread and revised manually; AI-assisted source code. Music and sound effects are licensed free assets with no generative AI. No live or runtime generation is mentioned.

games.raw: Human-made content: • All in-game 2D and 3D assets, created entirely by me. • Music and sound effects licensed from human creators via the Unity Asset Store or Itch.io. • Spanish and English localizations, written by me. AI tools were used for: • Coding assistance and debugging. • Translations into Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese, Portuguese, French, Italian, German, and Russian.

a.sum: The developer declares AI use only for development-time coding assistance and debugging, and for translating the game into eight languages (Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese, Portuguese, French, Italian, German, Russian). All 2D/3D art, Spanish and English text, and licensed music and sound effects are stated as human-made. No live in-game generation is mentioned.

games.raw: Generative AI tools may be used during the development and marketing of WBS26 to assist with concept art, promotional images, placeholder visual materials, character portraits, text editing, localization support, and production workflow. Some character portraits or visual assets may be created or assisted by generative AI tools and then reviewed, selected, and edited by the developer before being included in the game. The game does not use generative AI to create gameplay content in real time for the player. AI-assisted materials are reviewed and edited by the developer before being included in the game or on the Steam store page.

a.sum: The developer discloses generative AI use in development and marketing of WBS26 for concept art, promotional images, placeholder visuals, character portraits, text editing, localization support, and production workflow. AI-assisted visuals are created before release, then reviewed and edited by the developer. The game does not generate gameplay content in real time for players.

games.raw: Some in-game visual assets and trivia/ranking question data were created with the assistance of generative AI tools. All AI-assisted content was reviewed, edited, and curated by the developer before being included in the game.

games.raw: This game's development uses generative AI tools in the following ways: Image assets: generating some artwork and image materials (directed and curated by the developer; final design decisions and adjustments are made by a human). Coding: assisting with implementation and development (design decisions and final code review are done by a human). No content is generated by AI at runtime.

a.sum: The developer declares generative AI use for image assets (artwork and image materials, directed and finalized by humans) and for coding assistance (design and final code review by humans). The disclosure states no content is generated by AI at runtime. The specific placement of the image assets (store, in-game, or textures) is not stated.

games.raw: Some store visuals, in-game sound effects, and music were created with the assistance of artificial intelligence.

a.sum: Developer discloses AI assistance in store visuals, in-game sound effects, and music. The text does not say whether content is pre-generated or generated live during play.

games.raw: AI was used during sound and art asset authoring. Also assisted with game code.

a.sum: The developer discloses AI use in authoring sound and art assets and says AI assisted with game code. The disclosure does not say whether content is pre-generated or generated live in-game, and it does not name specific art or sound subtypes.

games.raw: Some of this game's content was created with generative AI tools and then reviewed and edited by the developer. This includes visual assets (2D art, 3D models and characters), some in-game text and localization, and some audio. No content is generated by AI during gameplay. The "Teaser" video on this store page was made with generative AI video tools; the gameplay trailer and all screenshots are captured from the game.

a.sum: The developer declares generative AI use in pre-generated content, later reviewed and edited by the developer. Covered areas are 2D art, 3D models and characters, some in-game text and localization, some audio (type unspecified), and the store page 'Teaser' video. The developer states no content is generated by AI during gameplay. The gameplay trailer and all screenshots are captured from the game.

games.raw: The development of this game made use of AI-generated content. Specifically, some of the in-game images, video sequences and character voice-over were created with the help of generative AI tools. All AI-generated assets were reviewed, curated and edited by the development team before inclusion in the final product

a.sum: Discloses generative AI use for some in-game images, video sequences, and character voice-over. All AI-generated assets were reviewed, curated, and edited by the team before inclusion, indicating pre-generated content with no live generation mentioned.

games.raw: We used generative AI for the English and Simplified Chinese localization of the game.

a.sum: The developer discloses using generative AI for the English and Simplified Chinese localization. The disclosure does not say whether the content is pre-generated or generated live in the game.

games.raw: The developer used ChatGPT to generate only the background for the promotional and marketing artwork displayed on the Steam storefront, everything else was hand made. No AI-Generated assets are used inside the actual game.

a.sum: The developer used ChatGPT to generate only the background for promotional and marketing artwork on the Steam storefront. All other elements were hand-made, and no AI-generated assets are used in the game.

games.raw: We used generative AI tools in a limited capacity during development: some store page descriptions and marketing texts were drafted with AI assistance and finalized with human editing. Some non-Chinese localization texts were translated using AI and reviewed by humans. All core gameplay, programming, and level design were created by the developers.Some in-game artwork / background music was created with the assistance of generative AI tools.

a.sum: Generative AI was used in a limited way during development. Store descriptions and marketing texts were AI-drafted and human-edited. Non-Chinese localization was AI-translated and human-reviewed. Some in-game artwork and background music were made with generative AI assistance. Core gameplay, programming, and level design were stated as developer-created. No runtime or live generation is mentioned.

games.raw: How is Generative AI used in this game? Toxic Dating Simulator utilizes cutting-edge generative AI technologies to elevate its interactive cinematic storytelling. Voice Acting (ElevenLabs): All character dialogues and Atakan's chaotic inner monologues are voiced using advanced AI-powered emotion-tagging technologies. This delivers high-fidelity voice lines capturing sarcasm, anger, or flirtatious tones with professional actor-level depth. Visuals & Animation (Kling AI): The facial expressions, eye contact, and reactive behaviors of the female characters sitting across the cafe table are generated using advanced AI video tools. Music: All context-dependent songs (electro, pop, or fantasy) playing on the post-date score screen are composed via AI tools, with all lyrics entirely written by the developer. All AI-generated content in the game consists of pre-rendered, curated, and fully copyright-compliant static assets created during development. The game does not generate any live or real-time AI content during gameplay.

a.sum: The developer declares AI use for voice acting (ElevenLabs) of character dialogue and inner monologues, AI video tools (Kling AI) for facial expressions, eye contact, and reactive behaviors of cafe characters, and AI-composed music for the post-date score screen, with lyrics written by the developer. All AI content is pre-rendered static assets created during development, and the game states it generates no live or real-time AI content.

games.raw: Generative AI was used for English and Japanese localization, text proofreading, and visual references during development. All final content was created and reviewed by the developer.

a.sum: The developer declares generative AI was used during development for English and Japanese localization, text proofreading, and visual references. The developer states all final content was created and reviewed by them. No runtime or live generation is mentioned.

games.raw: Some card illustrations and key art were created with the help of AI image tools and then curated and edited by the developer.

a.sum: AI image tools were used to help create some card illustrations and key art, which the developer then curated and edited. No live or runtime generation is mentioned.

games.raw: Some animations and scenes in the game are generated with the assistance of AI.

a.sum: The developer discloses that some animations and scenes in the game are generated with AI assistance. The disclosure does not say whether this content is pre-generated or live-generated, and 'scenes' is not mapped to a specific category.

games.raw: Marketing Materials: Promotional banners, store capsules, and conceptual marketing illustrations were generated using generative AI tools. In-Game Assets & Systems: In-game visuals exclusively utilize standard emoji sets, handcrafted UI layouts, and manual visual styling. All game mechanics, systems, logic, and algorithms are entirely custom-built without in-game runtime generative generation.

a.sum: The developer discloses generative AI use only for marketing materials: promotional banners, store capsules, and conceptual marketing illustrations. In-game visuals use standard emoji sets, handcrafted UI, and manual styling. Game mechanics, systems, logic, and algorithms are custom-built with no in-game runtime generative generation.

games.raw: Generative AI was used to create a limited number of pre-generated assets, including labels and artwork for some small in-game props, such as fish food products, as well as some customer voice lines, such as “Thank you” and “Have a nice day.” No AI-generated content is created during gameplay.

a.sum: Developer declares generative AI was used to pre-generate a limited set of in-game assets: labels and artwork for small props such as fish food products, and customer voice lines like "Thank you" and "Have a nice day." The developer states no AI-generated content is created during gameplay.

games.raw: AI language translator was used to localise the store page.

a.sum: The developer disclosed using an AI language translator to localise the Steam store page. No live or in-game generation is mentioned.

games.raw: LumaEdge does not contain generative AI features or generate AI content during use. AI-assisted tools were used to create portions of the multi-monitor environments shown in LumaEdge’s trailers and Steam store artwork. AI tools were also used to help write and refactor code, identify bugs, and improve performance. The reactive gradients shown in marketing materials were captured directly from LumaEdge and composited into the scenes. None of the gradients were AI-generated.

a.sum: LumaEdge has no generative AI features and generates no AI content during use. AI-assisted tools were used before release to create portions of the multi-monitor environments in trailers and Steam store art, and to help write, refactor, debug, and optimize code. The reactive gradients in marketing were captured from the game and are not AI-generated.

games.raw: Art: AI image tools assisted with 2D assets/icons; all final art was will be replaced by our artists based on original designs and concept. Localization: Core languages were translated by our team; additional languages use AI-assisted translation. This currently includes some 2D art assets (character, enemy, maps, and environment artwork and a few remaining icons), achievement icons and store artwork, and AI-assisted translation of the game's text into languages beyond the original Arabic & English, with human review. The in-game credits include an AI usage disclosure. The game does not generate any content at runtime (no live AI-generated content) Note: We are deliberately moving away from AI-generated assets. The AI-generated UI art set (themed frames, buttons and panel artwork) has already been removed from the build because it did not fit the game's art direction, and the interface now uses normal unity built elements; we will share that set only as a design concept while we look for an artist to rebuild the interface art from scratch. Our intent is to replace the remaining AI-generated images with original, non-AI artwork. We currently rely on AI only as a temporary baseline until we can work with experienced artists in Middle Eastern art to create the final assets.

a.sum: The developer discloses AI-assisted 2D art (character, enemy, map, environment artwork, some icons, achievement icons, store artwork) and AI-assisted translation beyond Arabic and English, with human review. The AI-generated UI art set was removed from the build. No runtime generation. The developer plans to replace the remaining AI art with original non-AI artwork.

games.raw: Generative AI were used to assist in the creation of assets, and artwork. All generated content was reviewed and modified by the developers before inclusion in the final game.

a.sum: The developer says generative AI assisted in creating unspecified 'assets' and 'artwork'. All generated content was reviewed and modified by developers before inclusion in the final game, so it is pre-generated, not live. The disclosure does not name specific asset types or placement (e.g., store vs. in-game).

games.raw: The following assets were created using generative artificial intelligence: some images, some models, all the voiceovers, and some videos.

a.sum: Developer discloses generative AI was used to create some images, some 3D models, all voiceovers, and some videos. The text describes these as pre-created assets and does not mention live or runtime generation. Images are not specified further, so they are mapped to 'other'.

games.raw: Generative AI tools were used during development to help create or iterate on some pre-rendered visual assets, supporting text, and marketing/store-page materials. All AI-assisted content is reviewed, edited, selected, and integrated by the developer. The game does not use live generative AI during gameplay.

a.sum: Developer declares generative AI was used during development for pre-rendered visual assets, supporting text, and marketing/store-page materials, all reviewed and integrated by the developer. No live generative AI is used during gameplay.

games.raw: Generative AI tools were used to assist with the creation of some 3D assets, textures, and translations. All AI-assisted content was reviewed and edited by the developer before being included in the game.

a.sum: Generative AI assisted with some 3D assets, textures, and translations. All AI-assisted content was reviewed and edited by the developer before inclusion in the game, indicating pre-generated content rather than live generation.

games.raw: As a solo developer, I used generative AI tools to help create some of the game's icons, artwork, and written text, which I then reviewed and edited by hand. The game's design, code, and systems are my own work, and the world, its factions, and its story are built on lore I have developed across the Imperium Sine Fine saga. Nothing is AI-generated during gameplay.

a.sum: Developer declares generative AI was used before release to help create some icons, artwork, and written text, all reviewed and edited by hand. Game design, code, systems, world, factions, and story are described as the developer's own work. The developer states nothing is AI-generated during gameplay. The placement of the icons and artwork (store, in-game, or other) is not specified.

games.raw: As a solo developer handling the entire scope of code, systems architecture, and design, generative AI tools were utilized during development to handle the massive volume of graphic assets. This includes illustrative 2D artwork for specific field environments, background landscapes, UI map layouts, and card illustration frames. Leveraging these tools allowed me to focus my full energy on what matters most: creating deep tactical gameplay, tight mechanical balance, and a compelling narrative. Every asset generated was extensively curated, manually edited, and visually polished to align perfectly with the game's aesthetic, storytelling, and tactical user interface. No live generative AI is used while the game is running.

a.sum: Developer declares generative AI was used to create 2D graphic assets: field environment illustrations, background landscapes, UI map layouts, and card illustration frames. Assets were curated, manually edited, and polished. No live generative AI runs during gameplay. Code, design, and narrative are described as the developer's own work.

games.raw: AI tools are used exclusively to translate game content into different languages.

a.sum: The developer states AI tools are used exclusively to translate game content into other languages. The disclosure does not say whether this translation is pre-generated or live, and names no other uses of AI.

games.raw: Generative AI was used as one of many development tools while creating Snake: Gridbreaker. As a solo developer, I used it to support programming, localization, UI work, visual assets, icons, and the development of quality-of-life and accessibility improvements. Every AI-assisted element was reviewed, edited, tested, and implemented by me. I designed the game, its mechanics, progression, and creative direction, and I remain fully responsible for the final experience. The game does not generate content with AI during gameplay.

a.sum: Developer used generative AI during development for programming, localization, UI work, visual assets and icons, and quality-of-life and accessibility improvements. All AI-assisted output was reviewed, edited, tested, and implemented by the developer. The game does not generate content with AI during gameplay.

The script, characters, game design, and 3D backgrounds are the developer's own work, and all voice acting is by human Cantonese voice actors. No live or runtime AI generation is mentioned.

a.sum: Generative AI was used to create some graphic assets, which were then processed with filters and adjustments to fit the game's visual style. The disclosure does not specify which assets or where they appear.

games.n: Legend of Azure Peak : Wuxia Heroes
games.raw: This game is developed using the commercial engine RPG Bakin. The core game logic, systems, and all promotional videos are 100% handcrafted and created without the use of any AI tools. To enhance the overall experience of this indie project, generative AI tools were utilized to assist in specific asset creation, video sequences, and localization: Pre-rendered Content & Video Sequences: The introductory cinematic video showcasing the game’s backstory was generated with the assistance of AI and manually edited. The short animations for the item forging and dismantling systems were generated using AI and manually refined. Some 2D character portraits, equipment icons (initial concepts), and background music (BGM) were generated with the assistance of AI and subsequently polished. Character Voiceovers: The Japanese battle voice lines for characters were created using modern AI voice generation tools. Language & Localization: The English translation and localization of the game's scripts and dialogues were assisted by AI translation tools. Our goal with incorporating AI tools is to enrich the game's atmosphere, aiming to deliver an authentic Wuxia RPG experience with rich audio-visuals and smooth language accessibility for players worldwide.

a.sum: AI was used for pre-generated content only: the intro backstory cinematic, item forging/dismantling animations, some 2D character portraits, initial equipment icon concepts, BGM, Japanese battle voice lines, and AI-assisted English translation/localization of scripts and dialogue. Core logic, systems, code, and promotional videos are stated as handcrafted without AI. No runtime AI generation is mentioned.

games.raw: AI was used to assist with early concept sketches for some backgrounds and characters. Final in-game assets were edited and adapted by the developer.

a.sum: AI assisted with early concept sketches for some backgrounds and characters. The developer then edited and adapted the final in-game assets. No live or runtime AI generation is mentioned.

games.raw: This game was developed by a solo developer, with artificial intelligence utilized for assistance in various areas. AI tools were used to assist with the development of the game's code and music.

a.sum: A solo developer states that AI assisted in various areas and names code and music specifically. The disclosure does not say whether the AI content is pre-generated or live-generated, so live generation is unstated.

games.raw: Some of the artwork in Hunters Trial: One Breath was created with the assistance of generative AI tools. Specifically, AI was used to help produce certain background and environment images, and as a visual reference aid during the design of our menus and user interface.

a.sum: Some artwork was created with generative AI assistance, specifically certain background and environment images. AI was also used as a visual reference aid when designing menus and UI. No live or runtime generation is mentioned.

games.raw: Some in-game and promotional art began as AI-generated concepts or drafts. These images were converted into pixel art or composited with in-game sprites, then reviewed, hand-edited, and finished by the developer; no unedited AI-generated image is shipped as final art. AI writing tools also assisted with drafting and revising portions of the game’s text and English localization based on the author’s original story, content, and direction. All released text was reviewed, edited, and approved by the developer. Generative AI was not used to create the game’s audio, and the game contains no live or runtime AI generation.

a.sum: AI was used before release. AI-generated concepts or drafts for some in-game and promotional art were converted to pixel art or composited with sprites, then hand-edited and finished by the developer, with no unedited AI images shipped. AI writing tools helped draft and revise portions of the game text and English localization, based on the author's original story, and the developer reviewed and approved all released text. No generative AI was used for audio, and the game has no live or runtime AI generation.

games.raw: This game uses pre-generated AI-assisted content. Most of the visual assets used in the game and its promotional materials were created with the help of generative AI tools, including character images, background images, key visual materials, and video/trailer assets. All AI-assisted outputs were reviewed, selected, edited, and integrated by the developer before being included in the game. The game does not generate AI content in real time during gameplay.

a.sum: The developer declares AI-assisted content that is pre-generated, not live. Most visual assets in the game and promotional materials, including character images, background images, key visual materials, and video/trailer assets, were made with generative AI tools. The developer reviewed, selected, edited, and integrated all outputs. The game does not generate AI content in real time during gameplay.

games.raw: Logo generated using photo editing generative AI. Music created using AI enabled Music Workflow.

a.sum: The developer declares AI use for a logo, created with photo editing generative AI (scope: other), and for music, created with an AI-enabled music workflow. The disclosure does not say whether any content is generated live during play.

games.raw: Some content is powered by AI

a.sum: The developer states only that some content is powered by AI. The disclosure does not say what content is affected, whether it is pre-generated or live-generated, or how AI is used.

games.raw: Artificial intelligence was utilized in the production of the store page, marketing materials, community assets, and certain in-game materials.

a.sum: The developer states AI was used in the store page, marketing materials, community assets, and certain in-game materials. The disclosure does not say whether the content is pre-generated or live-generated, and does not specify the in-game material types.

games.raw: Generative AI tools were used during development to assist with the creation of certain visual assets and animation references. All AI-generated content was reviewed, edited, and integrated into the game by the developer.

a.sum: Generative AI was used during development to help create certain visual assets and animation references. The developer reviewed, edited, and integrated all AI-generated content. No live or in-game generation is mentioned.

games.raw: AI tools were used to create some textures, video, and audio content for the game.

a.sum: The developer says AI tools were used to create some textures, video, and audio content. The audio type is unspecified, so it is mapped to 'other'. The disclosure does not say whether the content is generated in advance or at runtime.

games.raw: The paintings, portraits, music and filmed scenes in Vizier were made for it with Google Flow, Lyria and Nano Banana, then chosen, corrected and assembled by hand. The writing and its translations into seven languages were produced with AI assistance and read through before shipping. The game's sound effects are licensed royalty-free stock, not generated by us. Nothing is generated while you play. Every image and every line of text is fixed in the build: identical for every player, on every run. The game connects to no AI service and sends nothing anywhere. The same credits appear in the game itself, under Credits.

a.sum: Vizier declares AI use for paintings, portraits, music, and filmed scenes (Google Flow, Lyria, Nano Banana), hand-curated and assembled. Writing and its seven-language translations were AI-assisted and human-reviewed. Sound effects are licensed stock, not AI-generated. All content is fixed in the build with nothing generated during play and no external AI connections.

games.raw: Generative AI was used during development solely to create artwork for Dungebra. Music and voices were not generated using AI. The game does not use generative AI to create content during gameplay.

a.sum: Generative AI was used during development only to create artwork (type unspecified). Music and voices were not AI-generated, and the game does not generate content with AI during gameplay.

games.raw: AI-assisted tools were used to help create some splash screen visuals and store page promotional artwork. All assets were reviewed and finalized by the developer before being included in the game and store materials.

a.sum: The developer declares AI-assisted tools were used for splash screen visuals and store page promotional artwork. All such assets were reviewed and finalized before inclusion, so no live generation is described.

games.raw: Generative AI tools were used during development to assist with coding, music, voice, dialogue writing, and texture assets. All content has been reviewed and approved by the developer.

a.sum: The developer declares generative AI was used during development for coding, music, voice, dialogue writing, and texture assets. All AI-assisted content was reviewed and approved by the developer. No live or runtime generation is mentioned.

games.raw: During the early stages of development, generative AI was used to create prototypes for some visual assets. These assets were manually redrawn and revised by the developer before being included in the game.

a.sum: Generative AI was used early in development to create prototypes for some visual assets. The developer manually redrew and revised these, and only the human-revised versions were included in the game. No live generation is mentioned.

games.raw: BirdBots uses generative AI tools during development to assist in the creation of certain promotional images, visual concepts, illustrations, and marketing materials. All AI-generated content has been reviewed, edited, and integrated by the developer. AI is not used during gameplay and does not affect the game's mechanics.

a.sum: BirdBots used generative AI during development to help create promotional images, visual concepts, illustrations, and marketing materials. The developer reviewed, edited, and integrated all AI-generated content. The disclosure states AI is not used during gameplay and does not affect game mechanics.

games.raw: Some of the code and artwork featured on the store page were generated using AI.

a.sum: Developer discloses that some code and artwork featured on the store page were generated using AI. The text does not say whether content is pre-generated or live-generated, so live generation is unknown.

games.raw: Food graphics and background visuals use generative AI.

a.sum: The developer discloses generative AI use for food graphics and background visuals. The text does not say whether the content is pre-generated or live-generated, or whether these visuals appear in the store page or in-game.

games.raw: The game has AI generated images and other AI made components. If you are sensitive about AI generated content please do not download the game.

a.sum: The developer discloses AI-generated images and other unspecified AI-made components, with no detail on where they are used or whether content is generated at runtime. The developer also advises sensitive users not to download the game.

games.raw: Some of this game's assets were created with the assistance of generative AI tools. Character, enemy, and background artwork was created using Stable Diffusion and then manually edited and retouched by the developer. Background music and the ending theme songs were generated using ACE-Step v1.5. All AI-assisted assets were reviewed and curated by the developer. No content is generated by AI during gameplay.

a.sum: Developer discloses AI-assisted in-game artwork (characters, enemies, backgrounds) made with Stable Diffusion and then manually edited, plus AI-generated background and ending theme music made with ACE-Step v1.5. All were pre-generated, reviewed, and curated by the developer. No content is generated by AI during gameplay.

games.raw: Generative AI tools were used for localization, marketing images, intro video, and some graphical assets.

a.sum: The developer declares generative AI use for localization, marketing images, an intro video, and some graphical assets. The graphical assets are not specified further, and the disclosure does not say whether content is pre-generated or generated live.

games.raw: Some of the video, audio and text in Anomagram - and some of the images on this store page - were produced with the help of generative AI tools, then edited and finalized by the developer before release. No content is generated by AI while you play.

a.sum: The developer says some video, audio, and text in Anomagram, plus some store page images, were produced with generative AI tools and then edited and finalized before release. No content is generated by AI during play. 'Audio' has no exact match in the scope list, so it is mapped to 'other'.

games.raw: Generative AI assisted with selected 2D art, promotional assets,. All content was manually reviewed, edited, and integrated. The game does not generate AI content at runtime.

a.sum: Developer declares generative AI was used for selected 2D art and promotional assets, all manually reviewed, edited, and integrated. No AI content is generated at runtime.

games.raw: Some sprites and sound files were curated using generative AI.

a.sum: Developer discloses that some sprites and sound files were curated using generative AI. The text does not say whether the content is pre-generated or live-generated, or what kind of sound files were involved.

games.raw: The game does not use AI art. I have created all the art by hand, but the code does include AI help since I'm a one man team of a developer.

a.sum: The developer states the game uses no AI-generated art, and all art was made by hand. They disclose AI assistance in writing code, as a solo developer. No other AI use or in-game generated content is mentioned.

games.raw: Several of the original tracks included with the base game were created with the help of AI tooling as were some of the icons and translations into languages other than English.

a.sum: Developer discloses AI tooling was used for several original tracks in the base game, some icons, and translations into non-English languages. No live or runtime generation is mentioned.

games.n: Blue Remembered Hills: A Miscellany of Wayfarers from Yeyu

Character portraits and background art are produced using AI generation as a starting point, then manually edited, repainted, and finished by the developer. Some of the music is created with the help of generative AI tools. All AI-assisted content is pre-rendered as static assets during development; the game does not generate any content live at runtime. The writing, narrative, and design are authored by the developer.

a.sum: Discloses AI use for character portraits and background art, which are AI-generated starting points then manually edited and finished by the developer, and for some music created with generative AI tools. All AI-assisted content is pre-rendered as static assets; no content is generated live at runtime. Writing, narrative, and design are developer-authored.

games.n: Ashrose Manor - A Portrait of Forbidden Love

It was also used for proofreading and editing written text. All AI-assisted content was reviewed, selected, and refined by the developer before being included in the game or official marketing materials.

a.sum: The developer used generative AI to assist with selected 2D images, sprite assets, marketing artwork (including some Steam capsule and store assets), and proofreading/editing of written text. All AI-assisted content was reviewed, selected, and refined before inclusion in the game or marketing materials. No live or runtime generation is mentioned.

games.raw: Generative AI was used to enhance marketing assets such as steam capsule & early sketch concept before offloaded & polished by Humans. All gameplay, art, and final content remain crafted by Human.

a.sum: The developer used generative AI to enhance marketing assets, such as the Steam capsule, and to create early sketch concepts. Humans then offloaded and polished these outputs. The developer states that gameplay, art, and final content are human-crafted.

games.raw: 1.Some scenes 2.promotional renderings。

a.sum: The developer lists two AI-generated uses: 'some scenes' (likely in-game scenes, though the text is terse) and 'promotional renderings' (marketing art). The disclosure does not say whether content is pre-generated or generated live.

games.n: Heart Light: Knight of the Gnomes

games.raw: The game’s promotional artwork is based on our original designs, with AI used only to enhance and refine the promotional visuals.

a.sum: AI is declared for promotional artwork only, used to enhance and refine visuals based on the developer's original designs. No in-game or live generation is mentioned.

games.raw: Notice: AI-assisted development tools were used in the preparation and creation of the game mechanics and scripts, texts, and question catalog.

a.sum: The developer discloses that AI-assisted development tools were used to prepare and create game mechanics, scripts, texts, and a question catalog. The disclosure does not mention any content generated during play, so live generation is not stated.

games.raw: Helped create base assets from generative AI. Base assets are then edited, remixed, reworked or replaced to increase dev speed.

a.sum: The developer used generative AI to create base assets of unspecified type. Developers then edit, remix, rework, or replace these assets to speed up development. The disclosure describes only pre-development asset creation and does not mention runtime or live generation.

games.raw: The developer used pre-generated generative artificial intelligence tools to assist and optimize the development process. AI was employed as a productivity tool to structure logic and assist in writing the game's code. On the artistic side, AI tools were used to assist in the conception and generation of the audiovisual elements (including graphic and sound assets), which were subsequently selected, refined, and integrated into the final version. All AI-generated content was created beforehand during development; the game does not use artificial intelligence to generate new content in real-time during gameplay.

a.sum: The developer declares pre-generated AI use. AI assisted with structuring logic and writing code, and with conceiving and generating graphic and sound assets, which were then selected, refined, and integrated. All AI content was made during development, and the game does not generate new content in real time.

games.raw: This game's text localization into multiple languages was assisted by AI translation tools. Three background music tracks, licensed from Pixabay, were AI-created or AI-modified by their original creators. All other artwork, audio, and game assets are human-made or sourced from licensed marketplaces — no other AI-generated content is used.

a.sum: The developer discloses AI use in two areas: AI translation tools assisted text localization, and three licensed background music tracks from Pixabay were AI-created or AI-modified by their original creators. All other art, audio, and assets are said to be human-made or licensed from marketplaces, with no other AI content. Nothing indicates content is generated during play.

games.raw: Generative AI was used to assist with the creation of some terrain textures, localization, and a limited number of icons.

a.sum: Developer says generative AI assisted in creating some terrain textures, localization, and a limited number of icons. No live or runtime generation is mentioned.

games.raw: Generative AI tools assisted with pre-generated artwork, including Steam store capsules and library images, and some localization text. The game does not generate AI content during play or connect to external AI services.

a.sum: Generative AI assisted with pre-generated artwork, including Steam store capsules and library images, and some localization text. No AI content is generated during play, and the game does not connect to external AI services.

games.raw: AI was used for the store assets, the main menu background and logo, and some of the music.

a.sum: The developer discloses AI use for store assets, the main menu background and logo, and some music. The text does not say whether the content is pre-generated or generated live during play.

games.raw: Some visual assets used in the game and store page were created or modified with the assistance of generative AI, including certain UI elements, icons, and promotional artwork. AI-assisted translation was also used for some store page localizations. All AI-generated content was reviewed, edited, and integrated by the developer.

a.sum: Generative AI was used to create or modify some visual assets for the game and store page, including certain UI elements, icons, and promotional artwork. AI-assisted translation was used for some store page localizations. The developer reviewed, edited, and integrated all AI-generated content. No live or runtime generation is mentioned.

games.raw: Ski Lines is a solo-developed indie game created with the help of generative AI tools. AI was used throughout production to support artwork creation, music and sound design, code assistance, prototyping, iteration, and marketing assets. Every AI-assisted element was curated, edited, and integrated by the developer to fit the game’s minimalist ski-map aesthetic and gameplay vision. The use of AI helped accelerate production while preserving human creative direction, design decisions, quality control, and final authorship.

a.sum: Developer declares generative AI was used throughout production for artwork, music and sound design, code assistance, prototyping, iteration, and marketing assets. All AI-assisted elements were curated and edited by the developer. The disclosure does not mention any runtime or live-generated content.

games.raw: Generative AI tools were used during development to create pre-generated voice lines/audio effects and a few 3D environment models/textures. All AI-generated assets have been reviewed, integrated statically into the game files, and do not contain any illegal or copyright-infringing material. The game does not generate any content in real-time using AI during live gameplay.

a.sum: Developer declares generative AI was used during development to create pre-generated voice lines, audio effects, and a few 3D environment models and textures. All assets were reviewed and statically integrated; no real-time AI generation occurs during gameplay.

games.raw: Stick Crisis was developed with assistance from generative AI tools. AI-assisted image and animation tools were used to create selected visual assets, character animation frames and pre-rendered cinematics; these materials were reviewed, edited and integrated by the developer. AI coding assistants also contributed to portions of the source code. The game does not generate content during gameplay or connect to generative AI services at runtime.

a.sum: Developer discloses generative AI use for selected visual assets, character animation frames, pre-rendered cinematics, and portions of source code, all reviewed and edited by the developer. No content is generated during gameplay and no runtime connection to generative AI services.

games.raw: Generative AI tools are used as part of the visual asset production workflow for Shadows of Beginnings, including 3D models and UI/HUD elements. These assets are reviewed, edited, refined, and integrated by the development team before being used in the game. The development team remains responsible for the game's design, programming, systems, level construction, gameplay, balancing, narrative, and overall creative direction. No generative AI content is created live during gameplay.

a.sum: Generative AI is used in the visual asset workflow, specifically for 3D models and UI/HUD elements, which the team reviews, edits, and integrates before use. No generative AI content is created live during gameplay. Design, programming, systems, level construction, gameplay, balancing, narrative, and creative direction are stated as team responsibilities.

games.raw: This game does not use generative AI at runtime and does not generate content based on player input. Generative AI was used during development to assist with some static artwork, icons, promotional images, and draft text. All such content was reviewed, edited, integrated, and approved by the developer.

a.sum: Developer declares generative AI was used during development, not at runtime, to assist with static artwork, icons, promotional images, and draft text, all of which were reviewed, edited, and approved by the developer. No live or player-input-driven generation.

games.raw: Some NPC images used AI-generated images.

a.sum: The developer discloses that some NPC images use AI-generated images. The text does not say whether they are pre-generated or generated live, and gives no further detail.

games.n: Five-Star Courier and the Fog That Reeks of Death
games.raw: In this game, AI was used to generate code and music. It served as an auxiliary tool for composing backgrounds.

a.sum: The developer says AI generated code and music, and was used as an auxiliary tool for composing backgrounds. The disclosure does not say whether content is pre-generated or generated live during play, and 'backgrounds' is not specified as visual or audio.

games.raw: Generative AI was used for the in-game music, the logo and store page artwork, and the store page text and translations.

a.sum: The developer declares generative AI use for in-game music, the logo and store page artwork, and store page text and translations. The disclosure does not say whether any content is generated live during play.

games.raw: This game uses generative AI tools to assist with the creation of some pre-rendered visual assets and marketing materials. No live AI-generated content is created during gameplay. All AI-assisted content is reviewed and edited by the developer before release.

a.sum: Developer discloses generative AI was used to assist creation of some pre-rendered visual assets and marketing materials. No live AI-generated content occurs during gameplay, and all AI-assisted content is reviewed and edited by the developer before release.

games.raw: Generative AI was utilized to aid in the implementation of programming code, the production of visual assets, and translation tasks.

a.sum: Developer discloses generative AI used to aid programming code, produce visual assets (unspecified type), and perform translation. The disclosure does not say whether content is pre-generated or live-generated.

games.raw: Our development process makes limited use of generative AI tools for internal workflows, such as early-stage concept exploration or workflow automation. All final visual and audio content in the game is created entirely by our team without the use of generative AI.

a.sum: The developer discloses limited use of generative AI for internal workflows only, such as early-stage concept exploration and workflow automation. They state that all final visual and audio content was created by the team without generative AI. The disclosure does not mention live-generated content or AI use in text, code, or other categories.

games.raw: Generative AI was used to write the game’s code, create music and Steam marketing materials, and translate the game. No generative AI is used during gameplay.

a.sum: The developer declares generative AI was used before release to write code, create music, make Steam marketing materials, and translate the game. The developer states no generative AI runs during gameplay.

games.raw: 本游戏在开发过程中使用了生成式人工智能辅助制作部分美术素材、音效和音乐内容。所有生成内容均经过开发者筛选、修改和审核后使用。游戏玩法设计、程序开发、数值设计及最终内容均由开发者完成。

a.sum: The developer used generative AI during development to help produce some art assets, sound effects, and music. All generated content was screened, modified, and reviewed by the developer before use. Gameplay design, programming, numerical design, and final content were done by the developer. No runtime or live generation is mentioned.

games.n: The Veiled Atlas: A Cycle of Falls
games.raw: The art, music, and written text in this game were created using commercial generative AI services, working from the developer's own designs and ideas under direct human supervision, with each asset and passage curated and edited by hand. All content is pre-generated — no AI runs while you play.

a.sum: Art, music, and written text were generated with commercial generative AI services from the developer's designs, under human supervision, and hand-curated and edited. All content is pre-generated, and no AI runs during play.

games.raw: Some assets in Crown Cribbage were made with the help of generative AI tools: - in-game music was generated with AI music tools - capsule/key art - marketing copy drafts - assistance with programming One point of emphasis: The computer opponents in this game are not generative AI. They are hand-written heuristics, a fixed set of rules for discarding and pegging, tuned by difficulty. They see only what you see. They do not look at your hand, and nothing about them is generated while you play. No AI content of any kind is created during a match.

a.sum: Developer declares generative AI was used before release for in-game music, capsule/key art, marketing copy drafts, and programming assistance. The computer opponents are hand-written heuristic rules, not generative AI, and no AI content is created during a match.

games.raw: OST is AI-Generated

a.sum: The developer discloses that the original soundtrack (OST) is AI-generated. It does not state whether the music is pre-generated or generated live during play.

games.raw: Some art assets in this game are AI-generated and have been truthfully disclosed in the Content Survey.

a.sum: The developer states that some art assets are AI-generated and that this was truthfully disclosed in the Content Survey. The text does not specify which assets, whether generation is pre-generated or live, or where the art is used.

games.raw: Generative AI assisted parts of this game's development: AI (Claude by Anthropic) was used to help with code implementation and to assist with editing narrative dialogue and localization. Some placeholder cutscene illustrations were generated with AI (Grok) during development and are being replaced with artwork from a commissioned illustrator ahead of full release.

a.sum: Developer discloses dev-time AI use: Claude assisted with code implementation and editing narrative dialogue and localization; Grok generated placeholder cutscene illustrations, which are being replaced by commissioned artwork before release. No runtime/live generation is described.

games.raw: Generative AI tools were used during development to assist with certain pre-generated visual elements and sequences in the game. All such materials were reviewed, selected, edited, and integrated into the final video content by the Dev team. The game’s narrative, interactive structure, gameplay logic, and final presentation are created and controlled by the Dev team. No generative AI is used during gameplay, and no content is generated dynamically for players.

a.sum: Developer used generative AI during development to help create pre-generated visual elements and sequences, later reviewed, edited, and integrated by the team. Narrative, gameplay, and presentation are human-controlled. No generative AI runs during gameplay and no content is generated dynamically for players.

games.raw: AI-assisted tools were used during development to help produce some 2D art assets (character and enemy artwork, UI icons), sound effects, voice lines, and supporting code. All AI-assisted content was created before release and reviewed by the development team. The game does not generate any content or code in real time during gameplay, and it does not connect to any external AI service while playing.

a.sum: AI tools were used before release to help create 2D character and enemy art, UI icons, sound effects, voice lines, and supporting code. All AI-assisted content was reviewed by the team. The game generates no content or code in real time and does not connect to an external AI service during play.

games.raw: CrystalCanvas uses generative AI in parts of its development process. For the sound effects played when placing voxels, we aimed to create sounds that remain pleasant and unobtrusive even during extended play sessions. After exploring a variety of sound assets and recordings, we ultimately used generative AI as part of the sound design process to achieve the desired result. Generative AI is also used as a development aid through Claude Code for generating and assisting with parts of the code related to voxel space management and rendering. Generative AI is not used to generate the voxel artwork or gameplay content itself.

a.sum: Generative AI was used in sound design for the voxel-placement sound effects and, as a development aid via Claude Code, for code related to voxel space management and rendering. The disclosure states it is not used for voxel artwork or gameplay content, and it mentions no live generation.

games.raw: Assets and most of the coding was done through AI tools

a.sum: The developer says AI tools were used to create the game's assets and most of its code. The assets are not specified further, and the disclosure does not say whether any content is generated at runtime.

games.raw: This game contains pre-generated images and music created using generative AI. No generative AI is used during gameplay.

a.sum: The developer declares pre-generated AI images and AI-generated music. The images' specific placement (e.g., store, in-game, or marketing) is not stated. No generative AI runs during gameplay.

games.raw: Use of AI generated Art and some coding

a.sum: The developer discloses AI-generated art and some AI-assisted coding. The disclosure does not say where the art appears (store, in-game, or elsewhere), whether generation happens before release or live, or what 'some coding' covers.

games.raw: Localizations were done with help of generative AI.

a.sum: The developer states that localizations were produced with help of generative AI. The disclosure does not specify whether the AI generated content before release or during play, so generation type and live generation are unclear.

games.raw: Deeprise is a solo-developed indie game. Generative AI was used as a tool in the creation of this game, specifically for: - Concept art and illustrations (character portraits, enemy designs, environment backgrounds, building art, item icons, and research card art), generated with AI image tools and curated, edited, and integrated by the developer. - Sound effects and voicelines, generated with AI audio tools using developer-written scripts and prompts. - Capsule art and store page imagery, created by compositing AI-generated assets with developer-designed layouts. All game design, systems, code, writing, lore, and creative direction are the developer's own work. AI was used to bring this solo project to a visual and audio polish that would otherwise be out of reach for a single developer, and every AI-generated asset was reviewed, selected, and integrated by hand.

a.sum: Deeprise's developer declares AI use for pre-generated assets: in-game art (portraits, enemy designs, backgrounds, buildings, item icons, research card art), sound effects and voicelines, and store/capsule imagery. Assets were curated and integrated by hand. Code, writing, lore, game design, and creative direction are stated as the developer's own. No live or runtime generation is mentioned.

games.n: 缚于邪神低语的少女 TheWhisperingGodBoundGirl

games.raw: This game contains AI-generated 2D artwork, while all 3D models were created by hand.

a.sum: The developer discloses AI-generated 2D artwork. The disclosure does not say where that artwork appears in the game or whether it is pre-generated or generated live. All 3D models are stated to be hand-made.

games.raw: Mythia Wild Bonds was designed and built by a solo developer, game design, art direction, sound direction, and architecture are all the developer's own. AI generation tools were used to accelerate production of pixel art, sound effects, and music, each piece selected, reworked, and approved within the game's art bible and audio direction; code was also developed with AI pair-programming assistance, with all game systems designed by the developer. No content is AI-generated at runtime.

a.sum: Developer used AI tools to speed up pixel art, sound effects, and music, with each piece selected, reworked, and approved by the developer. Code was written with AI pair-programming assistance, with all systems designed by the developer. No content is generated at runtime.

games.raw: We use AI tools in production for parts of the game's art, animation, voices, music, writing and translation, built on our own mech designs, music compositions, voice performances and story direction. Nothing is generated by AI while you play.

a.sum: The developer declares AI tools were used in production for parts of the game's art, animation, voices, music, writing, and translation, built on their own mech designs, music compositions, voice performances, and story direction. Nothing is generated by AI during play.

games.raw: 游戏开发期间借助 Claude 大模型辅助完成部分代码撰写与逻辑梳理，部分 UI 界面、动画视觉素材使用 AI 工具辅助创作。游戏整体玩法框架、核心业务逻辑、数值策划全部由开发者独立设计与校验。 游戏正式运行时不会联网访问任何 AI 服务，不会在游戏内实时生成任何玩家可见内容。

a.sum: Claude assisted with some code writing and logic organization during development. AI tools helped create some UI and animation/visual assets. Core gameplay, core business logic, and numerical design were designed and verified by the developer. The game makes no network calls to AI services at runtime and generates no player-visible content in real time.

games.raw: As a solo developer with limited time each day to work on this game, AI helped me bring it to life and share it with you. I hope you enjoy it!

a.sum: The developer states that AI helped bring the game to life but does not specify which content or systems used AI, nor whether generation is pre-generated or live.

games.raw: We used AI to help creating Assets like Images, Music.

a.sum: The developer says AI was used to help create assets such as images and music. The disclosure does not specify where the images are used, whether content is pre-generated or generated live, or any other details.

games.raw: In ALASH, we utilized generative AI as a supplementary tool to assist in creating 2D art assets. Specifically, AI networks were used to help develop certain environment elements, textures, and background images to enhance the unique visual style of our alternate history setting. Please note that all game design, core mechanics, storyline, tower defense logic, and programming code were created entirely by hand by our development team. AI was used solely to support our artistic vision, ensuring that the integrity and soul of the gameplay remain entirely human-made.

a.sum: ALASH declares generative AI used as a supplementary tool for 2D art assets: environment elements, textures, and background images. Game design, mechanics, storyline, tower defense logic, and code are stated to be entirely hand-made. No live or runtime generation is mentioned.

games.raw: Some of the artwork in Disaster Scenario was created with the help of generative AI tools — including some character art, environment and diorama art, textures, comic illustrations, and store/marketing images. All AI-assisted art is curated, reviewed, and edited by hand by the developer. The game itself uses no AI while you play: all gameplay, text, characters, and outcomes are hand-authored and fully deterministic.

a.sum: Developer declares generative AI was used for some artwork in Disaster Scenario: character art, environment and diorama art, textures, comic illustrations, and store/marketing images. All AI-assisted art was curated, reviewed, and hand-edited by the developer. No AI runs during play; gameplay, text, characters, and outcomes are hand-authored and deterministic.

games.raw: Generative AI was used for the translation and localization of some text in certain languages on the store page.
