games.raw: Images and Music made by AI are in game. Images for UI, and almost all music in game.

a.sum: Developer discloses AI-generated images used for in-game UI and AI-generated music used for almost all of the game's music. The disclosure does not say whether the content is pre-generated or generated live.

games.raw: Some art, music, and 3D assets in this game were created with the help of generative AI tools. Every AI-generated asset was carefully reviewed, refined, and hand-curated by the developer to fit the game's art direction and tone. The game does not use any live-generated (runtime) AI content.

a.sum: Developer discloses generative AI was used to create some art, music, and 3D assets. All AI output was reviewed, refined, and hand-curated. The game states it uses no live-generated (runtime) AI content.

games.raw: The game itself (code, art, audio and gameplay) was made without generative AI. AI writing tools were only used to help draft the store description and marketing text. Voice control runs entirely on your PC and only transcribes your speech; it does not generate any content.

a.sum: AI writing tools were used only to help draft the store description and marketing text. Code, art, audio, and gameplay were made without generative AI. The voice control feature runs locally and only transcribes speech, generating no content, so no live-generated content is declared.

games.raw: This game uses AI-generated artwork for character portraits and encounter illustrations. All other content — game design, code, writing, and audio — is human-created.

a.sum: Declares AI-generated artwork for character portraits and encounter illustrations. States that game design, code, writing, and audio are human-created. Does not say whether the artwork is pre-generated or generated live during play.

games.raw: Some visual assets and concept artwork used in the game were created or assisted by generative AI tools and further modified by the developer. All gameplay systems, story content, level design, and interactive features were created by the developer.

a.sum: Developer discloses that some visual assets and concept artwork were created or assisted by generative AI and then modified by the developer. Gameplay systems, story, level design, and interactive features are stated to be developer-made. No live or runtime AI generation is described.

games.raw: Protocell's soundtrack was generated with an AI music tool, and a few interface layouts were explored with the help of AI image tool. Everything else — the code, the design, the pixel art and the procedurally generated creatures — is hand-crafted or produced by the game's own engine. No generative AI runs in real time while you play.

a.sum: AI is declared for the soundtrack (made with an AI music tool) and for exploring some interface layouts (AI image tool). All other content, including code, design, pixel art, and procedurally generated creatures, is described as hand-crafted or engine-produced. No generative AI runs in real time during play.

games.raw: Some content in SHARDS is created with the help of generative AI. AI image-generation tools are used to produce the game's key art, store capsule images, and marketing visuals, as well as textures for some in-game 3D models. Translations of store and in-game text into languages other than Japanese are also produced with AI assistance. All AI-generated content is reviewed, edited, and approved by the developer before use, and SHARDS does not generate any content live during gameplay. Music and sound effects are not AI-generated.

a.sum: AI image generation is used for key art, store capsules, marketing visuals, and some in-game 3D model textures. AI assists translation of store and in-game text into non-Japanese languages. All AI output is reviewed and approved by the developer before use. No content is generated live during gameplay. Music and sound effects are not AI-generated.

games.raw: Keep Drawing was developed by HuDoes Interactive with AI-assisted tools used as part of our workflow — not as a fully automated production pipeline. Store and marketing graphics (including Steam capsule artwork) were also created with AI assistance and then manually adjusted for quality and consistency. AI-assisted coding tools were used to help write and refactor parts of the game's source code. The design, game systems, balance, and final implementation remain developer-directed.

a.sum: Keep Drawing's developer discloses AI-assisted workflow. Generative AI created or refined some in-game visuals and UI elements during development, all reviewed and integrated by the developer before release. AI helped create store and marketing graphics, including the Steam capsule art, which were manually adjusted. AI coding tools helped write and refactor parts of the source code. Design, systems, balance, and implementation remain developer-directed. No runtime generation is mentioned.

games.raw: Some of this game's artwork (including store capsules and background art) was created with the help of generative AI image tools. This game does not use live-generated AI content during gameplay. No AI system generates new images, text, audio, dialogue, or gameplay content while the game is running. The developer has reviewed the AI-assisted content to ensure that it does not contain illegal or infringing material to the best of their knowledge.

a.sum: The developer discloses pre-generated AI use for selected promotional and store page images, concept/reference images, text refinement, and voice-related production support. All outputs were reviewed and edited by the developer. No live AI generation occurs during gameplay.

games.raw: Some art and audio assets in Cozy Airways were created with the help of generative AI tools during development. All AI-assisted content was reviewed, edited and approved by our team. The game does not generate any AI content live during gameplay.

games.raw: Images & content

a.sum: The text is only the heading 'Images & content' with no disclosure body. It states no AI use, so no AI generation is declared, and the scope and generation type cannot be determined.

No new content is generated by AI during gameplay.

games.raw: During development, some of the game's art assets (including icons, UI elements, scene backgrounds, and character visuals) were created with the help of AI image-generation tools, then curated, adjusted, and integrated by hand. games.raw: Generative AI was used heavily to assist in both coding and artwork.

games.raw: Some artwork and visual assets in this game were created with the assistance of generative AI tools during development. No AI content is generated during gameplay.

a.sum: The developer discloses that some artwork and visual assets were made with generative AI tools during development. No AI content is generated during gameplay.

games.raw: As an independent development team, we use generative AI tools to assist in creating some of the game’s background artwork and decorative wallpapers. games.raw: Utilize AI to generate certain UI elements within the game

a.sum: Developer states AI is used to generate certain in-game UI elements. The disclosure does not say whether the content is pre-generated or created live, or what kind of UI assets are involved.

games.raw: This game uses generative AI tools as part of its development and content production process. AI-assisted workflows were used for selected visual assets, video materials, music or audio drafts, localization/text drafts, code assistance, and marketing/store page materials. All AI-assisted outputs are reviewed, edited, and integrated by the developer before inclusion. The game does not generate AI content during gameplay and does not connect to external AI services while the game is running.

a.sum: The developer declares generative AI use in development and production: selected visual assets, video, music/audio drafts, localization/text drafts, code assistance, and store/marketing materials. All outputs are human-reviewed and edited before use. No AI content is generated during gameplay and the game does not connect to external AI services at runtime.

games.raw: Generative AI was used as part of the development process to assist with the creation and refinement of select visual assets, including concept art, graphical elements, and promotional artwork. AI-generated content is reviewed and modified by the development team before being included in the game or its associated materials.

a.sum: The developer used generative AI to help create and refine select visual assets: concept art, graphical elements, and promotional artwork. The team reviews and modifies this content before it goes into the game or its marketing materials. No live or runtime generation is mentioned.

games.raw: AI was used to assist in creating some game assets and development content. No AI-generated content is created or used during gameplay.

a.sum: The developer says AI assisted in creating some game assets and development content, with the specific asset types not named. No AI-generated content is created or used during gameplay.

games.raw: Some AI tools were used to assist in asset production

a.sum: The developer discloses that some AI tools were used to assist in asset production. The specific asset types and whether any content is generated live in-game are not stated.

games.raw: Card face art, in-game icons, and some store artwork were created with AI assistance.

a.sum: AI assistance was used to create card face art, in-game icons, and some store artwork. No live or runtime generation is mentioned.

games.raw: Generative AI tools were used extensively during the development of DashBreaker. games.raw: The store pages and the game's translations into languages other than English were produced with AI assistance. No AI-generated art, audio or level content ships in Gloom Delve.

games.raw: AI translation was used for the translation of the game and store page text from Japanese into other languages. No generative AI was used for the original Japanese scenario, artwork, or audio.

games.raw: Some 2D art assets (e.g. icons, store capsules, background art) were created with the help of generative AI image tools and then curated and edited by the developer. No AI-generated content is produced live during gameplay.

games.raw: Generative AI was used to assist in creating some UI elements and sound effects. All AI-generated assets were reviewed and edited by the developer before being included in the game.

a.sum: Developer declares generative AI was used to assist in creating some UI elements and sound effects. All AI-generated assets were reviewed and edited before inclusion, so the content is pre-generated, not live-generated.

games.raw: Event illustrations were created with the help of generative AI. They can be hidden in the settings.

a.sum: Event illustrations were created with generative AI. Players can hide them in the settings. The disclosure does not say whether the content is pre-generated or generated live.

games.raw: Xenomire uses generative AI for some sound effects, as well as some UI elements.

a.sum: Developer discloses generative AI used for some sound effects and some UI elements. Does not state whether content is pre-generated or live-generated.

games.raw: We use generative AI to assist in creating art images, adding more details to our work and speeding up the production process. AI-generated images are primarily used for backgrounds and certain CG details.

a.sum: The developer discloses using generative AI to help create art images, add detail, and speed production. The AI-generated images are mainly backgrounds and some CG details. The disclosure describes production-time creation and does not mention live or in-game runtime generation.

games.raw: Generative AI tools were used selectively during the development of Critical Ward, primarily to assist with programming, debugging, and refining existing audiovisual assets. ChatGPT was used to support coding and troubleshooting, while AI-assisted image and audio editing tools helped polish certain graphical assets, music, and sound effects originally created by me. For example, an original countdown sound effect was used as the basis for two additional variations by modifying its pitch with AI tools. This was an AI-assisted transformation of an existing asset rather than a sound generated entirely from scratch. Some of these AI-assisted refinements are included in the final game. However, no content is dynamically generated by AI during gameplay. The game's design, mechanics, characters, progression, and core systems were created and developed by me.

a.sum: AI was used before release to help with coding and debugging (ChatGPT) and to polish developer-created graphics, music, and sound effects, including pitch-modifying a countdown sound into two variations. No content is generated by AI during gameplay. Design, mechanics, characters, progression, and core systems are stated to be the developer's own.

games.raw: Some visual assets, promotional artwork, and store graphical assets were created or assisted using generative AI tools. All assets were reviewed, edited, and integrated into the game by the developer.

a.sum: Developer discloses generative AI was used to create or assist some visual assets, promotional artwork, and store graphics. All were reviewed, edited, and integrated by the developer. No live or in-game runtime generation is mentioned.

games.raw: Graphical assets and localization.

games.raw: Hammered Heroes is a solo-developed game, with all design, direction, and gameplay built by one developer. Some 2D art assets (such as sprites and capsule art) were created with the help of generative AI image tools, then edited and assembled by the developer.

a.sum: The developer discloses that some 2D art assets, such as sprites and capsule art, were created with generative AI image tools and then edited and assembled by the developer. No live or runtime AI generation is mentioned.

games.raw: AI was used to troubleshoot coding issues, generate some game model assets, and some UI elements. All code, models, and UI elements were edited and finalized by me before implementation into the game.

a.sum: The developer used AI to troubleshoot coding issues, generate some game model assets, and some UI elements. All code, models, and UI elements were edited and finalized by the developer before being implemented in the game. No live or runtime generation is mentioned.

games.raw: We used generative AI tools as part of our creative process, alongside our team’s direction, editing, and refinement.

We will continue to improve and replace these images as development progresses.

a.sum: Some unspecified art assets were created with generative AI during development, then hand-selected, edited, composited, and laid out by the developer. games.raw: This game's background music was created using generative AI, and its visual effects were also produced with the assistance of generative AI.

games.raw: Autoregressive Gen Assist & Debugging

games.raw: We want to be 100% clear: this software does not generate AI artwork. All animation, rendering, and creation tools are powered entirely by traditional algorithmic code. The use of AI is strictly limited to: • Text Localization: Assisted translations for store and interface text. • Legacy Shape Detection: An optional, legacy computer-vision model that can be toggled on solely to assist with detecting edges and outlines. It does not generate art from prompts or models, and can be completely ignored in favour of our standard, non-AI outline tools.

a.sum: Developer declares AI use limited to assisted translation of store and interface text, plus an optional legacy computer-vision model for detecting edges and outlines. The developer states no AI generates artwork, and the edge-detection model is not a generative tool and can be ignored in favour of standard outline tools. No live generation is described.

games.raw: AI Used for 3D models and shader creation, UI Logic and Huge amount of Testing-player Bots. (This is a Solo Dev Game)

games.raw: Erevael is made by a solo developer who uses generative AI as part of the development process. The following player-facing content is created with AI and reviewed by the developer before release: - Visual art, including assets used in the procedurally generated world. - Localization: translations are machine-generated and have not yet been professionally reviewed. Music and sound effects are sourced from licensed, human-made libraries and are not AI-generated. AI coding assistants are also used during development. The AI-generated art is a starting point. If the game finds an audience, the plan is to replace it with work from human artists in a free update for everyone, while keeping the original art available as an optional mod.

a.sum: Erevael's developer discloses AI use for player-facing visual art, including assets for the procedurally generated world, all reviewed before release and treated as placeholders to be replaced by human art later. Localization translations are machine-generated and not yet professionally reviewed. Music and sound effects are licensed human-made works, not AI. AI coding assistants are used in development. No live or runtime generation is mentioned.

games.raw: Generative AI is used in this title for translation (to support multiple languages) and for the initial concepts of the background music. All final assets have undergone a process of editing, refinement, and review by human creators.

games.raw: Generative artificial intelligence was used to assist with background materials

a.sum: The developer discloses that generative AI assisted with 'background materials.' The disclosure does not specify what those materials are, whether they are pre-generated or generated live, or whether the content is art, text, or something else.

games.raw: This game is a solo-developed project. Generative AI tools were used as part of the production workflow, including assistance with code and base visual assets. No generative AI output is used as a final in-game asset – all assets were manually edited and finalized by the developer. All gameplay design, creative direction, balancing, and content decisions were made by the developer.

a.sum: Developer discloses generative AI used in production for code assistance and base visual assets. No AI output is used as a final in-game asset; all assets were manually edited and finalized by the developer. Gameplay design, creative direction, balancing, and content were developer-made. No live or runtime generation is mentioned.

games.raw: Generative AI tools were used during development to assist with visual asset creation, programming support, background music generation, and writing/editing structured script data such as dialogue and localization files.

a.sum: The developer declares generative AI was used during development for visual asset creation, programming support, background music generation, and writing/editing structured script data such as dialogue and localization files. Live or runtime generation is not mentioned.

games.raw: A small portion of art assets were created with AI assistance. All AI-generated outputs were manually reviewed, modified, and refined before use.

a.sum: Developer discloses that a small portion of art assets were created with AI assistance. All AI-generated outputs were manually reviewed, modified, and refined before use. The specific art asset types are not named, and no live or runtime generation is mentioned.

games.raw: Some store page / marketing artwork (capsule images) was created with the assistance of generative AI tools. All in-game content is human-made.

a.sum: Generative AI tools assisted in creating store page and marketing artwork (capsule images). All in-game content is stated to be human-made, and no live-generated content is mentioned.

games.raw: This game contains pre-generated AI-assisted content, including some character artwork, visual assets, and audio. All AI-generated content has been reviewed, edited, and integrated into the game by the developer.

a.sum: The developer discloses pre-generated AI-assisted content: some character artwork, visual assets, and audio. All of it was reviewed, edited, and integrated by the developer. No live generation is mentioned. The audio type is not specified.

games.raw: Standard C++ game code, written during development with the assistance of an AI programming assistant, used as a pair-programming tool. This includes gameplay systems (crafting, inventory, world simulation), rendering and UI code, and development tooling. It is ordinary, static game logic. AI assistance was used only during development, directed by myself through specific requests, with every change reviewed, tested, and committed to version control by myself. The shipped game contains no AI models and does not execute or generate any code or content via AI at runtime. The game is a fully offline, single-player experience.

a.sum: AI was used as a development-time pair-programming assistant to help write standard C++ game code (gameplay systems, rendering and UI, and development tooling). The developer directed each request and reviewed, tested, and committed every change. The shipped game contains no AI models and generates no code or content with AI at runtime. It is fully offline and single-player.

games.raw: Some of the game's art assets were created with the assistance of generative AI tools.

a.sum: Developer discloses that some unspecified game art assets were made with assistance from generative AI tools. No details on specific asset types, whether content is pre-generated or live, or the extent of AI involvement.

games.raw: Generative AI tools were used during development to assist with the creation and editing of some visual assets, background assets, character assets, code, and text. The game does not include live AI-generated content based on player input. All AI-assisted content has been reviewed, edited, and approved by the developer before inclusion. The game does not contain AI-generated adult-only content.

a.sum: Generative AI was used during development to create and edit some visual assets (background and character art), code, and text. No live AI-generated content based on player input. All AI-assisted content was reviewed and approved by the developer. No AI-generated adult-only content.

games.raw: We used generative AI to assist with translating Galacto's in-game text into its supported languages. All game design, artwork, sound and music were created by hand without generative AI

a.sum: Generative AI was used to assist translating the game's in-game text into supported languages (localization). The developer states that game design, artwork, sound, and music were made by hand without generative AI. No runtime or live AI generation is mentioned.

games.raw: All story, lore, dialogue, and worldbuilding were written by the developer. AI was used only for proofreading and grammar feedback.

a.sum: Developer states all story, lore, dialogue, and worldbuilding were written by them. AI was used only for proofreading and grammar feedback on text, not to generate content.

games.raw: We used AI tools to generate several 2D images and art assets used throughout the game.

a.sum: The developer states they used AI tools to generate several 2D images and art assets that appear throughout the game. The text does not say whether the content is pre-generated or generated live during play.

games.raw: Generative AI was used to assist in the creation of some 2D visual assets, including certain fish and other artwork. AI-generated materials were reviewed, edited, and adjusted by the developer before being included in the game. Generative AI was also used as a development aid for ideation and production support. No content is generated by AI in real time during gameplay.

a.sum: The developer used generative AI to help create some 2D visual assets, including certain fish and other artwork. The developer reviewed, edited, and adjusted these outputs before inclusion. Generative AI was also used as a development aid for ideation and production support. No content is generated in real time during gameplay.

games.raw: AI tools were used to assist with coding.

a.sum: Developer states AI tools assisted with coding. No pre-generated or live-generated content is mentioned.

games.raw: The game calls the aforementioned third-party large language model API over the network at runtime. When the player makes a decision, issues an imperial edict, or interacts with ministers in the game, the game assembles the current situation and character settings into a request and sends it to the AI service; the text returned by the service (minister dialogue, memorials to the throne, plot deduction) is presented in the game interface in real time. This process is transparent to the player and requires no player-side configuration, but an internet connection is required throughout.

a.sum: The game sends player decisions, edicts, and minister interactions along with current situation and character settings to a third-party LLM API at runtime. The returned text (minister dialogue, memorials to the throne, plot deduction) is shown in the interface in real time. It requires an internet connection and needs no player-side configuration.

games.raw: The game's core visual presentation is built around human-created playable character sprite sheets and map artwork, while the level layouts and game design are created by the developer. Generative AI was used for selected pre-generated audio, localization, and supporting visual content, including the logo and key art illustrations. No generative AI content is generated during gameplay.

a.sum: The developer declares generative AI use limited to pre-generated content: selected audio (specific type not stated), localization, and supporting visuals including the logo and key art illustrations. Character sprite sheets, map artwork, level layouts, and game design are human-created. No generative AI runs during gameplay.

games.raw: The game does not use AI to generate content for the game. Some of the game content was developed using AI, but the game itself does not use AI to generate any content.

a.sum: Developer says some game content was developed using AI, but the game does not use AI to generate any content in-game. Which content was affected is not specified.

games.raw: Some art assets and music are first generated by AI, then manually re-created for secondary refinement.

a.sum: Some art assets and music were first generated by AI and then manually re-created for secondary refinement. The disclosure does not specify where the art assets are used, and it does not mention live or runtime generation.

games.raw: During development, generative AI tools were used to assist in the creation of certain visual assets. All AI-generated content has been reviewed and curated by the development team.

a.sum: Developer declares generative AI was used during development to assist in creating certain unspecified visual assets. All AI-generated content was reviewed and curated by the team. No live or in-game runtime generation is mentioned.

games.raw: Localization and some background 3D assets and sound effects were created with AI assistance.

a.sum: AI assistance was used for localization, some background 3D assets, and some sound effects. The disclosure says nothing about live or runtime generation.

games.raw: The developer used AI tools as an assistive technology for creating select 2D backgrounds (main menu and event nodes) and for translating non-English text. All such content was pre-generated during development, with no live AI generation in the game.

a.sum: Developer declares AI used as an assistive tool for select 2D backgrounds (main menu and event nodes) and for translating non-English text. All AI content was pre-generated during development; the game contains no live AI generation.

games.raw: AI-assisted tools were used during development for selected audio, music, interface iteration, coding assistance, and design feedback. All final content was reviewed, selected, and integrated by the developer. The game does not use live-generated AI during gameplay.

a.sum: The developer declares AI-assisted tools were used during development for selected audio, music, interface iteration, coding assistance, and design feedback. The developer reviewed, selected, and integrated all final content. The game does not use live-generated AI during gameplay. 'Selected audio' is not specified as sound effects or voice, so it is mapped to 'other'.

games.raw: Most of the code and game assets are AI-generated.

games.raw: AI tools are used exclusively to translate game content into different languages.

a.sum: The developer states AI tools are used exclusively to translate game content into other languages. The disclosure does not say whether translations are pre-generated or generated live.

The developer reviewed and curated all generated assets before inclusion. No live or runtime generation is mentioned.

games.raw: Crooked Derby includes some pre-generated visual assets created with generative AI. All AI-assisted content was iterated on, reviewed, and approved by the developer before being included in the game.

games.raw: Portions of this game's art and audio were created using generative AI tools during development: card and character artwork, backgrounds and icons (including store page artwork), music, sound effects, and voice audio were AI-generated under human direction, then curated and edited by the developers. Game design, rules, code, card text and names, and all narrative writing are human-authored. Nothing is generated by AI while you play.

a.sum: AI generated art (card and character art, backgrounds, icons, store page art), music, sound effects, and voice audio during development, under human direction and then curated and edited. Design, rules, code, card text and names, and narrative are human-authored. Nothing is generated by AI during play.

games.raw: The artwork, background music, in-game text and story, localizations into all supported languages, and store-page text in this game were created using generative AI tools, then curated, edited, and assembled by the developer. The game contains no live AI generation — all content is fixed and produced ahead of release.

a.sum: Developer discloses generative AI use for artwork, background music, in-game text and story, localizations into all supported languages, and store-page text, all curated and assembled by the developer. No live AI generation; all content is fixed before release.

games.raw: This game utilizes generative artificial intelligence tools to assist in the creation of pre-rendered character portraits and musical materials.

games.raw: Marketing and Store Visuals: AI tools were utilized during the concept design and background detailing phases for the thumbnail images, posters, and promotional materials on the Steam store page. Sound Design and Trailer Music: AI-powered sound and music production tools were used in the prototyping and production processes for the game’s promotional trailers and in-game atmospheric background sounds. Text and Localization Support: AI assistants were used to edit store page descriptions, marketing copy, and language optimization.

a.sum: The developer discloses AI use in pre-release production: concept and background detailing for Steam store thumbnails, posters, and promotional art; AI sound and music tools for trailer music and in-game atmospheric background sounds; and AI assistants for editing store descriptions, marketing copy, and language optimization. No live or runtime generation is mentioned.

games.raw: Some in-game voice lines and music were created with generative AI. No AI content is generated live during gameplay.

games.raw: AI is merely an auxiliary tool, not an excuse for laziness! We leverage AI to generate in-game image assets and use Suno AI to create the game’s background music. All AI-generated visual and audio materials have been manually reviewed and edited to ensure compliance with content standards.

a.sum: The developer declares AI use for in-game image assets (generated with AI tools) and the game's background music (created with Suno AI). All AI-generated visual and audio material was manually reviewed and edited before use. No runtime or live generation is mentioned.

games.raw: As an independent studio, we use generative artificial intelligence to continue developing the games we love. This enables us to tackle tasks that would otherwise be beyond the capacity of our small team. Generative AI was used in the development of certain user interface elements, as well as in translating the game into various languages. Every component created with the help of AI underwent thorough review and refinement before being included in the final version of the game.

a.sum: The developer declares generative AI use in certain UI elements and in translating the game into multiple languages. All AI-created components were reviewed and refined before inclusion in the final build. No live or runtime generation is mentioned.

games.raw: Some music and assets in this game were created with generative AI tools, then manually reworked and adapted by the developer. The game design, code and integration are the developer's own work.

a.sum: The developer discloses that some music and unspecified assets were created with generative AI tools and then manually reworked. Game design, code, and integration are stated to be the developer's own work. No live or runtime generation is mentioned.

games.raw: The token illustrations were made from AI-generated images, then reworked by hand. Everything else in Tapis is made without AI: game design, rules, balancing. No AI runs while you play.

a.sum: Token illustrations were created from AI-generated images and then reworked by hand. All other parts of Tapis, including game design, rules, and balancing, are non-AI. No AI runs during gameplay.

games.raw: This game used AI-assisted tools during development to help create parts of the Unity/C# code, and some music was created with AI-assisted music generation tools. All AI-assisted code and AI-generated music were reviewed, edited, tested, and integrated by the developer. The game does not generate code during gameplay and does not connect to external generative AI services while players are playing.

The game does not generate code during gameplay and does not connect to external generative AI services while playing.

games.raw: Voice over in this game is created using a combination of real voices with AI voices.

a.sum: The developer discloses AI use for voice-over, which combines real human voices with AI-generated voices. The disclosure does not say whether the voices are pre-generated or generated live during play.

games.raw: AI was used for scenario proofreading, coding assistance, and asset refinement. All content was reviewed and approved by the development team.

a.sum: The developer says AI was used for scenario proofreading, coding assistance, and asset refinement, and that the development team reviewed and approved all content. The disclosure does not say whether AI generated content before release or during play, and does not specify the asset types.

games.raw: Snot Pop! is an indie project. Like many independent developers, generative AI was used as a tool among many during development; for brainstorming, writing, art and audio design, and working through balancing problems. AI was not the game designer or orchestrator of the project. All content was reviewed, directed, altered, and approved before inclusion. Everything in the game reflects deliberate creative decisions made by the developer.

a.sum: Developer states generative AI was used as one tool among many for brainstorming, writing, art and audio design, and balancing problems. AI did not act as game designer or orchestrator. All content was reviewed, directed, altered, and approved before inclusion, implying pre-generated assets. No runtime or live generation is mentioned. The text does not specify which art or audio assets were affected.

games.raw: Visual assets in Blackbriar Crypt were created with generative AI tools (Stable Diffusion via ComfyUI), including in-game 2D art such as item icons, character portraits, enemy sprites, and UI backgrounds, as well as store and library marketing images. Each asset was selected, edited, and approved by the developer before release.

a.sum: Visual assets were generated with Stable Diffusion via ComfyUI and approved by the developer before release. Uses include in-game 2D art (item icons, character portraits, enemy sprites, UI backgrounds) and store and library marketing images. No live or runtime generation is mentioned.

games.raw: ERLIK is a solo project. The game design, mechanics, balance, folklore research and English writing are my own work. Nothing is generated while you play. The translations were AI-assisted and then reviewed. Generative AI tools were used for parts of the art and sound; every asset was directed, edited and tuned by hand to fit the game.

a.sum: Developer declares AI use for translations (AI-assisted, then human-reviewed) and for unspecified parts of the art and sound, all created before release and hand-edited. Nothing is generated during play. Core design, writing, and folklore research are stated as human-made.

games.raw: This game uses generative AI to assist with translations for some supported languages. As a small indie team, professional localization for every supported language is not currently within our budget, but we hope to work with professional translators as soon as it's financially feasible for us. All puzzles, artwork, characters, writing, game design, and gameplay were developed by our team.

a.sum: The developer discloses generative AI use only for translating text into some supported languages, because professional localization is not yet affordable. They plan to hire professional translators later. Puzzles, artwork, characters, writing, game design, and gameplay are stated to be team-made, with no AI use declared for them. The text does not say whether translations are pre-generated or generated at runtime.

games.raw: Campaign Forge uses generative AI as its core feature. Worlds, characters, regions, and stories are generated live, on demand, and only at your direction, using the bundled local AI model that ships with the game — or, optionally, your own locally hosted model. No account, API key, or internet connection is required. Every generation request is governed by a built-in content policy that requires original fantasy content and prohibits illegal or infringing material.

a.sum: Campaign Forge declares its core feature is generative AI that creates worlds, characters, regions, and stories live, on demand, at the player's direction. It runs on a bundled local model or an optional player-hosted local model, with no account, API key, or internet required. A built-in content policy requires original fantasy content and prohibits illegal or infringing material.

games.raw: Some of the game's background music (BGM) uses tracks created with generative AI, and AI tools were used for localization (translation) into some languages. Store page images and some in-game illustrations (such as cutscenes and maps) were created with the assistance of AI image generation tools. Some in-game icons are based on AI-generated images that were then manually retouched and refined by the developer. All other content (in-game pixel art including characters and monsters, code, original story, etc.) was not created with AI.

a.sum: The developer discloses AI use for background music (some tracks generative AI), translation/localization into some languages, store page images, in-game illustrations (cutscenes and maps), and icons based on AI images that were manually retouched. In-game pixel art (characters, monsters), code, and original story are stated as not AI-created. All described AI content is pre-generated; no runtime generation is mentioned.

games.raw: Many of the art assets used at this stage are AI-generated placeholders, including most of the card artwork. These AI assets help depict the overall creative style and vision that will be achieved in the full release. A Kickstarter campaign will be dedicated to raising the funds to replace the AI placeholder art. All of the sound design, music, text and game code is entirely human-created.

a.sum: The developer discloses that many art assets, including most card artwork, are AI-generated placeholders used to show the intended style. They will be replaced in the full release through a Kickstarter. Sound design, music, text, and game code are stated to be entirely human-created.

games.raw: Some non-interactive assets in Harvest Havoc were produced with AI-assisted tools: - Background music tracks were generated via AI music synthesis models, then curated and mixed by the developer. - Sound effects were produced with AI-assisted audio generation tools. - In-game text in English, Japanese, Russian, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese and German was drafted with AI translation assistance and then reviewed by the developer. Simplified Chinese is the original authored text. All level design, sprite art and character animations are drawn procedurally by hand-written code; no AI image generation was used. No AI content is generated at runtime.

a.sum: AI was used before release for background music (synthesis, then developer curation and mixing), sound effects, and AI-assisted translation of in-game text into six languages, all reviewed by the developer. Simplified Chinese is original. Level design, sprite art and animations are hand-coded procedurally with no AI image generation, and no AI content is generated at runtime.

games.raw: 本游戏在开发过程中使用生成式人工智能工具辅助制作部分预生成美术素材和程序代码。相关内容均经过开发者人工筛选、修改、整合与测试后加入游戏。 游戏运行时不会连接生成式 AI 服务，也不会根据玩家输入实时生成或输出任何 AI 内容。

a.sum: The developer declares AI-assisted development: some pre-generated art assets and program code were made with generative AI tools. All AI output was manually screened, modified, integrated, and tested before inclusion. The game does not connect to generative AI services at runtime and does not generate or output AI content based on player input.

games.raw: In Game: Icons and splash screens in the game have been generated during the development process using artificial intelligence. Store page: Images on the store page have been generated using artificial intelligence, with exception of in game screen shots which are not made using AI.

a.sum: AI was used during development to generate in-game icons and splash screens, and to generate images on the store page. In-game screenshots on the store page are not AI-made. No live or runtime generation is mentioned.

games.raw: Lane Wars uses generative AI only for some pre-made 2D artwork: the game's icon, main-menu key art, and the Steam store capsule/promotional images were created with AI image-generation tools and then edited by the developer. Some trailer and marketing music was made with an AI music tool. Everything you interact with in-game — the 3D characters, environments, HUD, visual and sound effects, and all gameplay systems — is hand-built and procedurally generated in code, not AI-generated. The game does not use any generative AI at runtime.

a.sum: AI was used only for pre-made 2D art (game icon, main-menu key art, Steam capsule and promotional images, later edited by the developer) and for some trailer/marketing music. All in-game content and gameplay systems are hand-built or code-procedural, and no generative AI runs at runtime.

games.raw: Disclaimer - AI has been used as a tool in some code elements.

a.sum: Developer discloses AI was used as a tool in some code elements. No other content types are mentioned, and the disclosure does not say whether any AI generation happens at runtime.

games.raw: Some creature sprites and artwork were created with the assistance of AI image generation tools (Pixellab) and subsequently edited and refined by hand. All game design, mechanics, and balance are human-made. Development tools with AI assistance were used for portions of the code. The game does not generate any content with AI at runtime.

a.sum: AI image generation (Pixellab) was used to create some creature sprites and artwork, which were then edited and refined by hand. AI-assisted development tools were used for portions of the code. Game design, mechanics, and balance are human-made. No content is generated by AI at runtime.

games.raw: Generative AI-assisted tools were used as part of the development process for Xenogarden. This includes support in creating and refining selected visual content such as concept art, artwork, textures, marketing materials and store page assets, as well as assistance with text, localization, sound/music ideas and creative drafts. All content included in the game is pre-generated, selected, reviewed and curated. The game does not generate new AI content during gameplay and does not connect to external AI services during gameplay.

a.sum: Xenogarden used generative AI tools in development for concept art, artwork, textures, marketing and store assets, text, localization, and sound/music ideas. All in-game AI content is pre-generated, reviewed, and curated. The game generates no AI content during play and does not connect to external AI services.

games.raw: Some textures have been created with AI assistance.

a.sum: The developer discloses that some textures were created with AI assistance. No other AI uses or live generation are mentioned, and the timing of generation is not specified.

games.raw: We used generative AI to create the user interface (UI) design and some of the graphic assets for this title.

a.sum: The developer says generative AI was used to create the UI design and some graphic assets. The disclosure does not say whether the content is pre-generated or live-generated, or where the graphic assets appear.

games.n: 47都道府県にプロ野球チームが存在する世界線で日本一の球団をめざそう！
games.raw: This game uses generative AI tools during development. AI-assisted tools are used to help create or refine some artwork, including fictional team logos, mascots, character portraits, background illustrations, and marketing images. AI-assisted tools are also used to help create or refine some sound and music-related materials, such as fictional team cheering themes and audio concepts. AI is used to assist with fictional game data creation, including team concepts, player data, regional flavor text, news text, event ideas, and other in-game text content. AI-assisted coding tools are used during development to help write, review, debug, and improve parts of the game code. All content is reviewed and edited by the developer before being included in the game. The game does not use live generative AI during gameplay.

a.sum: Developer discloses dev-time generative AI use for in-game and marketing artwork (logos, mascots, portraits, backgrounds, marketing images), audio and music concepts (cheering themes, audio concepts), fictional game text and data (team concepts, player data, flavor, news, event ideas), and AI-assisted coding. All content is reviewed and edited by the developer. No live generative AI is used during gameplay.

games.raw: Generative AI was used during development to assist in creating some of the pre-generated visual assets. All such assets were manually selected, modified, and integrated by the developers. The game does not generate content in real-time during gameplay, nor does it connect to external AI services.

a.sum: Generative AI was used during development to help create some pre-generated visual assets (specific asset types not stated). Developers manually selected, modified, and integrated them. No real-time generation during gameplay and no connection to external AI services.

games.raw: Neural Defense was developed by a five-person indie team using a combination of hand-crafted work and generative AI tools. Generative AI was used during development to assist with music composition, concept art, portions of the game's code, and the editing and expansion of some narrative text. All final in-game assets — including 3D models, textures, and visual art seen during gameplay — were hand-crafted by the studio's artists. No content or code is generated live during gameplay; everything was created, reviewed, and finalized by the team prior to release.

a.sum: Generative AI was used during development for music composition, concept art, portions of code, and editing/expansion of some narrative text. Final in-game assets (3D models, textures, visual art) were hand-crafted. No content or code is generated live during gameplay; all content was pre-generated, reviewed, and finalized before release.

games.raw: As of October 1, 2026 Our previous disclaimer disclosed the use of AI in drafting some of our original assets. As of October 1, 2026, thanks to the support of our early backers, the use of Aseprite and GIMP, and the work of talented freelance artists, all assets have been redrawn, rebuilt, and redesigned from their original versions, allowing us to move away from AI-generated artwork. We will retain this disclaimer in the interest of complete transparency and to acknowledge the development process behind the game.

a.sum: The developer previously disclosed using AI to draft some original assets. As of October 1, 2026, all assets were redrawn, rebuilt, or redesigned by people (using Aseprite, GIMP, and freelance artists), so the AI-generated artwork was removed. The disclaimer is kept for transparency. No live or runtime AI generation is mentioned, and the specific asset types affected are not named.

games.raw: Voice lines for the game's characters are generated using AI text-to-speech tools (ElevenLabs), from scripts written entirely by the developer, then edited and integrated by hand. All AI-generated content is pre-rendered: the game does not generate any content at runtime.

a.sum: Character voice lines are created with AI text-to-speech (ElevenLabs) from developer-written scripts, then hand-edited and integrated. All AI content is pre-rendered; the game generates nothing at runtime.

games.raw: The soundtrack is AI generated with human modifications. Art, text, localizations, and store assets were made with AI assistance and human modifications. Nothing is generated at runtime, and the game never connects to an AI service.

a.sum: The developer declares AI use: the soundtrack is AI-generated with human modifications; art, text, localizations, and store assets were made with AI assistance and human modifications. All content is pre-generated, nothing is generated at runtime, and the game never connects to an AI service.

games.raw: Generative AI was used during development to assist in creating some pre-generated visual assets for the game and its promotional materials, as well as parts of the English localization. All AI-assisted content was reviewed by the developer and edited where necessary. No content is generated by AI while the game is running.

a.sum: Generative AI was used during development to help create some pre-generated visual assets for the game and its promotional materials, and for parts of the English localization. The developer reviewed and edited all AI-assisted content. No content is generated by AI while the game runs.

games.raw: Some of the game’s visuals and sound effects have been created using artificial intelligence.

a.sum: The developer discloses that some visuals and sound effects were created using AI. The disclosure does not specify which visuals are affected, whether the content is pre-generated or live-generated, or whether it is used in store pages, marketing, or in-game.

games.raw: Some material images and sound effects are AI-generated.

a.sum: Some material images and sound effects are AI-generated. Live generation is not mentioned.

games.raw: AI tools were used during the development of this game to assist in creating some code, text, 2D visual assets, and character voice lines. AI-generated materials were further edited, refined, and processed by our team to ensure consistency with the game's overall art style and design. The game does not generate AI content at runtime, nor does it use third-party AI tools to generate content during gameplay.

a.sum: The developer declares AI use during development for code, text, 2D visual assets, and character voice lines, with human editing afterward. The game generates no AI content at runtime and uses no third-party AI tools during gameplay.

games.raw: This game used generative artificial intelligence to assist in creating certain content, including: concept designs for the opening comic and concept art for some UI elements. All AI-assisted content has been reviewed, edited, and remade manually. The game does not generate real-time AI content during runtime.

a.sum: The developer used generative AI for concept designs of the opening comic and concept art for some UI elements. All such content was reviewed, edited, and manually remade. The game does not generate AI content in real time at runtime.

games.raw: Assisted in coding and partial art asset creation.

a.sum: Developer declares AI assistance in coding and partial creation of art assets. The specific art asset types are not named, and the disclosure does not say whether AI generated content is pre-generated or live.

games.raw: Some visual assets used during development were created or assisted by generative AI and have been reviewed, refined, and integrated by the development team. All gameplay, level design, programming, and the overall player experience are created and curated by the developers.

a.sum: Developer discloses that some unspecified visual assets were created or assisted by generative AI during development, then reviewed, refined, and integrated by the team. Gameplay, level design, programming, and overall player experience are stated to be developer-created and curated, with no live generation mentioned.

games.raw: The game uses AI to create artwork and animations. However, no content was used randomly. Every AI-generated asset went through careful review, refinement, and adjustments to ensure it fit the game's artistic vision. The use of AI was an artistic choice, and every piece of content was meticulously polished to deliver an incredible gaming experience.

a.sum: The developer declares AI use for artwork and animations. The AI-generated assets were reviewed, refined, and adjusted before use, which suggests they were pre-generated rather than produced live. The text does not explicitly say whether any content is generated during play.

games.raw: AI helped with grammatical corrections for in-game text, which were then carefully reviewed and adjusted by hand Some store visuals modified with AI assistance

a.sum: The developer declares AI use in two areas: AI helped with grammatical corrections to in-game text, which were then reviewed and adjusted by hand, and AI assistance modified some store visuals. No live or runtime generation is mentioned.

games.raw: This game is developed by a solo developer. To ship a project of this scope in a reasonable timeframe, some assets are created with the help of generative AI tools. This includes parts of the user interface, the game logo and store capsule images(edited with AI). All core gameplay systems are built by hand. AI is used only as a support tool for visual assets and coding, and all generated content is reviewed and edited before use.

a.sum: The developer declares generative AI use for parts of the UI, the game logo, and store capsule images (edited with AI), plus AI-assisted coding as a support tool. Core gameplay systems are hand-built, and all AI output is reviewed and edited before use. The disclosure describes pre-generated assets only and does not mention any live or runtime generation.

games.raw: Limited use of AI in artwork.

a.sum: The developer discloses limited use of AI in artwork. The disclosure does not specify which artwork, whether the content is pre-generated or generated live, or whether any live generated content is used.

games.raw: Generative OpenAI tools were used during development to create and edit selected game illustrations, backgrounds, fictional-character portraits, document and assignment images, some marketing artwork, and to assist with portions of written content and localization. All generated material was reviewed, selected, edited, and integrated by the developer. Licensed archival photographs and credited source materials are identified separately in the in-game credits. Story narration and telephone conversations include pre-generated synthetic voice performances made with ElevenLabs eleven_multilingual_v2, using licensed default voices and original Voice Design voices. They were technically and linguistically reviewed before integration; no politician's voice is cloned or imitated. The game does not generate AI content during gameplay and does not connect to external AI services.

a.sum: Developer used OpenAI tools to create and edit pre-generated in-game illustrations, backgrounds, fictional portraits, document images, some marketing art, and assist written content and localization, all reviewed and integrated by the developer. Story narration and telephone conversations use pre-generated ElevenLabs synthetic voices (licensed default and original Voice Design voices, no politician voices cloned). No AI content is generated during gameplay and no external AI connections exist.

games.raw: All translations in the game were generated using AI.

a.sum: Developer discloses that all in-game translations were generated using AI. The disclosure does not say whether the translations are pre-generated or generated live.

games.raw: Bar Baron's game design, code, simulation systems, balance and all in-game text are written by hand.Generative AI was used as a production tool in two places: some of the game's 3D props-furniture, bar equipment, kitchen and decor items-were produced with AI tools, and part of the soundtrack is AI-generated music. Those props were made specifically for Bar Baron, following our own art direction, and were then reviewed, optimized and placed by hand-this is not a game assembled from generic asset packs. Character models are not AI-generated. Nothing is generated while you play. The game runs no generative AI at runtime: every system, every event and every number in the simulation was authored by a person.

a.sum: AI was used as a production tool for some 3D props (furniture, bar equipment, kitchen and decor items), which were then reviewed, optimized, and placed by hand, and for part of the soundtrack's music. Code, design, simulation, balance, in-game text, and character models are hand-made, and no generative AI runs at runtime.

games.raw: Forged Cards is a passion project, built by one person. I'm not a game studio, I'm a single developer who fell in love with an idea for a deck-builder where you build the cards and set out to make it real. Games like this usually take a team. Modern AI development tools are a big part of how one person was able to build something at this scope. I used AI coding assistants to help me build and iterate on the game's systems, AI image generation for the art, and AI-generated sound effects, all of it reviewed, edited, and shaped by me to fit the world I wanted to create. Every card, every enemy, every choice about how this game looks and feels came from a person (and some close friends) who cared about getting it right. I'm being upfront about this because I think you deserve to know how the thing you're playing was made. Forged Cards exists because these tools let one person build a game that otherwise would have stayed an idea in a notebook.

a.sum: The developer used AI coding assistants to build and iterate on game systems, AI image generation for the game's art (including cards and enemies), and AI-generated sound effects. All outputs were reviewed and edited by a human. No runtime or live AI generation is mentioned.

games.raw: Some in-game artwork, visual effects, backgrounds, splash/key-art variants, store/community artwork, and selected music were created or assisted with generative AI tools during development, then edited, reviewed, converted, and integrated by the developer. The game does not generate AI content during play and does not send player prompts, names, chat, or gameplay data to an external AI service for live generation.

a.sum: Generative AI was used during development to create or assist in-game artwork, visual effects, backgrounds, splash/key-art variants, store and community artwork, and selected music. The developer edited, reviewed, converted, and integrated the output. The game does not generate AI content during play or send player data to external AI services for live generation.

games.raw: Some in-game weapon and item icons were created with generative AI tools. All other art, audio, code, and gameplay content is human-made.

a.sum: The developer declares that some in-game weapon and item icons were created with generative AI tools. All other art, audio, code, and gameplay content is stated to be human-made. No live or runtime generation is mentioned.

games.raw: The in-game music and soundtrack are created using Suno (generative AI). All visual art is produced procedurally through code. Development used an AI coding assistant (Claude), which is a development-efficiency tool; it does not generate any content live at runtime. No generative AI runs during gameplay.

a.sum: AI (Suno) was used to create the in-game music and soundtrack, and an AI coding assistant (Claude) was used in development. Visual art is described only as procedural through code, with no AI stated. No generative AI runs during gameplay.

games.raw: The soundtrack was AI assisted.

a.sum: The developer states the soundtrack was AI assisted. The disclosure does not say whether the content was pre-generated or generated live, or whether the assistance was partial or full.

games.raw: The scene art, music, and ambient audio were generated during development and art-directed by the team. The interface's frame art began as image-model samples, cut and cleaned by the team. The ruleset adaptation, the world and its systems, every location's written description, the interface's design, and the voice the Machine Game Master is held to are human-made.

a.sum: The developer declares AI use for pre-generated scene art, music, and ambient audio, all art-directed by the team. Interface frame art began as image-model samples that the team cut and cleaned. The ruleset, world and systems, location descriptions, interface design, and the Machine Game Master's voice standard are described as human-made. No live generation is mentioned.

games.raw: Generative AI was used to assist in the creation of certain artwork, background music, sound effects, and translations. All AI-assisted content was reviewed, edited, and integrated by the developer. No content is generated by AI during gameplay.

a.sum: Developer declares generative AI assisted in creating unspecified artwork, background music, sound effects, and translations. All AI-assisted content was reviewed, edited, and integrated by the developer. No content is generated by AI during gameplay.

games.raw: Most of the game's 2D art assets — including monster sprites, map backgrounds, skill and skill tree icons, achievement icons, and store/marketing key art — were created with the assistance of generative AI image tools and then reviewed and edited by the developer. The short boss intro and boss defeat cutscene videos, and some of their sound effects, were also created with generative AI tools and then edited by the developer. Portions of the localization text (store page and in-game translations) were produced with AI assistance under human review. The game does not generate any content with AI at runtime.

a.sum: Most 2D art (monster sprites, map backgrounds, skill, skill tree, and achievement icons, and store/marketing key art) was made with generative AI image tools and then edited by the developer. The boss intro and defeat cutscene videos and some of their sound effects were also AI-generated and edited. Portions of localization text were AI-assisted with human review. No content is generated by AI at runtime.

games.raw: Shirt Happens! was made with the help of generative AI. We used it to write and review code, to bring the game's mechanics online, to support our UI work, to generate visual assets and reference images for our 2D and 3D art, to draft written text including parts of this store page, and as a sounding board for design ideas. Everything it produced was reviewed, edited and finished by us before it shipped.

a.sum: The developer declares generative AI use for writing and reviewing code, bringing game mechanics online, supporting UI work, generating visual assets and reference images for 2D and 3D art, drafting text including parts of the store page, and as a design sounding board. All output was reviewed and finished by the team before shipping. No live or runtime generation is described, though 'bring the game's mechanics online' is ambiguous.

games.raw: Minor UI elements were created with generative AI, (then further polished in Photoshop). No generative AI is used at runtime, all content in the game is fixed and pre-rendered.

a.sum: Generative AI was used to create minor UI elements, which were then polished in Photoshop. No generative AI runs at runtime; all game content is fixed and pre-rendered.

games.raw: This game uses generative AI in the following ways: - Some of the in-game and store page artwork was created using AI image generation tools. - Some localization (translations) was assisted by AI tools. All AI-generated content is reviewed and edited by the developer before release. Background music uses royalty-free tracks and is not AI-generated. Parts of the game's code were written with the assistance of AI coding tools.

a.sum: The developer discloses AI use for some in-game and store page artwork (image generation), AI-assisted localization/translation, and AI-assisted code. All AI-generated content is reviewed and edited by the developer before release. Background music is royalty-free and not AI-generated. No runtime or live generation is mentioned.

games.raw: AI were used to improve the language and readability of the in-game tutorial and the Steam store page.

a.sum: AI was used to improve the language and readability of the in-game tutorial text and the Steam store page text. No live or runtime generation is mentioned.

games.raw: The in-game translations for languages other than English and French were produced with AI translation tools.

a.sum: The developer discloses AI tools were used to produce in-game translations for languages other than English and French. Localization is the only AI-assisted area declared. The disclosure does not say whether the content is pre-generated or generated live.

games.n: Drone Orbit: An Incremental Space Mining Drift
games.raw: We use generative AI tools to produce the music and sound effects in this game. All audio is reviewed and edited by our team before release.

a.sum: The developer uses generative AI to produce the game's music and sound effects. All audio is reviewed and edited by the team before release, so the content is pre-generated rather than generated live.

games.raw: This game uses generative AI-assisted content in some pre-generated visual assets, such as visual effects, UI elements, and background or promotional artwork, as well as in localization. All AI-assisted content is reviewed and finalized by the developer. No live generative AI system is used during gameplay, and the game does not generate new player-facing content dynamically while the player is playing.

a.sum: The developer declares generative AI use for pre-generated visual effects, UI elements, background artwork, promotional artwork, and localization. All AI-assisted content is reviewed and finalized by the developer. No live generative AI runs during gameplay, and no new player-facing content is generated dynamically.

games.raw: Generative AI was used to create a small portion of the game’s artwork.

a.sum: Developer discloses that generative AI was used to create a small portion of the game's artwork. The specific art category and whether content is pre-generated or generated live are not stated.

games.raw: Generative AI was used as an assistive tool during the development of UNTIL SOMEWHERE. It helped accelerate certain prototyping phases, explore concept art ideas, and experiment with programming solutions. All assets integrated into the game were modified or recreated by the developer to align with the project's art direction and gameplay.

a.sum: Developer used generative AI as a development-time assistive tool for accelerating prototyping, exploring concept art ideas, and experimenting with programming solutions. All integrated assets were modified or recreated by the developer. No live in-game generation is described.

games.raw: Generative AI was used during the development of this game to speed up the coding process and to create some 2D visual designs. No other AI tools were used in the creation of the game.

a.sum: Generative AI was used during development to speed up coding and to create some 2D visual designs. The developer states no other AI tools were used. The disclosure does not mention any live or in-game generated content, and does not specify where the 2D visuals appear.

games.n: There is No Stress in Outer Space

games.raw: Generative AI tools are used to create some background images and marketing materials, as well as to assist with the animation production process. The final assets are adjusted by the development team.

a.sum: Generative AI creates some background images and marketing materials and assists the animation production process. The development team adjusts the final assets. No live or runtime generation is mentioned.

games.raw: This game uses AI-generated visual assets (security camera imagery, anomaly overlays, UI, across all in-game cameras) and AI-generated ambient music and sound effects. All AI-generated content was created during development and is fixed/pre-authored — none of it is generated live based on player input during gameplay.

a.sum: Developer declares AI-generated visual assets (security camera imagery, anomaly overlays, UI across all in-game cameras) and AI-generated ambient music and sound effects. All AI content was created during development and is fixed/pre-authored, not generated live from player input.

games.raw: I made MoonDoku's music, its world backdrops, and some of its other art and sound effects with generative AI tools. Nothing is generated while you play, and the game never connects to an AI service.

a.sum: Developer used generative AI to create MoonDoku's music, world backdrops, some other art, and sound effects before release. Nothing is generated during play, and the game does not connect to any AI service.

games.raw: Chrome Circuit is developed by a solo developer who uses generative AI as part of the production pipeline. Character and environment sprite art was created using AI image generation, then processed, edited, and integrated by hand. Portions of the game's code were written with AI assistance under the developer's direction, with all systems designed, reviewed, and tested by the developer. All AI-generated content is created during development ("pre-generated") — the game does not generate any content while you play, and no AI runs on your machine. Game design, writing, and all creative decisions are the work of the developer.

a.sum: Chrome Circuit uses AI for character and environment sprite art (generated during development, then edited by hand) and for some code written with AI assistance under the developer's direction. All AI content is pre-generated; the game generates no content during play and runs no AI locally. Design, writing, and creative decisions are the developer's.

games.raw: As an indie dev, I leveraged AI to create this game. Some voices are AI-generated. Concept art was generated for inspiration and then built from scratch.

a.sum: Developer declares AI use: some voices are AI-generated, and concept art was AI-generated for inspiration but the final art was built from scratch. No runtime or live generation is mentioned.

games.raw: This title utilizes generative AI in the creation of event CGs, character and background artwork, store-page portraits, marketing materials, character voices, and pre-rendered content used in the first part of the game. All AI-generated assets have been selected and edited by humans to ensure that they do not infringe on third-party rights, impersonate real-life individuals, contain illegal content, or feature prohibited sexual material. No content is generated live by AI during actual gameplay.

a.sum: The developer declares generative AI use for pre-generated event CGs, character and background artwork, store-page portraits, marketing materials, character voices, and pre-rendered content in the first part of the game. Humans selected and edited all AI assets for rights, impersonation, illegal, and prohibited-sexual-content concerns. No content is generated live during gameplay.

games.raw: No AI was used to create the artwork, animation, or sound effects. All of it is made by human hands. The game's English text is almost completely written by my hand. The other supported languages are partially AI-translated from my English source. Native-speaker review is ongoing, and corrected translations ship in updates. The soundtrack is original music that I've written over the last 30 years. I used AI to produce the final compositions.

a.sum: AI was used for partial translation of the non-English languages from the developer's English source, with native-speaker review ongoing and corrected translations shipping in updates. AI was also used to produce the final soundtrack compositions from the developer's own music. Artwork, animation, sound effects, and English text are stated to be human-made.

games.raw: Generative AI was used during development to create some visual artwork and background music. The generated content was reviewed by the development team before being included in the game. The game does not generate AI content during gameplay.

a.sum: Developer used generative AI during development to create some visual artwork and background music. The team reviewed the output before inclusion. No AI content is generated during gameplay. The specific placement of the artwork (store, in-game, or other) is not stated.

games.raw: Generative AI was used to assist in creating certain environmental textures, decorative artwork, and promotional materials. All gameplay systems, programming, level design, puzzles, story, and core game content were created by the developer and manually integrated into the game
