The game does not use live-generated AI during gameplay.

a.sum: Generative AI was used during development to create some pre-generated visual assets: selected skill and weapon icons (in-game art), concept references (other), and promotional art references (marketing). The team reviewed, curated, edited, and integrated all final assets. The game does not use live-generated AI during gameplay.

games.raw: Generative AI was used strictly to create temporary concept art and placeholder assets during early development. All of these placeholders are being systematically replaced with custom or commissioned assets prior to the game's final release.

a.sum: Generative AI was used only for temporary concept art and placeholder assets during early development. These are being replaced with custom or commissioned assets before final release. No live or in-game generated content is described.

games.raw: All content in this game was created by a single developer using generative AI tools, under full human supervision. The scenario and script were written by the developer (writing assistance: Claude). All theme song lyrics were written by the developer. Backgrounds, character sprites, the logo, and the OP/ED movies were generated with Leonardo AI, based on the developer's own character designs, compositions, and art direction. The music and theme songs were produced with Suno AI. All voice acting was generated with ElevenLabs; every line in all three languages (Japanese, English, and Simplified Chinese, approx. 1,900 lines each) was individually reviewed by the developer for pronunciation, acting, and emotional delivery, and only approved takes were used. Localization was assisted by Claude Code, with every translation reviewed by the developer. Programming was assisted by Claude Code. The store page and marketing assets (capsule images, logo, trailers, etc.) were likewise created with Leonardo AI (imagery) and Suno AI (music). Screenshots and trailer footage are captures of the actual game (the game itself contains the AI-generated assets described above). Every AI-generated asset was reviewed, selected, and corrected by the developer before use. No content is generated by AI at runtime. A breakdown of tools by production stage is included in the end credits.

a.sum: Developer discloses extensive generative AI use, all pre-generated with no runtime generation. Leonardo AI made backgrounds, character sprites, logo, OP/ED movies, and store/marketing imagery. Suno AI made music, theme songs, and marketing music. ElevenLabs made all voice acting in three languages. Claude assisted with script writing, localization, and programming (Claude Code). The developer wrote theme lyrics and reviewed and corrected all AI output.

games.raw: Capy of Gods is built on the work of 22 independent pixel artists. Most of the enemies, bosses, weapons, effects and traps come from asset packs purchased on itch.io from creators like Admurin, Clembod, elesrech, Fellor, GandalfHardcore, Penusbmic and many more. Full credits are listed in the game. As a solo developer, I used generative AI as a supplementary tool to create original content not covered by those asset packs, including some sprites, item icons, illustrations, sounds, and translations into languages beyond English and Spanish. Every AI-assisted visual was reviewed and repainted by hand to match the overall artistic style and my vision for the game. Nothing is generated while you play.

a.sum: Developer declares supplementary generative AI use for original sprites, item icons, illustrations, sounds, and translations beyond English and Spanish. AI visuals were reviewed and repainted by hand. Most art comes from credited human-made asset packs. Nothing is generated during gameplay.

games.raw: Generative AI tools were used during development to create and manually refine some illustrations, store page artwork, and music tracks, as well as to assist with text preparation and localization. The game does not generate any AI content in real time.

a.sum: Generative AI was used during development to create and manually refine some illustrations, store page artwork, and music tracks, and to assist with text preparation and localization. The game generates no AI content in real time.

games.raw: Some images are AI generated

a.sum: The developer discloses that some images in the game are AI generated. The disclosure does not say which images, where they appear, or whether they are pre-generated or generated live.

games.raw: Some of the images on our store page were created by artificial intelligence and edits were made on the images.

a.sum: The developer discloses that some store page images were created by AI and then edited by hand. Only store page art is mentioned, and the images are presented as created before publication.

games.raw: Generative AI tools were used during development to assist with visual assets, in-game text, localization, and programming. All AI-assisted content was reviewed, edited, tested, and integrated by the developer. No generative AI is used while the game is running.

a.sum: Generative AI was used during development for visual assets, in-game text, localization, and programming. The developer reviewed, edited, tested, and integrated all AI-assisted content. No generative AI runs while the game is running.

games.raw: We use pre-generated AI imagery for some visual elements, like card textures, backgrounds, and store page graphics. The game does not generate any AI content in real-time. However, the doodles you see on the desk are 100% hand-drawn by the developer's child!

a.sum: The developer discloses pre-generated AI imagery for card textures, backgrounds, and store page graphics. The game generates no AI content in real time. Desk doodles are stated to be hand-drawn by the developer's child and are not AI.

games.raw: I know AI in game development is a sensitive topic, so I want to be upfront: as a solo developer, I couldn't have brought this idea to life without it. Lanelord is still a passion project, designed by me. Every idea and every decision came from a human. Some icons and 3D assets were generated by scripts in Blender, GIMP and Python. AI helped write those scripts; I directed and approved every result. No AI image generators were used for anything in the game.

a.sum: AI helped write Blender, GIMP, and Python scripts that generated some icons and 3D assets, which the developer directed and approved. No AI image generators were used, and no live AI generation is described.

games.raw: Some content was created with the help of AI tools during development: translations of the UI and story texts into additional languages, and some store/promotional images and icons. No content is generated by AI while the game is running.

a.sum: AI tools were used during development to translate UI and story text into additional languages and to create some store/promotional images and icons. The developer states no content is generated by AI while the game runs.

games.raw: Generative AI is used solely to assist with localization and translation work. The game does not use AI-generated art, audio, or real-time in-game content.

a.sum: Generative AI is used only for localization and translation. The developer states the game has no AI-generated art, audio, or real-time in-game content.

games.raw: The game's artwork (chapter illustrations, ending vignettes, and store art) was pre-generated using generative AI tools and then curated, edited, and composited by the team. The in-game backgrounds, the title screen and the paper the letters are set on were made the same way. The narrative was written with substantial AI assistance under human direction and editorial review. The music was generated with AI tools; ambience and effects are recorded sound. games.raw: Generative AI tools were used to create the game's visual assets: character portraits, event illustrations, region artwork and some store-page imagery. AI also assisted with part of the localization (translations into several of the supported languages) and some promotional text. The game's design, systems, code and original writing were created by the developer; all AI-assisted output was reviewed, selected and edited by a human. The game does not generate any content at runtime.

A human reviewed, selected, and edited all AI output. Design, systems, code, and original writing are human-made. The game generates no content at runtime.

games.raw: Veyrasol uses generative AI tools as part of its art pipeline. Both 3D models and 2D artwork used in the game (illustrations, backgrounds, UI and unit icons), as well as store page and marketing graphics such as capsule images and banners, were created with the help of generative AI tools and then reviewed, edited and assembled by the developer. Generative AI tools were also used to help write parts of the marketing website and store page copy. The core game (engine, server logic, real-time combat, and systems) is hand-coded by the developer, and no content is generated by AI at runtime during play.

a.sum: Generative AI was used to create 3D models, 2D art (illustrations, backgrounds, UI, unit icons), store and marketing graphics, and some marketing website and store copy. The developer reviewed, edited, and assembled these assets. The core game code is hand-coded, and no content is generated at runtime.

AI-generated or AI-assisted outputs were reviewed and edited by the developer before being included in the final game.

All AI or AI-assisted outputs were reviewed and edited before inclusion in the final game, so the content is pre-generated, with no live generation described.

All AI-assisted output is reviewed and edited by a human developer, and we have taken steps to ensure it does not include infringing or illegal content.

games.raw: About Generative AI This game used generative AI during development to help create some visual assets. All assets were reviewed, edited, and shipped as pre-made files before release—in the game and on the store page. What AI was used for Character portraits, expression variants, and NPC art Some CG illustrations and background art Some Steam store capsules, library images, and marketing graphics What AI was not used for No images or story are generated live while you play Dialogue, events, and localization were written and proofread by the development team—not produced dynamically by AI during gameplay How it was made Art was generated on the developer’s machine using image-generation tools (SwarmUI / Z-Image Turbo), guided by fixed style and character prompts. Outputs were manually selected and post-processed (e.g. cutout, compositing, resizing) before import into the Godot project. Your copy contains fixed assets only; gameplay does not trigger new AI generation. If you prefer to judge the visual style first, please review the screenshots and trailer on this store page.

a.sum: AI image generation (SwarmUI / Z-Image Turbo) was used to pre-make in-game art (character portraits, expression variants, NPC art, CG illustrations, backgrounds) and store/marketing graphics. Outputs were manually selected and edited, and shipped as fixed files. No live AI generation occurs during play. Dialogue, narrative, events, and localization were written by the team, not AI.

games.raw: Greenrise includes a small amount of AI-assisted content created during development (pre-generated): one sound effect and one visual asset were made with the help of generative AI tools. Generative AI was also used to help review and verify the game's localization. The game does not generate any AI content live at runtime. We hold the rights to use this content and it does not infringe on any third-party intellectual property.

a.sum: Greenrise discloses pre-generated AI-assisted content made during development: one sound effect and one visual asset created with generative AI tools, plus generative AI used to review and verify localization. No AI content is generated live at runtime. The developer states they hold rights to the content and it does not infringe third-party IP.

games.raw: Kaironia uses generative AI tools during the development process to create pre-rendered assets. None of these assets are generated dynamically or live during gameplay.

games.raw: The game's period artwork was created with OpenAI's image generation: character portraits, the document plates and photographs on the desk, the paper stocks and document chrome the pages are printed on, and the background textures behind the game. I directed and reviewed every image, checked each one several times and edited it where needed. The store page art is composited from the same artwork. The game's written content, meaning the documents the player searches and reads and the text of the interface, was written with the help of large language models under my direction. I read and checked every text several times and edited it where needed before it entered the game. No text is generated while the game runs. Sound effects and the ambient bed are produced by a deterministic synthesis program (oscillators, filtered noise and math-based DSP), not by a generative-AI audio model and from no sampled or library audio. Fonts, engine and runtime are non-AI third-party components under their own licenses (see THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt).

a.sum: Pre-generated AI use only. OpenAI image generation produced the character portraits, document plates and photographs, paper stocks and document chrome, and background textures, and the store page art is composited from them. LLM-assisted writing, under the developer's direction, produced the in-game documents and interface text. No content is generated at runtime. Sound effects and the ambient bed come from a deterministic non-AI synthesis program. Fonts, engine and runtime are non-AI third-party components.

games.raw: Don't worry, this game is made by an experienced developer. It's fun and good quality. Give it a try! That being said: AI was used to facilitate development. For example: it was used to facilitate coding, writing, and making steam assets.

games.raw: Generative AI was used during development to create content that ships in this game. The in-game 2D visual assets and the 2D upgrade and ability icons began as generated images. They are placeholder art: the developer edited them by hand in Aseprite and reworked them in bulk with custom scripts, and intends to replace them with work commissioned from human artists. Part of the sound-effect library was generated; the remainder is procedurally synthesized by the developer's own scripts. The music cues in the soundtrack were generated, then edited and mastered by the developer. The in-game text in the ten non-English languages began as machine translation and is being corrected from player reports as they arrive. Generative AI was also used for voice-over audio in some older promotional videos. All generated outputs were reviewed, selected, edited, and integrated by the developer. Game design, progression, balance, and code direction are the developer's own work; AI coding assistants were used as development tools only. The game does not use live generative AI and does not generate content at runtime.

a.sum: Generative AI produced pre-shipped content: placeholder 2D art and upgrade/ability icons (hand-edited, to be replaced by commissioned art), part of the sound-effect library, music cues (edited and mastered by the developer), machine-translated in-game text in ten languages (being corrected from player reports), and voice-over in some older promotional videos. All outputs were reviewed and edited by the developer. Design, code direction, and balance are the developer's own work. The game uses no live generative AI and generates no content at runtime.

a.sum: The game uses a locally run, offline Large Language Model to parse player text input and generate replies at runtime. The developer states that all artwork, music, sound effects, and pre-written narrative are human-created, and that generative AI is not used for visual or audio assets.

games.raw: Including AI-generated content

a.sum: The developer states the game includes AI-generated content but gives no details on what content, how it was generated, or whether it is generated live.

games.raw: AI tools were used to create or modify some steam store artwork and the game logo, and assist with localization.

a.sum: The developer discloses AI tools used to create or modify Steam store artwork and the game logo, and to assist with localization. No live or in-game generated content is mentioned.

games.raw: These translations were generated with the help of AI. As an indie developer, I currently don't have the budget to hire professional translators, but I hope to do so in the future.

a.sum: The developer discloses that the game's translations were generated with AI assistance because they lack the budget for professional translators, and they plan to hire translators in the future. The text does not say whether the translated content is pre-generated or generated live.

games.raw: Translations.

a.sum: The input is only the word 'Translations' with no disclosure text. No AI use is declared, and no generation type or usage scope can be determined.

games.raw: The art, audio, and writing in Refund Speedrun are created by hand. Generative AI was used only for the voice-over narration in our promotional teaser trailer (ElevenLabs). The game does not generate any content using AI at runtime.

a.sum: Generative AI (ElevenLabs) was used only for voice-over narration in the promotional teaser trailer. All art, audio, and writing in the game are stated to be hand-made, and the game generates no content with AI at runtime.

games.raw: The pictures in the journal are created by AI.

a.sum: The developer states that the pictures in the journal were created by AI. The text does not say whether the images are pre-generated or generated live during play.

games.raw: AI tools were used to assist with code, art, and sfx. Every element was manually edited and polished by hand.

a.sum: The developer says AI tools assisted with code, art, and sound effects, and that all elements were manually edited and polished by hand. The disclosure does not say whether content was pre-generated or generated live, and does not specify where the art is used.

games.raw: The game's 2D artwork, including card and unit illustrations, worker portraits, and store assets, was generated with AI image tools and then reviewed, selected, and edited by the developer. Parts of the in-game text and localizations were also written with AI assistance. The game does not generate any content with AI at runtime.

a.sum: AI image tools generated the 2D artwork (card and unit illustrations, worker portraits, store assets), which the developer reviewed, selected, and edited. AI assisted in writing parts of the in-game text and localizations. No content is generated with AI at runtime.

games.raw: I'm a solo artist working on this project. So I used IA mostly for coding.

a.sum: Developer, a solo artist, states AI was used mostly for coding. No other uses, generation timing, or live-generated content are mentioned.

games.raw: During development, AI-assisted tools were used to support code and content creation. However the final resulting player experience directly represents the artistic vision and creative input of the developer.

a.sum: Developer says AI-assisted tools were used during development to support code and content creation. The text does not specify which content types were affected or whether any content is generated during play. It states the final player experience reflects the developer's artistic vision.

games.raw: Generative AI tools were used to assist in the creation of some 2D visual assets and artwork (including character illustrations and background art). All generated assets have been reviewed and refined to fit the game's pixel art style and quality standards.

a.sum: The developer used generative AI tools to help create some 2D visual assets, including character illustrations and background art. The generated assets were reviewed and refined to match the game's pixel art style. No live or runtime generation is mentioned.

games.raw: Generative AI helped with the 2D illustrations, some sound effects and the first pass of the translations. Nothing else, and nothing while you play.

a.sum: Developer discloses generative AI for 2D illustrations (no placement specified, mapped to 'other'), some sound effects, and a first-pass translation. States no other uses and no AI generation during gameplay.

games.raw: Generative AI tools were used in the development of this game and for some of the art. All of the music was composed, performed, and recorded by a musician exclusively for this game.

a.sum: The developer declares generative AI tools were used in development and for some art, with no specific art types or generation timing stated. All music was human-composed, performed, and recorded for the game, so music is not AI-generated.

games.raw: We used generative AI tools to make this game. They helped write its code, including the code that generates its music and many of its sounds, helped make much of its artwork, and wrote this store page. One person directed all of it, decided what the game is and how it plays, and judged the results by playing the game: keeping what worked, throwing out what didn't. No generative AI runs in the game itself. Nothing is generated while you play.

a.sum: Generative AI helped write the game's code (including music- and sound-generating code), helped make much of the artwork (scope not specified), and wrote the store page text. Content was produced during development. No generative AI runs in the game, and nothing is generated during play.

games.raw: I built Orbisphere as a solo developer using AI tools under human direction. The soundtrack was created with generative AI music tools, with each track directed, selected, and edited by me. In-game vector artwork was authored with AI assistance from my terrible MS Paint references and designs. All game design, writing, systems, and balance are my own work.

a.sum: Orbisphere's soundtrack was created with generative AI music tools and then directed, selected, and edited by the solo developer. In-game vector artwork was made with AI assistance from the developer's own references and designs. The developer states that game design, writing, systems, and balance are their own work. The disclosure does not mention any content generated during gameplay.

games.raw: Song of Larithea is made by a solo developer using generative AI across the pipeline: the artwork is AI-generated and then hand-edited in Photoshop, and the voice lines, music, and sound are AI-generated as well. The story is the author's own, adapted from her own novel, with AI helping polish the English text. The game ships in English, Russian and Simplified Chinese; both translations are AI-generated. Art, voice, music, and sound are reviewed, corrected, and finished by hand before they ship.

a.sum: Solo developer declares generative AI across the pipeline: artwork is AI-generated and hand-edited in Photoshop; voice lines, music, and sound are AI-generated. The story is the author's own, with AI polishing the English text. English, Russian, and Simplified Chinese translations are AI-generated. All art, voice, music, and sound are reviewed and finished by hand before shipping, so content is pre-generated rather than live.

games.raw: I'm the only developer on The Fixer. The 928 2D images (portraits, scenes, stadiums, events) were made with AI image tools, then I selected and adjusted each one against fixed references. The 59 music tracks and 34 sound effects came from AI audio tools, picked and tuned by me. Code and narrative text were written with AI assistance under my direction: I set the rules, balanced the game, rewrote the text, and validated it all by playing. The EN, ES and IT translations are AI-assisted and proofread. Everything is produced during development: nothing is generated by AI while you play.

a.sum: AI was used during development, not at runtime. 928 2D images (portraits, scenes, stadiums, events) were AI-generated and hand-adjusted; 59 music tracks and 34 sound effects came from AI audio tools and were selected and tuned by the developer. Code and narrative text were AI-assisted under the developer's direction and rewritten or validated by them. EN, ES, and IT translations are AI-assisted and proofread. Nothing is generated by AI during play.

games.raw: Pixellab was used to generate some art assets. Claude code was used for backend development.

a.sum: Developer discloses AI use: Pixellab generated some unspecified art assets, and Claude Code was used for backend development. The disclosure does not say whether generation was pre-generated or live.

games.raw: Some of the buildings, characters, and hiding objects in the game’s maps were generated using AI.

a.sum: The developer discloses that some buildings, characters, and hiding objects in the game's maps were generated using AI. The disclosure does not say whether this content is pre-generated or generated live during play.

games.raw: Some of the game's visual assets were created with the assistance of generative AI. Part of the written content, including event text and quest descriptions, was also created with the assistance of generative AI. All generated content is reviewed, edited, refined, and adapted by me to maintain a consistent visual identity and ensure that it matches the game's artistic direction and design choices. Using AI-assisted tools is what allows me to keep developing the game, speed up production, and bring it to players sooner while preserving a cohesive and recognizable style. No AI generation happens during gameplay. All content is fixed at build time.

a.sum: The developer used generative AI, with human review and editing, for some visual assets (unspecified which) and for written content such as event text and quest descriptions. No AI generation happens during gameplay; all content is fixed at build time.

games.raw: During our creative processes, we may use modern digital tools that include AI-based features to assist with content creation, such as language translation or voice acting. This helps us stay innovative without losing sight of what makes our games truly unique, while ensuring the final product preserves the distinctive style and quality our development team strives for.

a.sum: The developer says they 'may use' modern digital tools with AI-based features to assist content creation, citing language translation and voice acting as examples. The use is hedged, not confirmed, and the text does not say whether content is pre-generated or live-generated, or which specific assets are affected.

games.raw: Some store visuals, in-game icons, sound effects, and music were created with the assistance of artificial intelligence.

a.sum: Developer discloses AI assistance for store visuals, in-game icons, sound effects, and music. No mention of live or runtime generation.

games.raw: The developer used generative AI as a tool during development. Store page and marketing copy was drafted with an AI writing assistant and edited by the developer. All artwork, logos, and screenshots are human-created or captured from real gameplay. The game does not use generative AI to create any content live during play all in-game text, events, and outcomes come from the developer's own hand-authored, deterministic systems. All AI-assisted content is reviewed by the developer before release.

a.sum: The developer declares generative AI use as a development tool, limited to drafting store page and marketing copy with an AI writing assistant, which the developer then edited. Artwork, logos, and screenshots are stated to be human-created or captured from gameplay. No live generation occurs during play; in-game text, events, and outcomes are hand-authored deterministic systems. All AI-assisted content is reviewed by the developer before release.

games.raw: Some 2D art assets (vehicle icons, map symbols, UI iconography), some in-game text and some translations were created with AI assistance.

a.sum: AI assistance was used to create some 2D art assets (vehicle icons, map symbols, UI iconography), some in-game text, and some translations. No live or runtime generation is mentioned.

games.raw: Some of the content in Dawnheart Keepers was created with the help of generative AI tools during development. All of it was made before release: the game does not generate anything with AI while you play, and it never connects to an AI service. What that covers: - Illustrated art - menu and story backgrounds, story scenes, the world map, character and tower portraits, and the upgrade-card plates - was made with image-generation models run locally on the developer's own machine, from prompts the developer wrote. - The English and Hebrew voice-over was generated with ElevenLabs from scripts written by the developer. - Sound effects were generated from written prompts, or synthesised procedurally in code. All of it was reviewed, edited, curated and tested by the developer before it shipped, and the same applies to the trailer and store art. The music is not AI-generated. It is written as code and synthesised by the game itself while you play, the way game soundtracks were built before recorded audio.

a.sum: AI was used before release for illustrated in-game art, store art, the trailer, English and Hebrew voice-over (ElevenLabs), and some sound effects. Nothing is generated by AI during play, and the game never connects to an AI service. The music is not AI-generated; it is code-synthesised by the game at runtime.

games.raw: Some cosmetic cat skins and visual assets were created with the assistance of generative AI tools. All final assets are manually reviewed, edited, and integrated by the developer. The game does not generate AI content during gameplay.

a.sum: Generative AI was used to assist creation of some cosmetic cat skins and visual assets. The developer manually reviews, edits, and integrates all final assets. The game does not generate AI content during gameplay.

games.raw: The game does not contain AI-generated content. AI-generated content is used just for Steam cover.

a.sum: The developer states the game contains no AI-generated content. AI-generated content is used only for the Steam cover (store art). The disclosure does not say whether that cover art was pre-generated or live-generated.

games.raw: Some of the user interfaces were generated using AI; the reason for this is that I am not a graphic designer myself and cannot afford to hire a service provider to create them.

a.sum: The developer declares that some user interfaces were generated using AI because they are not a graphic designer and cannot afford to hire one. The disclosure does not say whether the content is pre-generated or live.

games.raw: Development Toolchain developed by AI with human guided R&D. The engine and all game code are hand-written (custom C++ engine, no third-party game engine). 2D graphical assets — character, NPC, and enemy art, portraits, environment and UI artwork — and the pre-rendered cinematic videos were created using locally-run AI image/video generation tools trained on our own styles, then manually reviewed, edited, and integrated by the developer. All AI content was pre-generated during development; nothing is generated by AI at runtime.

a.sum: Developer declares AI use for 2D art (character, NPC, enemy, portraits, environment, UI) and pre-rendered cinematic videos, made with locally run AI image/video tools trained on their own styles and then manually edited. The engine and game code are hand-written. A development toolchain was 'developed by AI with human guided R&D.' All AI content is pre-generated, with nothing generated at runtime.

games.raw: In this game, the developer uses AI tools in the creation of the following pre-generated content that players see: 1. Artwork: Image assets and promotional materials. 2. Text: In-game text, store page descriptions, and their multilingual translations.

a.sum: The developer discloses AI use for pre-generated content players see: image assets and promotional artwork, and in-game text, store page descriptions, and their multilingual translations. Live or runtime generation is not mentioned.

games.raw: The game features AI-assisted German, French, and Italian localization. If you are fluent in any of these languages and would like to help translate the game, feel free to reach out to contact@dancraa.com!

a.sum: The developer discloses AI-assisted localization into German, French, and Italian. The text does not say whether the AI output is pre-generated or live, and it does not mention other AI use. It also invites fluent speakers to help with translation.

games.raw: Some of this game's shipped assets were created with the assistance of generative AI tools, all reviewed and curated by our team: 3D models and their textures (generated from our team's original concept designs), 2D illustrations and UI artwork, music and sound effects, and AI-assisted translations of in-game text for some supported languages. All AI-generated assets are used under commercial licenses with full usage rights. No content is generated while the game is running, and the game does not connect to any external AI service.

a.sum: The developer discloses generative AI use for pre-generated shipped assets, all reviewed by the team: 3D models and textures (based on the team's original concepts), 2D illustrations and UI art, music and sound effects, and AI-assisted translations for some languages. No content is generated at runtime, and the game does not connect to an external AI service.

games.raw: Syncline is developed by me — AI tools were used to assist with parts of development, including code, some text content (UI copy, tutorial hints, level descriptions, store page copy), localization/translations, and some audio. All such content was directed by me and reviewed/edited before being included. No content is generated by AI at runtime — everything players see, hear, and play is fixed at build time.

a.sum: AI assisted development of Syncline in code, text (UI copy, tutorial hints, level descriptions, store page copy), localization/translations, and some unspecified audio. The developer directed and reviewed all AI output. No content is generated at runtime; everything is fixed at build time.

games.raw: Generative AI tools were used during development to assist with some pre-generated 2D artwork and UI imagery, 3D models and animations, instrumental music and sound effects, localization drafts, and portions of the game code. As a two-person team, we selected, edited, integrated, and reviewed all of these outputs before inclusion. The game does not generate content at runtime and does not send player input to generative AI services.

a.sum: Generative AI was used during development, before release, for some 2D artwork and UI imagery, 3D models and animations, instrumental music, sound effects, localization drafts, and portions of code. The developers selected, edited, integrated, and reviewed all outputs. The game does not generate content at runtime or send player input to generative AI services.

games.raw: AI tools were used during development solely for asset optimization and text proofreading.

a.sum: The developer discloses AI use during development only, for asset optimization (not specified which assets) and text proofreading. No content generation or live AI-generated content is described.

games.raw: AI has been used during the development of Blokkit to accelerate the process of writing code, creating some assets for the store page, and for writing translations into 7 different languages,

a.sum: AI was used during development to help write code, create some store page assets, and write translations into 7 languages. No live or in-game generation is mentioned.

games.raw: Generative AI tools were used during development to assist with portions of the game’s code and to create or refine some pre-rendered 2D artwork, including character sprites and portraits, item icons, and environment assets. All AI-assisted content was reviewed, edited, and integrated by the developer. The game does not generate AI content or code during gameplay and does not connect to an external AI service during gameplay.

a.sum: The developer used generative AI during development to assist with some game code and to create or refine pre-rendered 2D art, including character sprites and portraits, item icons, and environment assets. The developer reviewed, edited, and integrated all AI-assisted content. The game does not generate AI content or code during gameplay and does not connect to an external AI service during gameplay.

games.raw: AI was used in development of the game

a.sum: Developer discloses that AI was used in development of the game. No specific usage areas or whether content is pre-generated or generated live are stated.

games.raw: Includes AI and handcrafted artwork and audio

a.sum: The developer states the game includes both AI-generated and handcrafted artwork and audio. The disclosure does not specify which assets are AI-generated, whether generation happens before release or at runtime, or whether any content is generated live.

games.raw: Generative AI was used to assist in creating certain decorative user interface elements, and background graphics. All gameplay systems, mechanics, programming, game design, and core game content were created and curated by the development team.

a.sum: Generative AI assisted in creating decorative UI elements and background graphics. Gameplay systems, mechanics, programming, game design, and core content were made by the development team. The disclosure does not say whether AI output is pre-generated or live.

games.raw: This game includes AI-generated background music, used under a commercial license. Some of the translations into the available languages ​​were produced with the help of AI.

a.sum: Discloses AI-generated background music used under a commercial license, and AI-assisted translations into some available languages. The text does not say whether either is pre-generated or generated live during play.

games.raw: Generative AI tools were used during development to create pre-generated 2D visual assets included in the game. These assets may include character, item, environment, and user interface artwork. All AI-generated assets are reviewed, selected, and adjusted by the developer before being included in the game. The game does not use generative AI during runtime and does not connect to any live generative AI service.

a.sum: Generative AI was used during development to create pre-generated 2D visual assets (character, item, environment, and UI artwork) included in the game. The developer reviews, selects, and adjusts these assets. The game uses no generative AI at runtime and connects to no live generative AI service.

games.raw: To create realistic interrogation scenarios in this detective game, this game packages a local, offline LLM to serve as the brain of the NPC suspects. This allows the user to lead the investigation however they like. Generative AI was NOT used to create this game, but an LLM is featured as a main game mechanic in the form of freeform NPC conversation.

a.sum: Game does not use generative AI to create its assets. It packages a local, offline LLM that generates NPC suspect dialogue live during freeform interrogations.

games.raw: Generative AI tools were used during development to assist with portions of the game’s code, including implementation, debugging, refactoring, and testing. The resulting code was reviewed, edited, integrated, and tested before inclusion in the shipped build. The game does not contain a generative AI model, does not connect to a generative AI service, does not accept player prompts, and does not generate code or other AI content while running.

a.sum: Generative AI tools assisted development of game code (implementation, debugging, refactoring, testing). Developers reviewed, edited, integrated, and tested the output. The shipped game contains no generative AI model, does not connect to AI services, accepts no player prompts, and generates no AI content at runtime.

games.raw: 2d sprites

a.sum: The text only mentions '2d sprites' and does not state that AI was used to create them or any other content. No AI generation is declared.

games.raw: We use generative AI tools in the process of creating music and some of the illustrations.

a.sum: The developer discloses using generative AI tools to create music and some illustrations. The disclosure does not say where the illustrations appear, and it does not mention any live or runtime generated content.

games.raw: Generative AI tools were used during development to assist with creating and refining some pre-generated artwork and other media assets, including assets used in the game and on its Steam store page. All AI-assisted content was reviewed, edited, and integrated by the developer. The game does not generate AI content during gameplay or connect to external AI services.

a.sum: The developer used generative AI during development to help create and refine some pre-generated artwork and other media assets, used both in the game and on its Steam store page. The developer reviewed, edited, and integrated all AI-assisted content. The game generates no AI content during gameplay and does not connect to external AI services.

games.raw: Some images and translations used in the game and its marketing materials were created or assisted using generative AI tools only when necessary. The majority of the assets were created by human artists and contributors. All AI-assisted content was reviewed and integrated by the development team before inclusion.

a.sum: Developer discloses that some images and translations in the game and its marketing were created or assisted by generative AI, used only when necessary. Most assets are human-made, and the team reviewed and integrated all AI-assisted content before release. No runtime generation is mentioned.

games.raw: Generative AI was used to assist in creating selected pre-rendered visual assets for marketing. Star Claw does not generate content using AI while the game is running.

a.sum: Generative AI was used to help create selected pre-rendered visual assets for marketing. The developer states the game does not generate any content with AI while running.

games.raw: Submundus is made by one person. Generative AI is used in asset production: 3D models are generated from concept art, then rigged, animated and corrected by hand; music and sound effects are generated, then edited and mixed; key art is generated, then composed manually. Game design, systems, writing and balancing are authored by the developer.

a.sum: Generative AI is used before release for 3D models (generated from concept art, then hand-rigged, animated and corrected), music and sound effects (generated, then edited and mixed), and key art (generated, then manually composed). Game design, systems, writing and balancing are authored by the developer. No runtime generation is mentioned.

games.raw: Symbiosis: Criticality uses generative AI in content that ships with the game. Visual assets, audio, and written material (including in-game text and store page copy) were produced with generative AI tools and then selected, edited, and integrated by hand. All game design, balance, and final decisions are mine. Development also used AI coding assistants, working from specifications and balance targets I set and tested. I am a solo developer and I would rather state this plainly up front.

a.sum: Declares generative AI use in shipped content: visual assets, audio, and written material (in-game text and store page copy), all generated with AI tools, then selected, edited, and integrated by hand. AI coding assistants were also used for development, working from the developer's specifications. No runtime or live generation is mentioned. Audio is not broken down by type.

games.raw: A small amount of artwork, the soundtrack, and voiceovers were generated with AI.

a.sum: The developer discloses AI use for a small amount of artwork, the soundtrack, and voiceovers. The artwork is not specified further, and the text does not say whether content is pre-generated or generated live.

games.raw: Generative AI was used during development to assist with some visual assets, text and localization, and code. All AI-assisted content included in the game and its marketing materials was reviewed and edited by the developer. The game does not generate AI content during gameplay and does not connect to external AI services.

a.sum: The developer used generative AI during development for some visual assets, text and localization, and code. AI-assisted content in the game and its marketing materials was reviewed and edited by the developer. The game does not generate AI content during gameplay and does not connect to external AI services.

games.raw: AI tools were used during development for programming assistance, and multilingual localization.

a.sum: AI tools were used during development for programming assistance (code) and multilingual localization. The disclosure does not say whether the generated output was pre-generated or live, and it does not mention live-generated content.

games.raw: This is a solo-developed game. The in-game voice lines were generated with an AI text-to-speech tool, then edited and remixed by the developer. AI tools also assisted with translating the store page and in-game text. Game design, code, art and audio are otherwise the developer's own work. No AI content is generated at runtime.

a.sum: AI text-to-speech generated the in-game voice lines, which the developer then edited and remixed. AI tools assisted with translating the store page and in-game text. Game design, code, art, and other audio are stated as the developer's own work. No AI content is generated at runtime.

games.raw: Some art is AI and all of the localization.

a.sum: Developer discloses that some art is AI-generated and all localization is AI-generated. The art category is not specified further, and the text does not say whether generation is pre-generated or live.

games.raw: Many of the world's objects are generated images

a.sum: The developer states that many of the game world's objects are generated images. The text does not say whether 'generated' means AI, when generation happens (pre-release or live), or which tools were used.

games.raw: Generative AI tools were used during development to assist in creating some pre-generated promotional artwork and 2D art assets. No AI-generated content is created during gameplay.

a.sum: The developer used generative AI during development to help create some pre-generated promotional artwork and 2D art assets. The disclosure states no AI-generated content is created during gameplay.

games.raw: Localizations other than Italian are AI-assisted, with human and community review ongoing during development. All game design, writing, and art direction are human-made. A very few assets were modified using AI. Some store assets are made with the help of AI

a.sum: AI is used for localizations other than Italian (AI-assisted, with human and community review ongoing), for some store assets, and for modifying a very few unspecified assets. Game design, writing, and art direction are stated as human-made. No runtime or live generation is mentioned.

games.raw: All AI involvement is pre-generated and human-reviewed: nothing is generated while you play, the game runs no AI models, and it never sends your data anywhere. Specifically, AI was used to draft some static artwork objects, the first-pass translations for non-English languages, and synthesizing the games soundtrack (I'm not a musician and can't afford one). Every sprite, track and translation in the game was directed, reviewed, edited, and approved by an actual person before it went in.

a.sum: AI was used before release, not during play, to draft static artwork objects (sprites), first-pass non-English translations, and the soundtrack. The developer says no AI models run in the game, no data is sent anywhere, and a person directed, reviewed, edited, and approved all AI-assisted content.

games.raw: The 3D models of the cakes were made with AI

a.sum: The developer discloses that the cake 3D models were made with AI. The text does not say whether the content is pre-generated or generated live.

games.raw: Some pre-rendered assets in this game and on its store page, including artwork, music, and sound effects, were created with the assistance of generative AI tools. All AI-assisted content was directed, reviewed, and edited by the developer. No content is generated by AI during gameplay.

a.sum: Some pre-rendered assets, including artwork (in-game and on the store page), music, and sound effects, were made with generative AI assistance. The developer directed, reviewed, and edited all AI-assisted content. The developer states no content is generated by AI during gameplay.

games.raw: Helped find minor coding bugs/issues and coding suggestions.

a.sum: Developer disclosed AI assistance limited to finding minor coding bugs/issues and offering coding suggestions. No generated game content (art, text, audio, etc.) or live-generated content is mentioned.

games.raw: This game uses generative AI in the creation of some graphics, text, and English localization. All AI-generated content has been reviewed and edited by the developer before being used. No generative AI content is created during gameplay.

a.sum: Developer discloses generative AI used for some graphics (specific type unspecified), text, and English localization. All AI content is reviewed and edited by the developer before use. No generative AI runs during gameplay.

games.raw: This game uses pre-generated AI-assisted content during development. AI tools were used to assist with the creation of certain visual assets and early concept artwork. All AI-generated content has been reviewed, edited, and curated by the developer before inclusion in the final game. The game does not use live AI generation during gameplay.

a.sum: The developer declares AI-assisted pre-generated content used during development for certain visual assets and early concept artwork. All such content was reviewed, edited, and curated before inclusion. No live AI generation occurs during gameplay.

games.raw: Tatomic was originally created in 2008 for the first-generation iPhone, with artwork designed for its 480 × 320 display. Generative AI was used only to upscale and recreate the original artwork at higher resolutions while preserving the game’s original visual style. No generative AI was used to create the game’s design, gameplay, sound effects, music, or original art direction.

a.sum: Generative AI was used only to upscale and recreate the game's original 2008 artwork at higher resolutions while keeping the original visual style. No generative AI was used for design, gameplay, sound effects, music, or original art direction.

games.raw: The promotional video and the character design of GUGUGAGA is generated by AI.

a.sum: The developer discloses that the promotional video and the character design of GUGUGAGA were generated by AI. The disclosure does not say whether this content is pre-generated or live-generated.

games.raw: No art or sound generation was used. Some help for coding the complex in-game enemy AI interactions were utilized from LLM models. Also the game analysis was made with coding help.

a.sum: The developer declares no AI-generated art or sound. LLM tools were used to help code complex in-game enemy AI interactions, and also to help with the game analysis. The text does not describe any content generated during play.

games.raw: Some card artwork was created with the assistance of generative AI tools. All final assets were manually edited, refined, and integrated.

a.sum: The developer discloses that some card artwork was made with generative AI tools. All final assets were manually edited, refined, and integrated, which suggests pre-generated assets rather than live generation. The text does not state the generation timing explicitly.

games.raw: Ai was used to support humans in developing the code, artwork, various events, music and dialogue in the game. games.raw: Policy on the Use of Generative AI Technology in Our Titles HUGA INC. (hereinafter referred to as "the Company") actively adopts and utilizes generative AI technology—including code assistance tools for development efficiency and image generation—in our titles. This is positioned as part of our development process to pursue new possibilities of artistic expression and high productivity in small-scale indie game development. In utilizing AI technology, the Company strictly adheres to the following compliance and development standards: ■ Compliance with Laws and Intellectual Property Rights Our development process complies with the Copyright Act of Japan (including the provisions for information analysis under Article 30-4) as well as the laws and regulations of relevant countries. Generative AI tools are used strictly within legally permitted boundaries. ■ Adherence to Distribution Platform Guidelines We strictly comply with the disclosure obligations and various guidelines regarding generative AI established by Steam and other distribution platforms, ensuring appropriate information disclosure and proper registration processes. ■ Establishment of Creative Direction as a Proprietary Product All AI-generated assets are integrated into our games only after undergoing our strict creative direction, editing, processing, and reconstruction within the overall game design. Our products do not rely on mere automated output. The Company positions the proactive adoption of new technologies to deliver next-generation entertainment as a core innovation strategy for an indie developer. Please note that while the Company closely monitors the ongoing social and ethical debates surrounding AI technology, we conduct our business lawfully based on current regulations and platform rules. Therefore, we do not issue individual statements or respond to inquiries regarding legal interpretations or related debates. Thank you for your understanding.

games.raw: This game uses pre-generated AI content created during development. All in-game pixel art (characters, monsters, items, terrain, props, effects, and interface) was drawn pixel by pixel by AI coding and writing agents placing pixels under our direction, not by image-generation models, with boss and named-monster designs referencing AI-generated concept images. All large illustrations (the title screens, studio splash card, character-selection portraits, prayer and covenant cut-ins, god portraits, tarot card backs, companion portraits, endings, and credits scenes) and the game's app icon were generated with an AI image model and fitted to the pixel grid and palette by our tools and AI agents. The animated title backgrounds get their motion from AI video generation, and the optional intro video on the title menu is an AI-generated video. All background music was generated with an AI music tool, every sound-effect file and monster cry was generated with an AI sound-effect tool, and remaining sounds are synthesized by code that AI wrote, with no voice acting and no AI voice in the game. Most in-game text was written or drafted by AI, the English, Simplified Chinese, and Japanese translations were done by AI, and most of the game's code was written by AI coding agents that we directed and reviewed. Capsule and key art were made from AI-generated title art, event artwork and most achievement icons come from AI-generated art, store text, event announcements, and patch notes were drafted with AI, and the store trailer features real gameplay footage with AI-generated music and an AI voice narration reading an AI-written script. Plants Game set the direction, chose among candidates, gave feedback, approved every result, and playtested the game, while AI agents and scripts did much of the generation, cleanup, and selection work. Nothing is generated by AI while you play, and the game does not connect to any AI service.

Music, sound effects, and monster cries are AI-generated, and other sounds are AI-written code output. Most in-game text and all translations (English, Simplified Chinese, Japanese) are AI-produced, and most code was written by AI agents. Store capsule and key art, event art, most achievement icons, store text, and patch notes are AI-based. The store trailer uses AI music and an AI voice narration. games.n: A Magical Honor "The Race to Rescue PFC Whiskers"

games.raw: Portions of this game's 2D artwork — character and enemy sprites, item and orb illustrations, backgrounds, UI decoration, and HUD icons — were created with the assistance of image-generation AI (GPT-image-2), working from the developer's own compositions, reference art, and prompts. Every AI-assisted image was individually selected, post-processed, and reviewed by the developer, and is tracked in an internal asset ledger. Store capsule artwork was produced the same way. Store screenshots are unedited captures of actual gameplay. Visual effects are generated procedurally by the developer's own code without AI. The game contains no AI-generated audio or music. Some in-game text was drafted with AI assistance and edited by the developer.

a.sum: Declares AI-assisted 2D art (GPT-image-2) for sprites, item/orb illustrations, backgrounds, UI decoration, HUD icons, and store capsule art, all pre-made, reviewed, and tracked by the developer. Some in-game text was AI-drafted and then edited. No AI audio or music. Screenshots are unedited gameplay and visual effects are procedural without AI. No live-generated content is described.

games.raw: During the development of this game, AI tools were used solely as a coding assistance aid — primarily to help identify and fix minor bugs, and to assist with small code corrections and improvements. AI was not used to generate any content experienced by the player, including visual assets, audio, narrative or in-game text. All artwork, sound, and written content presented to the player are original and human-created. The AI usage disclosed here is limited to development-side coding assistance and does not appear as generated content within the final player-facing experience.

a.sum: AI was used only as a development-side coding assistant to find and fix minor bugs and make small code corrections and improvements. The developer states no AI generated any player-facing content (visual art, audio, narrative, or in-game text), and no live-generated content is disclosed.

games.raw: Some graphical assets and sounds.

games.raw: Mithril uses generative AI in much of its art and audio. games.raw: The Previous Owner uses generative AI as an assistive tool under human art direction and editorial control. The game's painted artwork — scene plates, room and prop textures, character and portrait art, the found photographs, the book spreads and the store art — was pre-generated with generative image tools, then curated, keyed, composited and hand-corrected by the developer; a small number of props are AI-generated 3D meshes, and some looping scene animations are AI-generated video. The shopkeeper's 3D figure is an AI-generated mesh made from her painted character art. Music and sound effects are pre-generated with AI tools and edited by the developer. The narrative text is human–AI co-written under the author's direction and human-edited; the story, its structure and the game design are the author's. Everything ships pre-rendered in the build — the game generates nothing live during play. No real people are depicted; every character, book, photograph and document in the game is fictional.

a.sum: AI is used as an assistive tool under human direction. Pre-generated AI covers painted art (scene plates, textures, portraits, photographs, book spreads, store art), a few AI 3D meshes including the shopkeeper figure, some looping AI video animations, AI music and sound effects, and human-AI co-written narrative that the author edited. Nothing is generated live; all content ships pre-rendered. Characters and documents are fictional.

The game does not generate any content with AI while you play, and it never connects to an external AI service.

No AI-generated images, audio, or video are used; art, animation, and sound are hand-written procedural code. The game generates no AI content during play and never connects to an external AI service.

games.raw: Game AI Content Self-Inspection Report The following items are sorted by the degree of AI assistance, from highest to lowest: 1. Programming & Engineering: I only possess basic programming knowledge and used AI coding tools to assist with writing code snippets. All project planning, feature integration, result verification and iterative testing were completed independently by myself. 2. Art & Visuals: With solid aesthetic judgment and proficiency in AE, TexturePacker, Spine and other asset tools, I independently completed all post-processing work for art resources. Part of the visual assets were AI-generated, then manually screened, redrawn and finely adjusted before implementation. 3. Music & Sound Effects: In-game background music was produced with AI assistance, while all sound effects were manually tuned and finalized by me. 4. Core Gameplay Mechanics: Fully designed, polished and iterated manually with no AI involvement whatsoever. 5. Narrative Content: This is a lightweight story-driven game with zero AI participation in narrative production. 6. System Design: The complete game system architecture, rule logic and iterative optimization were independently developed by me with no AI assistance. All AI-generated assets have undergone manual review, screening and secondary modification, and will never be imported into the game without revision.

a.sum: Developer discloses AI assistance for code snippets, some visual assets (later manually screened and redrawn), and in-game background music. Sound effects, core mechanics, narrative, and system design are stated as manual or non-AI. AI-generated assets are reviewed and modified before import, with no runtime generation mentioned.
