Music and sound effects from Epidemic Sound are licensed third-party audio, not AI-generated.

games.raw: Human solo dev made: writing, music, game design, game production, voice acting, SFX, and basically everything else. In addition, some 3D and VFX asset packs (plus additional SFX) were purchased from third-party marketplaces, where they are explicitly labeled as non-AI, human-made content, and credited in-game. AI usage: AI helped with localization corrections, and was used to refine assets, strictly following human artistic direction and human-made examples — no generation from scratch. Example: Plum's character portraits are in-game mesh screenshots, inserted by me into pre-designed empty icon frames, then refined with AI for a more polished result. Note: I would be happy to replace AI-refined assets with human artist's work, if this becomes financially possible in the future.

a.sum: AI was used before release for localization corrections and for refining human-made assets (e.g., character portraits built from in-game mesh screenshots in pre-designed frames), with no generation from scratch. Writing, music, design, voice, SFX, and most assets are human-made, and purchased 3D/VFX/SFX packs are labeled non-AI. No live or runtime AI generation is declared.

games.n: Roll for Order: Sort Every Set!

games.raw: Parts of the artwork were created with generative AI tools and then retouched by hand: several background illustrations, the title logo, and the store page capsule images. Text outside Japanese — the in-game text in every other language and the store page translations — was produced with the help of AI. Nothing is generated by AI while the game is running.

a.sum: Generative AI was used for several background illustrations, the title logo, and the store page capsule images, all retouched by hand. AI helped produce the in-game text in all languages except Japanese and the store page translations. Nothing is generated by AI while the game runs.

games.raw: Music was created using generative AI tools. The game does not generate any AI content during gameplay.

a.sum: The developer discloses that the game's music was created using generative AI tools. They state the game does not generate any AI content during gameplay, so AI use is limited to pre-generated music.

games.raw: Some of the art in this game was made with the help of generative AI. The voxel character portraits were generated from written prompts using an AI image generator, then cut out, colour-corrected, posed and animated by hand by the developer. The store page capsules and the achievement icons are composed from that same character art. Parts of the store page text, and the game's translations into its eight supported languages, were produced with AI assistance and reviewed by the developer. No generative AI runs while you play — nothing is generated in real time. The patrons' behaviour is ordinary game AI: hand-written rules and probability tables. The music and every sound effect are not AI-generated; they are synthesised procedurally.

a.sum: AI image generation was used for the base voxel character portraits, which the developer then edited by hand. These portraits also feed the store capsules and achievement icons. AI assisted some store page text and the eight-language translations, all reviewed by the developer. No generative AI runs during play. Patron behaviour is hand-written rules and probability tables, and music and sound effects are procedurally synthesised, not AI-generated.

games.raw: No AI content is generated during gameplay, and the game does not connect to external AI services. Generative AI was used during development to create and iterate on selected pre-rendered 2D artwork, environmental textures, decals, and billboard/sign graphics. These assets were selected, edited, processed, and integrated by the developer.

a.sum: Generative AI was used during development to create and iterate on selected pre-rendered 2D artwork, environmental textures, decals, and billboard/sign graphics. The developer selected, edited, processed, and integrated these assets. No AI content is generated during gameplay, and the game does not connect to external AI services.

games.raw: The in-game music and portions of the marketing materials (such as promotional images and text) were generated or assisted using AI. All AI-generated content was reviewed and curated by the developer.

a.sum: The developer discloses AI use for in-game music and for marketing materials, including promotional images and text. The AI output was reviewed and curated by the developer. The disclosure does not mention live or runtime generation, so the content appears pre-generated.

games.raw: The demo's NPCs use a local LLM that runs with the game for chat responses, in addition to prewritten lines. NPCs respond based on their personality, past player interactions, job, location, etc. The game is fully playable with the model disabled. Some audio assets are generated or originated by AI tools.

a.sum: The demo uses a local LLM, shipped with the game, to generate live NPC chat responses shaped by personality, past player interactions, job, and location, alongside prewritten NPC lines. The game is fully playable with the model disabled. Some unspecified audio assets were generated or originated by AI tools.

games.raw: Generative AI tools were used to create visual concepts and initial drafts for most of the game's artwork. These drafts were used as references and starting points for the final pixel art assets, which were manually created, reviewed, edited, and refined by the developer before being included in the game or its marketing materials. Generative AI tools were also used to assist with localization and the creation of some in-game names and text. All AI-assisted text was manually reviewed and edited by the developer before being included in the game. The game does not use generative AI to create content during gameplay.

a.sum: Generative AI was used for visual concepts and initial drafts of most artwork, which the developer manually recreated and refined as final pixel art for the game and marketing. AI also assisted with localization and some in-game names and text, all manually reviewed. The game does not generate content during gameplay.

games.raw: "Our game actively utilizes AI generation technology during the development process to enhance workflow efficiency and visual quality. While AI tools are used to help generate initial concepts and source assets, every single final element goes through extensive, hands-on retouching and polishing by our development team to ensure it meets our quality standards and fits the game seamlessly."

a.sum: The developer discloses using AI generation during development to create initial concepts and source assets. Every final element is said to be extensively retouched and polished by the team. The specific asset types are not named, and no runtime or in-game generation is mentioned.

games.raw: Generative AI was used to assist in creating pre-generated content for the game and its promotional materials, including character artwork, event illustrations, and background music based on the developer's own compositions. It was also used to help draft and localize much of the game's text. All included content was reviewed, edited, and curated by the developer. No content is generated by AI during gameplay. The in-game "AI" game master, Mon, is a fictional character, and all of its dialogue is pre-written.

a.sum: The developer used generative AI to help create pre-generated character artwork, event illustrations, and promotional materials, and to help draft and localize much of the game's text. Background music is based on the developer's own compositions. All AI-assisted content was reviewed, edited, and curated by the developer. No content is generated by AI during gameplay, and the in-game AI game master Mon's dialogue is pre-written.

games.raw: The narrative and interface text in this game - dialogue, tutorial guidance, in-game descriptions, and localization into all supported languages (Russian, English, French, Italian, German, Spanish, Dutch, Polish, Portuguese) - was generated with the assistance of generative AI (a large language model), based on the developer's original game concept, design, and creative direction. No other content in this game - music, sound, or gameplay - is AI-generated.

a.sum: Generative AI (an LLM) was used to produce the game's narrative and interface text: dialogue, tutorial guidance, in-game descriptions, and localization into nine languages, based on the developer's original concept, design, and creative direction. The disclosure states that music, sound, and gameplay are not AI-generated. It does not mention runtime or live generation.

games.n: Life Is a Dungeon: Lean into It.
games.raw: Generative AI was used to create and iteratively refine some graphics and promotional images, to translate character voices, and to assist with writing and implementing the game’s code. All outputs were selected, reviewed, and integrated by the developer. No AI-generated content is produced during gameplay.

a.sum: The developer declares generative AI use for graphics and promotional images (created and iteratively refined), for translating character voices, and for assisting with writing and implementing code. All outputs were reviewed and integrated by the developer. No AI-generated content is produced during gameplay, so generation is pre-generated only.

games.raw: This game was developed with AI assistance for localization, in-game text (tutorial, lore, item descriptions, UI), monster/enemy artwork, and store page artwork (including the game's capsule image). All AI-assisted content was reviewed and edited by the developer before release. No content is generated by AI during gameplay.

a.sum: AI assisted with localization, in-game text (tutorial, lore, item descriptions, UI), monster/enemy artwork, and store page artwork including the capsule image. All AI-assisted content was reviewed and edited by the developer. No content is generated by AI during gameplay.

games.raw: This game uses AI generation tools in the creation of some graphical assets, background music, and code.

a.sum: The developer discloses AI tools were used for some graphical assets, background music, and code. The graphical assets are not specified further, and the disclosure does not say whether content is pre-generated or generated live.

games.raw: This game was made with substantial use of generative AI tools. All of it happens during development — nothing is generated live during gameplay. - Artwork: backgrounds and object art were generated with Google Gemini; enemy sprites and battle effects with Retro Diffusion. - Music: background music was generated with Suno. - Writing and code: the scenario, dialogue and game code were written by the developer working together with Claude (Anthropic). Every asset and line of text that ships in the game was selected, edited and approved by the developer.

a.sum: Generative AI was used during development only, with nothing generated live in gameplay. Gemini made backgrounds and object art, Retro Diffusion made enemy sprites and battle effects, and Suno made background music. The developer wrote the scenario, dialogue and code with Claude's help, and the developer approved all shipped assets and text.

games.raw: Game art assets are created using AI tools.

a.sum: The developer states that game art assets were created using AI tools. The disclosure does not say whether generation was pre-generated or live, or which specific asset types or in-game and store uses are involved.

games.raw: Industry Unbound includes a limited number of pre-generated visual assets created with the assistance of generative AI. Each asset was selected, reviewed, and edited by the developer before release. Generative AI is not used to generate content in real time during gameplay.

a.sum: Discloses a limited number of pre-generated visual assets made with generative AI assistance. The developer selected, reviewed, and edited each asset before release. No real-time generative AI is used during gameplay. The specific asset types (e.g., store, in-game, textures) are not stated.

games.raw: The background art, character art, and music in this game were created with the assistance of generative AI tools. The story and narrative text were written by humans.

a.sum: The developer discloses generative AI assistance for background art, character art, and music, which are described as created ahead of time. The story and narrative text are stated to be human-written, and the disclosure does not mention live or runtime generation.

games.raw: Claude helped with performance optimization and troubleshooting bugs

a.sum: The developer discloses using Claude for performance optimization and bug troubleshooting, which points to development-time code assistance. The disclosure does not describe any AI-generated content shipped in the game or any live generation.

games.raw: We have used generative AI to obtain sketches, icons, artwork, and code to move faster in development.

a.sum: The developer says generative AI was used to produce sketches, icons, artwork, and code to speed up development. The disclosure does not say whether content is pre-generated or generated live, or where the artwork and icons appear in the game or store.

games.raw: Some of the game's 2D artwork - was created using generative AI tools, then manually curated and edited by the developer. Text localization into non-English languages is AI-assisted and reviewed by the developer. A planned voice for one character will use AI speech generation. All game design, level design, code, gameplay systems, and the English text are human-made.

a.sum: The developer declares AI use for some 2D artwork (generated, then manually curated and edited), AI-assisted non-English localization (developer-reviewed), and a planned AI speech voice for one character. All game design, level design, code, gameplay systems, and English text are stated as human-made. No live or runtime generation is mentioned.

games.raw: UI Elements, sounds.

a.sum: Developer lists AI-generated UI elements and sounds. Scope is brief, and it does not say whether content is pre-generated or generated live.

games.raw: Generative AI tools were used during development to assist with game code, localization, concept development, selected environmental and shop-interior images and textures, and store and marketing artwork. All AI-assisted outputs were reviewed, edited, and integrated by the developer before inclusion. The game does not use generative AI during runtime, and players cannot generate AI content within the game.

a.sum: The developer used generative AI during development for game code, localization, concept development, some environmental and shop-interior images and textures, and store and marketing art. All outputs were reviewed, edited, and integrated by the developer. The game uses no generative AI at runtime, and players cannot generate AI content.

games.raw: Generative AI was used strictly for debugging and optimization. No AI was used to generate art, music, etc.

a.sum: The developer says generative AI was used only for debugging and optimization, and that no AI was used to generate art, music, or other content. No generated content is declared, and the disclosure does not mention in-game or live generation.

games.n: World of Kadal: Protector of Hammerdale

games.raw: This game was developed with the assistance of AI tools in selected areas, including visual assets, music, sound effects, and language translation. The game’s original text and creative direction were created by the developer. AI-assisted content was reviewed, edited, and refined by the developer before being included in the game.

a.sum: Developer discloses AI assistance in visual assets, music, sound effects, and translation. Original text and creative direction are human-made. AI output was reviewed, edited, and refined before inclusion, which implies pre-built assets rather than live generation.

games.raw: Generative AI was used as a creative tool to assist with parts of the artwork, code, and written content. All design choices, creative direction, edits, and final decisions were made by the human developer, with all AI-assisted work reviewed and refined before release.

a.sum: The developer declares generative AI was used as a creative tool for parts of the artwork, code, and written content. A human made all design, creative, and final decisions, and all AI-assisted work was reviewed and refined before release. The disclosure does not mention live or runtime generation, and the pre-release review implies static, pre-generated content. The specific artwork uses are not stated.

games.raw: AI was used to generate art assets.

a.sum: The developer discloses that AI was used to generate art assets. The disclosure does not specify which assets, whether generation happened before release or during play, or whether any content is generated live.

games.raw: I’m a normal guy, and making a game has been a dream of mine. I used generative AI as part of my development process, including helping with code and creating visual assets. Every asset included in the final game was personally selected, refined, placed, and directed by me to match the game’s overall vision.

a.sum: Developer used generative AI during development to help with code and create visual assets. All assets in the final game were selected, refined, placed, and directed by the developer. The disclosure does not mention runtime or live-generated content.

games.n: Enkhbayar's Olympiad Chess: Multi-Board Team Matches

games.raw: This work incorporates the use of generative artificial intelligence (AI) in the following areas: Parts of the artwork, parts of the sound, and localization.

a.sum: The developer declares generative AI use for parts of the artwork, parts of the sound, and localization. The disclosure does not specify which artwork or sound elements are affected, or whether content is pre-generated or generated live.

games.raw: Some background assets and sound effects in this game were created using generative AI.

a.sum: The developer discloses that some background assets and sound effects were created using generative AI. The text describes assets created in advance and does not mention runtime or live generation.

games.raw: Selected visual assets and music tracks were created using generative AI tools as part of the production process. All AI-generated material was reviewed, curated, and integrated by the developer to ensure consistency with the game’s creative direction. No AI-generated content is produced during gameplay.

a.sum: Selected visual assets and music tracks were generated with AI tools during production. The developer reviewed, curated, and integrated this material. No AI content is generated during gameplay.

games.raw: The game uses static images and UI elements (including a cryptocurrency exchange chart) generated with AI tools. These assets were manually post-processed and integrated into the game. All game code, mechanics, audio, and original level design were created by the studio without AI generation.

a.sum: The developer declares AI-generated static images and UI elements, including a cryptocurrency exchange chart. These were manually post-processed and integrated. Code, mechanics, audio, and original level design are stated as not AI-generated. No live generation is mentioned.

games.raw: Generative AI was used during development for early visual exploration and as a creative assistance tool. Any AI-assisted visual material included in the game or store assets is substantially edited and art-directed by the developer. Final game art, visual design, and implementation are created and curated by the developer. No generative AI is used during gameplay.

a.sum: Generative AI was used during development for early visual exploration and creative assistance. AI-assisted visual material in the game or store assets was substantially edited and art-directed by the developer. Final art and implementation are developer-created and curated. No generative AI runs during gameplay.

games.raw: This game has two soundtracks. One is human-made and one is AI-Enhanced. Players have the option of choosing between the two. AI was used for art, sound effects, and programming.

a.sum: The developer declares AI use for art, sound effects, and programming. The game offers two soundtracks, a human-made one and an AI-enhanced one, and players can choose between them. The disclosure does not say whether AI content is pre-generated or generated live, or what kind of art is covered, so 'other' is used for art.

games.raw: Quarter Mile contains no AI-generated art, music, voice or in-game text. Every visual in the game is rendered in real time from geometry and materials authored by hand in code — there are no image assets. Every sound is synthesized by the game while you play, from a physical model of the engine; no audio files ship with the game. All car data and track layouts are hand-authored. The store page capsule art and screenshots are rendered by the game itself, using the same renderer that draws the game — they are not concept art, not painted, and not AI-generated. The game description and other store page text were written with the assistance of an AI writing assistant, and portions of the game's source code were written with the assistance of an AI coding assistant. All of it was reviewed and edited by the developer. The game does not use generative AI at runtime. Nothing is generated while you play, there is no network connection of any kind, and the game is fully playable offline.

a.sum: AI was used during development only: an AI writing assistant helped write the game description and other store page text, and an AI coding assistant helped write portions of the source code, all reviewed and edited by the developer. No AI-generated art, music, voice, in-game text, or audio files are used. Visuals and sound are produced by hand-authored code and a physical engine model, and store capsule art and screenshots are rendered by the game itself. Nothing is generated at runtime, and the game has no network connection and works offline.

games.raw: some of the models use AI

a.sum: Developer states that some models use AI. The text does not specify which models, what content they produce, or whether generation is pre-generated or live.

games.raw: Ricochet Witch includes content created with the assistance of generative AI tools. Every AI-assisted element was directed, selected and edited by the developer, and all of it was reviewed before release. - 2D artwork (title illustration, game logo, clear end card, scoreboard background, and the application icon, which is a crop of the title illustration): generated with Google Gemini and OpenAI ChatGPT, then selected and edited by the developer. - Achievement icons: base images generated with OpenAI ChatGPT; the grayscale (locked) versions were made by the developer in Photoshop. - The player character 3D model: generated with Meshy AI, then adjusted and integrated into the game by the developer. - English localization text: translated with the assistance of a generative AI tool (Anthropic Claude), then reviewed and adjusted by the developer. - Store page description text (Simplified Chinese, Korean, Traditional Chinese, Brazilian Portuguese, German and Spanish): translated with the assistance of generative AI tools (OpenAI ChatGPT and Anthropic Claude), then reviewed and adjusted by the developer. - Store page images: these use the AI-assisted artwork described above. No content is generated by AI while the game is running.

a.sum: Developer declares generative AI use for pre-generated content only. 2D art (title illustration, logo, end card, scoreboard background, app icon) was made with Gemini and ChatGPT, then edited by the developer. Achievement icon bases were made with ChatGPT, and grayscale versions were made by hand. The player character model was made with Meshy AI and adjusted by the developer. English localization and store page description translations were made with ChatGPT and Claude, then reviewed by the developer. Store page images use the AI-assisted artwork. No content is generated by AI at runtime.

games.raw: The game supports multiple interface languages, and some visual assets were generated using AI.

a.sum: The developer discloses that some visual assets were generated using AI. The disclosure does not say which assets, whether generation was pre-generated or live, or where the assets appear. The mention of multiple interface languages does not state that AI was used for localization.

games.raw: Swirl Together contains a rotoscoping/masking model similar to Adobe’s roto brush, or Davinci Resolve's magic masking tool, and a depth-estimating model for colliders.

a.sum: The developer discloses a rotoscoping/masking model (comparable to Adobe's Roto Brush or DaVinci Resolve's Magic Mask) and a depth-estimating model used for colliders. The disclosure does not say whether these run live in the game or whether their outputs are pre-generated, and it does not name any art, code, or other content they produce.

games.raw: Some visual assets were AI-assisted, then manually edited by our team. No AI content is generated during gameplay.

a.sum: Some visual assets were AI-assisted and then manually edited by the team. No AI content is generated during gameplay. The specific asset categories are not named.

games.raw: The Offering is made by one person working with AI, and I'd rather you know exactly how before you decide to buy it. AI did most of the making. It wrote the bulk of the code, built the creatures in Blender reconstructed into 3D from AI-generated concept art, painted much of the interface and card art, generated the music, and machine-translated the game into its 28 other languages. Sound effects come from free sound libraries. I did the deciding. Every system, card and number was designed and argued over by me, then thrown out and rebuilt when it didn't feel right, which happened a lot. The balance comes from my own playthroughs plus a pile of simulation runs, and I decide what stays. Nothing is generated while you play. The game runs no AI model, needs no account or subscription, and never talks to an AI service. If AI-made content is a dealbreaker for you, this game isn't for you, and that's a fair call to make.

a.sum: AI wrote most of the code, built creatures from AI-generated concept art reconstructed into 3D, painted much of the interface and card art, generated the music, and machine-translated the game into 28 languages. Sound effects come from free libraries. The developer designed and balanced all systems. Nothing is generated during play, and the game runs no AI model or service.

games.raw: AI was used for help with minor assets and some copy. The AI content will get removed throughout the timeline of this game up until full release.

a.sum: Developer says AI helped with minor assets and some copy, and that the AI content will be removed before full release. Text does not specify asset types or whether any content is generated live in-game.

games.raw: Parts of this game's code were written with the assistance of AI programming tools; all output was reviewed, tested and integrated by the developer. Store page texts and localizations were also produced with AI assistance and reviewed by the developer. [Some music and sound assets were created using AI generation tools and curated by the developer.] [Some marketing artwork (e.g. capsule images) was created with AI image tools and edited by the developer.] All in-game 3D models and simulation content are authored procedurally or by hand. The game does not generate any content with AI at runtime, and it does not connect to any external AI services.

a.sum: AI assisted code (reviewed and tested by the developer), store page texts and localizations, some music and sound assets (curated by the developer), and some marketing artwork such as capsule images (edited by the developer). All content is pre-generated. In-game 3D models and simulation content are procedural or hand-made. No AI runs at runtime and the game does not connect to external AI services. Some items appear in brackets in the disclosure.

games.raw: Generative AI tools were used to assist in creating some of this game's artwork and store page imagery, and to assist with translating its text into the supported languages. All translations were reviewed before shipping. No content is generated by AI during gameplay.

a.sum: The developer says generative AI assisted with some of the game's artwork, store page imagery, and translation of text into supported languages. Translations were reviewed before shipping. The developer states no content is generated by AI during gameplay.

games.raw: 本作では、以下の3箇所に生成AIを使用しています。 【BGM】ゲーム内利用楽曲は、生成AI（Suno）で作成したものを、開発者が選定・編集のうえ収録しています。 【レース実況の音声】音声合成エンジン「VOICEVOX」を使用し、ゲームの実行中に実況の音声を生成しています。読み上げる文章はすべて開発者が書いた定型文で、AIが文章そのものを作ることはありません。可変部分はプレイヤーが入力した馬名だけです。 【ゲームアイコン】ゲームアイコンの画像は、生成AI（Claude Code）で作成したものを開発者が調整のうえ使用しています。 上記以外のグラフィック・3Dモデル・効果音・フォントには、生成AIを使用していません。

a.sum: BGM is pre-generated with Suno and then selected and edited by the developer. Race commentary voice is generated live during play with VOICEVOX, using developer-written fixed templates where only the player-entered horse name varies; the AI does not write the text. The game icon image is pre-generated with Claude Code and adjusted by the developer. Graphics, 3D models, sound effects, and fonts are declared as not AI-generated.

games.raw: Generative AI tools were used during development to assist with selected 2D and 3D visual assets, sounds, localization, and marketing materials. All AI-assisted content was reviewed, edited, and integrated by the developer to ensure consistency with the game's visual style and intended design.

a.sum: Developer discloses generative AI use during development for selected 2D and 3D visual assets, sounds, localization, and marketing materials. All AI-assisted content was reviewed, edited, and integrated by the developer. No live or runtime generation is mentioned.

games.raw: Codex generated the game's original code and visual assets, as well as written content and localization, under the developer's detailed direction. The developer designs the rules, directs iterations, tests the game and reviews the output. The soundtrack is licensed separately, and third-party fonts, source sound recordings and software libraries are credited separately. DeltaV does not generate content during gameplay or connect to a generative AI service. Computer-controlled opponents use conventional rule-based game logic.

a.sum: Codex generated the game's original code, visual assets, written content, and localization under the developer's direction. Content is pre-generated; no content is generated during gameplay, and there is no connection to a generative AI service. Opponents use rule-based logic. The soundtrack, fonts, sound recordings, and libraries are non-AI and credited separately.

games.raw: PER MY LAST EMAIL contains pre-generated AI content. Its music, ambience and sound effects are created with generative audio tools. Its narrative text is human–AI co-written and human-edited under the author's direction; the game design is the author's. Its store artwork uses AI-generated background plates, composed and finished programmatically, and the game shows an AI-generated photograph of the office with each of its six endings; every document, form and user-interface element in the game is drawn in code. No AI content is generated at runtime, and the game contains no AI-generated depictions of real people.

a.sum: Pre-generated AI use only; no runtime AI. AI tools make music, ambience and sound effects. Narrative text is human-AI co-written and human-edited. Store art uses AI background plates finished in code. Six ending screens show an AI-generated office photo. Documents, forms and UI are code-drawn, and the game has no AI depictions of real people.

games.raw: The game contains AI generated music

a.sum: Developer discloses that the game contains AI-generated music. The disclosure does not state whether the music is pre-generated or generated live during play.

games.raw: The observation tower model in SaboTour was initially created using an AI-based 3D generation tool, then manually repaired, retopologized and finished in Blender. No other AI-generated content is included, and the game does not generate any content using AI while it is running.

a.sum: AI-based 3D generation tool was used to initially create the observation tower model, which was then manually repaired, retopologized, and finished in Blender. No other AI-generated content is included, and the game generates no content using AI at runtime.

games.raw: Generative AI tools were used as development assistants, including assistance drafting and editing portions of store-page marketing text. All player-facing content is reviewed and edited by the developer. Main Street Operator does not use generative AI during gameplay and does not connect to external AI services while the game is running.

a.sum: The developer used generative AI as a development assistant, including drafting and editing store-page marketing text. All player-facing content is reviewed and edited by the developer. The game does not use generative AI during gameplay or connect to external AI services at runtime.

games.raw: This game uses generative AI in the following places: Images: the scene artwork starts from photographs taken on location — the lanes, stairwells and apartment courtyards of Anping, Tainan. Each photograph is processed first — removing things that should not appear in frame, commercial branding, and anything touching on privacy — and then stylised into animation by AI. Music: AI-generated. Code: AI is used during development to help check the code for bugs and logic errors. Localisation: Traditional Chinese is the language the game is written in. Every other language — English, Japanese, German, and Taiwanese Pe̍h-ōe-jī — is AI-translated, with no native-speaker editing pass. If you find a mistake, please do tell me. Store page and marketing images also include AI-generated elements.

a.sum: The developer declares AI use in in-game scene art (location photos stylised by AI into animation), music, development-time code bug checking, translation of all languages except Traditional Chinese (no native-speaker review), and AI-generated elements in store and marketing images. No runtime or live generation is mentioned.

games.raw: TOWN HALL contains pre-generated AI content. Its environment art and character models are created with generative image and image-to-3D tools, composed, programmed and finished by hand; its store artwork comes from the same pipeline. Its narrative text is human–AI co-written and human-edited under the author's direction; the game design is the author's. Its music and sound are created with generative audio tools. No AI content is generated at runtime, and the game contains no AI-generated depictions of real people.

a.sum: TOWN HALL declares pre-generated AI content: environment art, character models (via image-to-3D), store artwork, co-written narrative text, music, and sound. No AI content is generated at runtime, and there are no AI depictions of real people.

games.raw: This game uses AI for answering questions and generating image models.

a.sum: The developer declares AI use for answering player questions, which implies runtime generation, and for generating image models, whose timing (pre-generated or live) is not stated.

games.raw: Almost all assets were bought but AI was used to generate some of them.

games.raw: AI-assisted tools were used during parts of the development process.

games.n: Riggin Farm: Raw Land to Riches

games.n: Panda Fishing: The Way of Angling

games.raw: I designed Lanternfall's mechanics, towers, enemies, waves and balance myself. Every level background is a 3D scene I designed and lit in Blender over hundreds of hours, and every character, enemy and tower is rendered through my own lighting, camera and sprite-sheet setup. Generative AI was used during production for some content: - The store artwork, main menu art, concept art and some menu illustrations were made with AI image tools. - The 3D models, rigging and animation for characters, enemies, towers and props began as AI-generated models, which I then edited, lit, rendered and tuned for the game. - The music, one boss voice and some sound effects and ambience were made with AI audio tools, then selected, edited and mixed by me. Most sound effects come from licensed sound libraries. No generative AI runs in the game. Nothing is generated while you play.

a.sum: Generative AI was used during production, not in the game. AI image tools made store art, main menu art, concept art and some menu illustrations. AI-generated 3D models for characters, enemies, towers and props were then edited, lit, rendered and tuned, and their rigging and animation are described as beginning from AI output. AI audio tools made the music, one boss voice and some sound effects and ambience, which the developer selected, edited and mixed. Most sound effects are licensed libraries. Mechanics, levels and balance are the developer's own work. Nothing is generated during play.

games.raw: The game includes some assets pre-generated by AI.

The disclosure also lists two images and two short instrumentals, which it implies are the remaining AI-related content, though it doesn't state their origin or use. No live generation is mentioned.

games.raw: American Gold Rush uses limited AI-generated art in the opening scene background. All pixel art, all sound effects, all music, and all writing are human-made, by named people in the credits paid for the work.

games.raw: the code/image of game are mostly implemented by AI.

games.raw: **AI is awesome! We love AI!** AI has allowed our small team to create a much larger, deeper RPG than we could have built otherwise, with complex gameplay systems, a living world, and characters who have lives of their own. But don't worry—there's a real human behind the Game Master's screen! Nine Thrones is a labor of love inspired by classic tabletop roleplaying games. Our world, characters, and adventures are shaped by human imagination, with AI helping us bring that vision to life. We also use generative AI as part of our art development process. AI-assisted tools help create and refine some character art, environments, sprites, and promotional artwork. All assets are selected, directed, edited, and reviewed by our development team before being included in the game. No AI content is generated during gameplay.

a.sum: Developer states generative AI is used in art development for some character art, environments, sprites, and promotional artwork, all reviewed and edited by the team. The text says no AI content is generated during gameplay. Other AI uses are vaguely described as helping 'bring the vision to life' without specifics.

games.raw: Generative AI tools were used to assist a solo developer with some visual assets, audio, and translations. All core text is original, and no content is generated in real time when you play.

a.sum: The developer declares generative AI used to assist with visual assets, audio (type unspecified), and translations. Core text is stated as original, and no content is generated in real time during play.

games.raw: Generative AI was used during development to create and edit some in-game letter icons and Steam store and library artwork, and to assist with writing and translation. No content is generated using generative AI during gameplay.

a.sum: Generative AI was used during development to create and edit in-game letter icons and Steam store and library artwork, and to assist with writing and translation. The developer states no content is generated with generative AI during gameplay.

games.raw: Store listing assets & descriptions passed through generative AI for enhancements & review.

a.sum: The developer discloses that Steam store listing assets and descriptions were passed through generative AI for enhancement and review. The disclosure describes only pre-release use on store materials and does not mention any in-game or live-generated content.

games.raw: The 2D art in OBOLUS is made with image generation models running locally on my own machine — Stable Diffusion XL through ComfyUI, including a style model I trained myself on 1930s cartoon references. None of it is a raw output: every sprite, backdrop, card frame and icon was directed through many passes, then cut out, colour-corrected, upscaled and assembled frame by frame into animation sheets. Everything else is not AI: the rules, every card and every number on it, the balance, the 22 heroes, the six lands, the writing and the interface. The sound effects are synthesised by code written for this game. Nothing is generated while you play. The game makes no network calls and ships with no model — nothing runs on your machine, and none of your data goes anywhere.

a.sum: 2D art (sprites, backdrops, card frames, icons) was generated with locally run Stable Diffusion XL via ComfyUI, using a self-trained style model, then heavily edited and assembled into animation sheets. Nothing is generated during play. Rules, cards, numbers, balance, heroes, lands, writing, interface, and sound effects (code-synthesised) are declared not AI. No network calls and no bundled model.

games.raw: Some game icons were AI-generated and then manually edited and overpainted.

a.sum: Some game icons were generated with AI, then manually edited and overpainted by the developer. No live or runtime generation is mentioned.

games.raw: The game's icons, key art, UI skins, and interface translations include assets created using generative AI.

a.sum: The developer discloses generative AI used to create game icons, key art, UI skins, and interface translations. No live or runtime generation is mentioned.

games.n: The Last Bastion: Beyond the Frontier

games.raw: This game's implementation makes extensive use of generative AI tools. Most of the visual assets (including skill icons and UI elements such as the boss health bar), the background music, portions of the in-game text and its localization, and much of the source code were produced with the assistance of AI generation tools. The game design itself is authored by the developer: the overall structure and player progression, class and skill design, boss movesets and phase design, and all numeric balance including damage values, health, drop rates and growth curves. These were planned, playtested and iterated on by the developer.

a.sum: AI was used to pre-generate most visual assets (including skill icons and UI such as the boss health bar), the background music, portions of in-game text and its localization, and much of the source code. Game design, progression, class/skill design, boss movesets and phases, and all numeric balance were authored and playtested by the developer. No runtime/live generation is mentioned.

games.raw: The localization for this game were generated with AI (and are included as fixed text. This covers the Steam store page text (short description and “About This Game”) and the in-game text (menus, settings and dialogue) in Chinese (Simplified), Russian and German. The translations have not been reviewed by a native speaker and may contain errors. The original English text was written by the developer. AI coding assistance was used during development. All art, music and sound are not AI-generated. No AI-generated content is created while the game is running.

a.sum: AI generated the Simplified Chinese, Russian, and German localizations of the Steam store text and in-game text (menus, settings, dialogue), included as fixed text and not reviewed by a native speaker. The English original was written by the developer. AI was used for coding assistance. Art, music, and sound are not AI-generated, and no AI content is generated during gameplay.

games.raw: AI was used as an assistant for programming.

a.sum: The developer declares AI was used as an assistant for programming. No other content types or live generation are mentioned.

games.raw: This game was made with the help of generative AI. AI tools assisted in various parts of development, including code and localization.

a.sum: Developer declares generative AI was used in development, including code and localization. Text does not say whether content is pre-generated or generated live in-game.

games.raw: Generative AI tools were used during development to assist in the creation of certain 3D models, characters and creatures, textures, animations, and visual assets. All such content is generated in advance, then reviewed, modified where necessary, and manually integrated into the game by the developer. No generative AI is used in real time during gameplay.

a.sum: Generative AI was used during development for certain 3D models, characters and creatures, textures, animations, and visual assets. All such content is generated in advance, reviewed and modified as needed, then manually integrated by the developer. No generative AI runs in real time during gameplay.

games.raw: Some of the assets in Champions of Thaloria were created with the help of generative AI tools during development. This includes parts of the store page artwork and trailer, a portion of the in-game 2D art such as item icons, avatar frames and class emblems, and some of the music and sound effects. The Hungarian, German, Polish and Romanian translations were also made with the help of AI tools. Every AI-assisted asset was selected, edited and assembled by hand before it went into the game, and all of it was reviewed by the developer. The game does not generate anything while you play. No content is created at runtime and no AI service is contacted during gameplay — everything ships with the game.

a.sum: AI tools were used in development for parts of the store page artwork and trailer, some in-game 2D art (item icons, avatar frames, class emblems), some music and sound effects, and Hungarian, German, Polish and Romanian translations. All AI-assisted assets were hand-selected, edited, assembled and reviewed by the developer. The game generates no content at runtime and contacts no AI service during play; everything ships with the game.

games.raw: Generative AI tools were used during development to assist with some pre-generated 2D artwork and UI imagery, 3D models and animations, instrumental music and sound effects, localization drafts, and portions of the game code. As a solo developer, I selected, edited, integrated, and reviewed all of these outputs before inclusion. The game does not generate content at runtime and does not send player input to generative AI services.

a.sum: The developer declares generative AI use during development for pre-generated 2D artwork and UI imagery, 3D models and animations, instrumental music, sound effects, localization drafts, and some game code. A solo developer selected, edited, integrated, and reviewed all outputs. The game does not generate content at runtime or send player input to generative AI services.

games.raw: Some assets have been generated using AI

a.sum: The developer discloses that some assets were generated using AI. The disclosure does not specify which assets, the generation method, or whether any content is generated live during play.

games.raw: Generative AI will only be used in game development, especially localization. All puzzles in the game is hand-crafted by human beings.

a.sum: Developer says generative AI is used in game development, especially localization, and that all puzzles are hand-crafted by humans. The disclosure does not say whether AI content is generated before release or live, and does not specify other uses.

games.raw: This is a fully AI-directed game. Generative AI is integral to world generation (both structured data and images), as well as directing events and experiences for the player in real time according to the game engine's logic/harness.

a.sum: The game is described as fully AI-directed. Generative AI is integral to world generation, covering both structured data and images, and to directing events and experiences for the player in real time through the engine's logic and harness.

games.raw: ChromaFlow was developed with assistance from generative AI tools (such as Large Language Models) to help write and structure the source code and draft store descriptions. All AI-generated content was reviewed, edited, and integrated manually. The game does not feature live, runtime generative AI or external API connections during gameplay.

a.sum: The developer declares generative AI (LLMs) was used to help write and structure source code and draft store descriptions, with all output reviewed, edited, and manually integrated. The disclosure states there is no live or runtime generative AI and no external API connections during gameplay. Note that 'store descriptions' is text, so the closest matching scope is general_text, though the list offers store_art for store-page content; the disclosure itself names only code and store descriptions.

games.raw: Some assets in Magician Alisa were created with the assistance of generative AI tools: visual artwork and music. All AI-generated assets were selected, curated and edited by the developer.

a.sum: Some visual artwork and music in Magician Alisa were created with generative AI assistance. The developer selected, curated, and edited all AI-generated assets. No live or in-game generation is described.

games.raw: The in-game localization for this title is currently in an AI-assisted translation phase. For the official release, the text will undergo expert proofreading and re-translation to deliver an improved gaming experience. In terms of audio, while there are a few temporary AI assets used to hit our Next Fest schedule, rest assured that every last one will be replaced.

a.sum: The developer discloses AI-assisted translation for in-game localization, to be replaced by expert proofreading and re-translation for the official release. They also disclose some temporary AI audio assets used for the Next Fest schedule, to be replaced before release. The audio type is not specified.

games.raw: The developer used generative AI tools during the development process to assist in creating pre-generated 2D visual assets (such as backgrounds and promotional art) and to help generate programming code. All AI-generated content was heavily modified, curated, and reviewed by the developer to fit the game's cyberpunk setting. There is no live-generated AI content in this game.

a.sum: Developer declares generative AI used during development for pre-generated 2D visual assets (such as backgrounds and promotional art) and for generating programming code. Developer states all AI output was heavily modified, curated, and reviewed. No live-generated AI content.

games.raw: Some ambient audio in this game — background crowd voices and station announcements — is generated using neural text-to-speech. All visual art, music, and narrative writing are human-authored or made with traditional, non-generative tools.

a.sum: Ambient audio, specifically background crowd voices and station announcements, is generated with neural text-to-speech. The disclosure does not say whether this audio is pre-generated or produced live. Visual art, music, and narrative writing are stated to be human-authored or made with non-generative tools.

games.n: Kigetsu: Night of the Waning Moon
弾幕の戦乙女 -Barrage of Valhalla-
games.raw: Some 2D art assets in this game (character illustrations, sprites, backgrounds, and UI decorations) were created using generative AI (Google Gemini) and then retouched and processed under human supervision. Text, code, and game design were created with AI-assisted tools under human direction and review. All generated content has been reviewed by a human to ensure it does not resemble existing copyrighted works.

a.sum: AI (Google Gemini) generated 2D art assets (character illustrations, sprites, backgrounds, UI decorations), which humans then retouched and processed. Text, code, and game design used AI-assisted tools under human direction and review. Generated content was human-reviewed for resemblance to copyrighted works. No live or runtime generation is mentioned.

games.raw: Generative AI was used to assist in creating some background artwork. Character artwork, writing, narrative content, and in-game performances were created by humans. The game does not use generative AI to create content in real time.

a.sum: Generative AI was used to assist in creating some background artwork. Character art, writing, narrative, and in-game performances are human-made. No real-time generative AI is used.

games.raw: Generative AI was used during development to assist in creating some 2D art assets, including scene backgrounds, character and monster artwork, UI elements, and icons for items, equipment, skills, and status effects. Generative AI was also used to assist in drafting some in-game text. All AI-assisted content was selected, edited, post-processed, and integrated by the developer. The game does not use generative AI at runtime and does not generate content in real time in response to player input.

a.sum: Developer used generative AI during development to help create 2D art (scene backgrounds, character and monster art, UI elements, item/equipment/skill/status effect icons) and to draft some in-game text. All AI-assisted content was selected, edited, post-processed, and integrated by the developer. The game does not use generative AI at runtime or generate content in real time from player input.

games.raw: Generative AI was used as an assistive tool for translating parts of the scenario and in-game text. All translated content has been thoroughly reviewed, refined, and proofread manually by the developer to ensure natural phrasing and quality.

a.sum: Developer disclosed generative AI used as an assistive tool to translate parts of the scenario and in-game text; all translations were manually reviewed, refined, and proofread by the developer. No live or runtime generation is described.

games.n: Save Ruika! — Looping with a Losing Heroine
games.raw: Generative AI was used as an assistive tool for translating parts of the scenario and in-game text. All translated content has been thoroughly reviewed, refined, and proofread manually by the developer to ensure natural phrasing and quality.

a.sum: Developer disclosed AI used as an assistive tool to translate parts of the scenario and in-game text; all translations were manually reviewed, refined, and proofread. No live or runtime generation is mentioned.

games.raw: Generative AI was used during development to assist with coding, promotional artwork, and store-page copy and localization. All outputs were reviewed by the developer.

a.sum: The developer declared generative AI use during development for coding assistance, promotional artwork, store-page copy, and localization. All outputs were reviewed by the developer. No live or in-game generation is mentioned.

games.raw: The visual assets in RindTown were created with an AI-assisted workflow to speed up development. We respect artists and their craft, but as a small indie team we had no choice but to use AI-assisted tools to get this game made. We sincerely believe the game is fun and enjoyable, and we have done everything we can to make sure players like it. We hope the gameplay will leave you satisfied. Thank you to everyone for taking the time to play our game. No generative AI is used while the game is running. All content is pre-made and shipped with the game.

a.sum: The developer discloses that RindTown's visual assets were created with an AI-assisted workflow. They state that no generative AI runs while the game is played and that all content is pre-made and shipped with the game. The disclosure does not specify which visual asset types were affected.

games.raw: Parts of Fluxgates were built with AI assistance, and all of it is fixed content baked into the build - nothing is generated while you play. Code: Some of the game's source was written with an AI coding assistant, reviewed, edited and tested by the developer before shipping. Text: English and French interface strings and node descriptions were drafted with AI help and edited by hand. No AI generated art or audio. Every visual is drawn by the interface itself, and every sound and music track is synthesised procedurally by a script in the project. The game runs fully offline. No AI model runs at runtime, and no data leaves your machine.

a.sum: AI assisted with some code (reviewed and tested by the developer) and drafted English/French interface strings and node descriptions (edited by hand). All AI-assisted content is fixed and baked into the build. No AI art or audio, and no AI model runs at runtime or sends data off the machine.

games.raw: This game was developed through collaboration between the developer and AI tools across most content (art, writing, design); in-game translations were generated by AI.

a.sum: Developer declares AI collaboration across most content (art, writing, design), with in-game translations generated by AI. Generation timing (pre-generated vs. live) is not stated.

games.raw: Generative AI tools were used during development to assist in creating and refining some pre-generated narrative, text, and visual content. All such content is created prior to release and reviewed by the developer. The game does not generate AI content during gameplay.

a.sum: Developer declares generative AI was used during development to help create and refine some pre-generated narrative, text, and visual content, all reviewed by the developer before release. The game does not generate AI content during gameplay.

games.raw: Generative AI tools were used during development to assist with the creation of [artwork, voice audio, text, and localization]. All AI-assisted content was reviewed and edited by the developer before being included in the game. The game does not generate AI content during gameplay.

a.sum: The developer declares generative AI was used during development for artwork, voice audio, text, and localization. All AI-assisted content was reviewed and edited by the developer. The game does not generate AI content during gameplay. The artwork scope is not specified as store, marketing, or in-game.

games.raw: Generative AI tools were used during development to assist with the creation and iteration of some 2D artwork, visual assets, UI elements, and marketing materials. All generated content used in the final product is selected and reviewed by the developer. No generative AI content is generated during gameplay.

a.sum: The developer used generative AI during development to help create and iterate on some 2D artwork, visual assets, UI elements, and marketing materials. All AI-generated content in the final product was selected and reviewed by the developer. No generative AI content is produced during gameplay.

games.raw: Generative AI tools were used during development to assist with the creation and iteration of some pre-generated visual, written and promotional assets. All AI-assisted content is reviewed, edited and curated by the developer. No generative AI is used during gameplay.

a.sum: The developer used generative AI during development to create and iterate on pre-generated visual, written, and promotional assets. A developer reviews, edits, and curates all AI-assisted content. No generative AI runs during gameplay. The visual assets are not further specified as in-game, store, or other art.

games.raw: Generative AI was used during the creation of certain in-game content, such as cutscenes and other visual assets.

a.sum: The developer discloses generative AI use during creation of certain in-game content, such as cutscenes and other visual assets. The content is described as created during development, and no runtime or live generation is mentioned.

games.raw: Generative AI was used to create some content for the game, including cutscenes and related visual materials.

a.sum: Developer discloses that generative AI was used for some game content, explicitly including cutscenes and 'related visual materials' (vaguely specified). The text does not say whether content is pre-generated or generated live during play.

games.raw: Generative AI was used to assist with content creation, including text and graphical materials used in the game and/or on the store page.

a.sum: Developer discloses generative AI assisted content creation, including text and graphics used in the game and on the store page. Live versus pre-generated use is not stated.

Exorcism of the Legion (Last Rites) - Final Cut

games.raw: Generative AI was used to assist with selected store artwork and localization. All generated content was reviewed and integrated by the developer.

games.raw: This game contains pre-generated content created with the assistance of generative AI, including selected visual assets, music, sound effects, and written content. All AI-assisted content is reviewed and curated by the developer before release. The game does not use generative AI to create content live while players are playing.

a.sum: The developer declares generative AI was used to pre-generate selected visual assets, music, sound effects, and written content, all reviewed and curated before release. The game does not generate content live during play.

games.raw: Generative AI tools were used to help develop some game assets.

a.sum: The developer states that generative AI tools were used to help develop some game assets. The specific asset types, whether content is pre-generated or generated live, and whether it appears in-game or in the store are not specified.

games.raw: This game uses content created or assisted by generative AI. Generative AI was used to help create and edit some visual assets, music/sound materials, and scripts. All final content was reviewed, selected, and adjusted by the developer before being included in the game.

a.sum: Generative AI was used to create or assist some visual assets, music/sound materials, and scripts. The developer reviewed, selected, and adjusted all final content before inclusion, which indicates pre-generated rather than live content. The visual asset type is unspecified, and 'scripts' could mean narrative or code.

games.raw: Some marketing assets on the store page (capsules, logo) were produced with a generative AI tool, based on screenshots and 3D renders from the game itself. Part of the in-game text (encyclopaedia entries and mission briefings) was drafted with the assistance of a large language model, then reviewed and edited by the developer. The 3D parts, textures and the simulation itself are authored. Nothing is generated while the game is running.

a.sum: AI was used for pre-generated store and marketing art (capsules, logo) based on game screenshots and renders, and for drafting in-game encyclopaedia entries and mission briefings, which the developer reviewed and edited. 3D models, textures, and simulation are authored, and nothing is generated at runtime.

games.raw: I developed this game entirely on my own, handling all the game design, hand-drawn artwork, and music composition myself. Only the translations/localizations were generated by AI.

a.sum: The developer states AI was used only for translations/localizations. Game design, hand-drawn artwork, and music were created by the developer without AI.

games.raw: Some assets in this game were created with the assistance of generative AI and were then reviewed and edited by the developer. This includes character illustrations and animations, some item icons and textures, music and sound effects, and portions of translated text.

a.sum: The developer discloses that some assets were created with generative AI and then reviewed and edited by the developer. These include character illustrations and animations, some item icons and textures, music and sound effects, and portions of translated text. No live or runtime generation is mentioned.

games.raw: Generative AI tools were used for some artwork and music, directed and curated by our developer. All writing, characters, sound effects, level design, and gameplay, plus part of the soundtrack, are original STONEFRUITWORKS work.

a.sum: The developer declares generative AI was used for some artwork and music, directed and curated by the developer. Writing, characters, sound effects, level design, gameplay, and part of the soundtrack are stated to be original work. The disclosure does not specify where the artwork appears, and it mentions no runtime or live generation.

games.raw: During the development process, we may use procedural- and AI-based tools to assist with content creation. In all such cases, the final product reflects the creativity and expression of our own development team.

a.sum: The developer states they 'may use' procedural and AI-based tools to assist with content creation during development, without specifying which content types are affected. It does not say whether any AI content is generated live in the game. The statement is vague and hedged, and it asserts that the final product reflects the team's own creativity.

games.raw: Generative AI tools are used to assist with porting the game text into additional languages. All AI-assisted translations are reviewed and edited by the developer before release. No generative AI is used during gameplay.

a.sum: Generative AI is used to assist translating game text into additional languages; all such translations are reviewed and edited by the developer before release. The developer states no generative AI is used during gameplay.

games.raw: Pre-generated AI content in this game: - The boss character's English voice lines were generated with a text-to-speech model. - Some sound effects were created with a generative audio model. - The title logo, app icon, and some store page and marketing artwork were created with the help of generative image tools. - Text in languages other than Korean and English (in-game text, subtitles and store page) was translated with AI assistance. All AI content is pre-generated during development; the game does not generate any content live at runtime.

a.sum: AI is declared for pre-generated content only: TTS English voice lines for the boss, generative sound effects, generative image tools for the title logo, app icon, and some store/marketing art, and AI-assisted translation of non-Korean/English in-game text, subtitles, and store page. The game generates no content live at runtime.

games.raw: Generative AI tools were used during development to assist with the creation and editing of some text content and graphical materials used in the game and its related assets.

a.sum: The developer says generative AI was used during development to help create and edit some text content and graphical materials in the game and its related assets. The disclosure does not say whether generation happens before release or live in the game, and it does not specify the exact asset types.

games.raw: AI was used in the coding and content creation for this game. That should not take away from this project the thousands of hours spent on its creation, honing and reshaping its style, direction and gameplay which was all done by a human.

a.sum: Developer discloses AI was used for coding and content creation, without specifying which content or whether AI generates anything during play. Human creative direction, style, and gameplay work is emphasized.

games.raw: The following were assisted by AI tools: music, voiceover, some icons, and backgrounds.

a.sum: Developer discloses AI assistance for music, voiceover, some icons, and backgrounds. The disclosure does not say whether content is pre-generated or generated live, and does not specify where icons and backgrounds appear.

games.raw: Some pre-generated artwork and audio were created with generative AI during development. These outputs are integrated as fixed assets; the game does not generate content live during gameplay or connect to a third-party AI service during gameplay.

a.sum: The developer used generative AI during development to create some pre-generated artwork and audio. These are fixed assets built into the game. The game generates no content live during gameplay and does not connect to a third-party AI service during gameplay. The disclosure does not specify which artwork or audio categories are affected.

games.raw: Generative AI was used during development to create selected 2D artwork, including crew portraits, environmental elements, user interface icons, and key art. Generated assets were selected, edited, and adapted to match the game’s visual style and technical requirements. The game does not generate any AI content at runtime and does not send player data to generative AI services.

a.sum: Developer declares generative AI was used during development to create selected 2D artwork: crew portraits, environmental elements, UI icons, and key art. Generated assets were selected and edited to fit the game's style. No AI content is generated at runtime and no player data is sent to generative AI services.

games.raw: Generative AI tools were used during development to assist in creating some pre-generated visual and audio assets included in the game and its marketing materials. AI tools were also used to assist with coding. All AI-assisted content was reviewed and, where necessary, edited by the developer. No content is generated by AI during gameplay.

a.sum: The developer declares generative AI use in development. It produced some pre-generated visual and audio assets used in the game and its marketing, and assisted with coding. A developer reviewed and edited all AI-assisted content. The developer states no content is generated by AI during gameplay. The specific type of audio is not stated.

games.n: Before I Turn: Survival Auto Battler
games.raw: AI was used in the localization of the game.

a.sum: The developer discloses that AI was used in the game's localization. The disclosure does not specify whether the content is pre-generated or generated live, so live generation is unknown.

games.raw: Background Art — AI generation tools were used for some of the background images. Not all backgrounds were created with AI; hand-made backgrounds are also used. AI-assisted images were further processed to match the game's pixel art style. Music — The music in this game was created using AI generation tools.

a.sum: AI generation tools were used for some background images, which were then processed to match the pixel art style; other backgrounds are hand-made. Music was created entirely with AI generation tools. No live or runtime generation is mentioned.

games.raw: The game's code, in-game text (Korean and English), localization, and store page text were created with the assistance of AI tools (Anthropic Claude), under human direction and review. Pixel artwork and audio are produced by procedural generation scripts that were also written with AI assistance. No content is generated by AI at runtime.

a.sum: AI (Anthropic Claude) assisted the code, in-game text (Korean and English), localization, and store page text, under human direction and review. Pixel artwork and audio come from procedural generation scripts written with AI assistance. The developer states no content is generated by AI at runtime. Audio type (music, sound effects, or voice) is not specified.

games.raw: A limited amount of 2D user-interface artwork was created with AI assistance.

a.sum: Developer discloses AI assistance in creating a limited amount of 2D user-interface artwork. No live or in-game generation is mentioned.

games.raw: I use generative AI as a tool during development: • Some 3D models (characters, creatures and props) were created with AI generation tools, then edited, rigged and animated by hand for use in the game. • Some sound effects were generated with AI audio tools, then edited and mixed by hand. • Some store page and marketing artwork was created with AI image generation. Everything produced this way is reviewed and reworked by me before it ships. The game generates no content while you play and connects to no AI service at runtime.

a.sum: The developer declares AI use as a development tool. AI-generated 3D models (characters, creatures, props) were edited, rigged, and animated by hand. AI-generated sound effects were edited and mixed by hand. AI-generated store page and marketing artwork was used. All outputs are reviewed and reworked before shipping. The game generates no content at runtime and connects to no AI service.

games.raw: GenAI tools were used during the creation of promotional key art.

a.sum: Developer declares GenAI tools were used in creating promotional key art. No live or in-game generated content is mentioned.

games.raw: Some visual assets used in Retro TV Tycoon were created with the assistance of generative AI. Specifically, AI-generated imagery is used for some of the fictional thumbnail artwork displayed in the **TV Catalog** and **Film Archives** sections of the game. These images are pre-generated assets created during development and are not generated dynamically while the game is running. Generative AI is not used to generate gameplay, player interactions, or live content. The AI-assisted images are used solely as visual illustrations and thumbnails representing fictional television programs and films within the game's catalog and archive interfaces.

a.sum: Generative AI was used to create some fictional thumbnail artwork in the TV Catalog and Film Archives. These are pre-generated assets, not generated at runtime. The developer states AI is not used for gameplay, player interactions, or live content.

games.raw: We use generative AI to assist with writing and localizing the game's text. All art and audio are procedurally generated by our own code or sourced from CC0 libraries. No content is generated by AI in real time during gameplay.

a.sum: The developer declares generative AI used to assist with writing and localizing game text, with the output produced before release. Art and audio are stated as procedurally generated by the developer's own code or sourced from CC0 libraries, not AI. The developer explicitly states no AI content is generated in real time during gameplay.

games.raw: Small part of the pre-made content in Dead Keys was edited with the help of generative AI and then reviewed and (again) edited by us. Most assets were fairly bought and are licensed with artists referenced above. No generative AI runs while you play.

a.sum: Generative AI was used to edit a small part of the pre-made content in Dead Keys. Developers then reviewed and re-edited that content. Most assets are licensed or purchased from artists. No generative AI runs during gameplay. The specific asset types affected are not stated.

games.raw: Generative AI tools were used during development to create some pre-generated visual assets, including certain ships, enemies, bosses, and visual effects. These assets were reviewed, selected, edited, and manually processed before being integrated into the game. HULLSTORM does not generate content using AI during gameplay.

a.sum: The developer used generative AI during development to create some pre-generated visual assets: certain ships, enemies, bosses, and visual effects. Humans reviewed, selected, edited, and manually processed these before integration. The game does not generate content with AI during gameplay.

games.raw: The visuals are generated by AI.
