games.n: Didgeridoo Man - The Legend of the Hill
games.raw: Generative AI is used in this game for tasks such as music generation. As an indie game and a small software development studio, we simply do not have the budget to license a large number of well-known and popular songs. Unfortunately, nothing comes for free – so AI is used as an alternative. AI is also used for tasks such as integrating graphics, music and beat analysis, and translating content. AI can complete time-consuming tasks within minutes that would otherwise take a human several hours. No jobs are being replaced or put at risk through the use of AI in this project. This “crazy game” was still made with lots of love by humans. An AI probably would not have come up with a game idea like this anyway. And because it fits the topic far too well: purely on principle, this disclosure text was of course also written with the help of AI.

a.sum: The developer discloses generative AI for music generation, used as a substitute for licensing popular songs. AI is also used for graphics integration, music and beat analysis, and translation. No live or in-game runtime generation is mentioned, so the timing of generation is unclear. The developer says no jobs were replaced and that the game was made by humans.

games.n: DESKTOP CLEANER 98: Tidy Up the Desktop

games.raw: AI-enabled tools were used during development to assist with asset creation. Some visual and audio assets in the finished game incorporate AI-assisted or AI-generated source material.

a.sum: The developer says AI-enabled tools assisted asset creation. Some visual and audio assets in the finished game use AI-assisted or AI-generated source material. The specific audio types are not stated, and no runtime or live generation is mentioned.

games.raw: Yes, Spell Death was made with AI. On purpose, out loud. Why? This is a game about a city that stopped reading. The demons here don't eat anyone. They need us. They keep the presses running, they copy everything and read nothing, and they are always hungry for more text. Sound familiar? I paid one to help me make this. Not made with AI: - The taste, the design, the systems and the balance. 10+ years of making mobile games and 30 years of collecting cards, building decks and theorycrafting. - The dictionary: a human-made list of about 196,000 words. (Even TRAGI. I still don't get TRAGI.) - Your words. Nothing is generated while you play. No suggestions, no autocomplete. There never will be. Made with AI: - Illustrations: image models, then picked, retouched and composed by hand. - Music: an AI music tool, directed by my taste for oriental and arabesque music and my obsession with the art deco and noir era. - Sound effects: most are synthesised from code, just math and stubbornness. A few come from the same AI music tool. - Code and some text: much of it drafted with an AI assistant, then edited, broken and fixed again by me. So I'm not standing outside the city pointing at it. I live here. A game about the trap, made from inside the trap. Art or hypocrisy, your call. (I've made mine.) The line, for me and for the game: a tool is fine, a proxy is not. The machine can draw a street. It doesn't get to do your reading, your thinking or your spelling. Still hate it? Fair. Spell something mean at it. It's a word game.

a.sum: Developer openly declares AI use. Illustrations are image-model outputs, then picked, retouched and composed by hand. Music comes from an AI music tool, directed by the developer. A few sound effects come from that tool; most are synthesised from code. Code and some text were drafted with an AI assistant, then edited by the developer. Nothing is generated during play. The dictionary, design, systems and words are human-made.

Generative AI was also used to remix the developer's own original melodies into background music. Both uses are development-time, with no runtime generation mentioned.

Audio includes music, voices, and sound effects. 3D models and animations are from licensed asset packs, not AI. Nothing is generated by AI during play.

games.raw: Investors and characters respond to the business idea you type, because a language model re-words our hand-written dialogue at runtime. It only changes wording — never numbers, outcomes, or anything in your save. If a generation fails, you get the hand-written line instead. Your product illustration is generated from your own idea text.

It changes only wording, not numbers, outcomes, or save data, and falls back to the hand-written line if generation fails. A product illustration is also generated at runtime from the player's idea text.

games.raw: Generative AI tools were used as part of the content creation process for this game: - Visual assets — some item, charm and UI sprites were generated with AI assistance and used as a base, then reviewed, reworked and finalized by the team before being integrated into the game - Store page artwork — AI image generation was used as a starting point, then reworked, recolored and finalized by the team to match the game's pixel art style A large part of the game's code was written with the help of AI coding assistants. All content was reviewed and approved by the team before shipping.

All content was team-reviewed before release. No live or in-game runtime generation is mentioned.

games.raw: Capsule artwork, minigame artwork, and UI assets were created using generative AI.

games.raw: AI image generation has been used on object artwork and asset creation

games.raw: Pending Review is made by one person using generative AI tools as part of the production pipeline. The visual art, including the desk, the documents, the applicant photographs and the cutscenes, was generated with AI tools and then selected, edited, composited and art directed by the developer. Some of the in-game text was written with AI assistance and edited by the developer. The game's design, its rules and its systems are the developer's own work. Nothing is generated by AI while you play. Every applicant, document, rule and outcome you encounter is produced by the game's own procedural systems from authored content, and the game does not connect to any AI service at runtime.

a.sum: The developer declares generative AI was used before release for visual art (desk, documents, applicant photographs), cutscenes, and some in-game text, all edited and art directed by the developer. Design, rules, and systems are stated as the developer's own work. Nothing is generated by AI during play, and the game does not connect to an AI service at runtime.

games.raw: Generative AI was used during development to assist in the creation of certain pre-generated visual assets, including some UI artwork, icons, textures, and other 2D art. All AI-assisted content was reviewed and integrated by the developer before being included in the game. The game does not use live-generated AI during gameplay.

a.sum: Developer declares generative AI was used during development to help create pre-generated visual assets such as some UI artwork, icons, textures, and other 2D art, all reviewed and integrated by the developer. No live-generated AI is used during gameplay.

games.raw: AI-generated content in this project is limited to the store page and marketing materials. The game build itself contains no AI-generated content. Store page text: The store description and Early Access questionnaire answers were drafted with the assistance of a large language model, then reviewed and edited by the developer. Not AI-generated: All in-game art, models, textures and animation. 3D assets are CC0-licensed (Kenney) or built by the developer in Blender; textures are CC0/licensed sets from Poly Haven, ambientCG and Poliigon. All screenshots and capsule images are real frames captured from the game's renderer, composited with the game's own title typography. No image generation model was used to produce any art in the game or on the store page.

a.sum: AI (a large language model) was used only to draft the store description and Early Access questionnaire answers, which the developer then reviewed and edited. The developer states the game build has no AI-generated content and that no image generation model was used for any art, in-game or on the store page. Art, models, textures, and animation are human-made or CC0/licensed, and screenshots are real captures.

games.n: Money Makes Money: Historical Market Simulator

games.raw: Generative AI was used for some textures and 3D models, as well as for English translation of both the game and its Steam store page. All original content, including the story, dialogue, archive documents, game design, level design, programming, and Chinese localization, was created by the developer.

games.raw: Generative AI was used to assist in creating some store promotional images with manual post-compositing. Generative AI was also used to produce part of the 2D assets within the game, and to assist with translation and localization for portions of the game text. All AI-assisted content has been reviewed, edited and refined by our development team.

All AI-assisted content was reviewed, edited, and refined by the team. No live or runtime generation is mentioned.

games.raw: Select visual artwork used in Comic Shop Tycoon, including some in-game comic and product artwork as well as Steam promotional artwork, was created using generative AI tools. All AI-generated content is pre-generated and fixed. The game does not generate AI content during gameplay or connect to external AI services while running.

a.sum: Some visual artwork is AI-generated: in-game comic and product artwork, plus Steam promotional artwork. All AI content is pre-generated and fixed. The game does not generate AI content during gameplay or connect to external AI services at runtime.

games.raw: AI tools assisted with some visual assets, music, and localization. All AI-assisted content was reviewed and edited by the developer.

games.raw: Some background images and illustrations in this game are pre-generated content created using generative AI. These assets have been reviewed and, where necessary, adjusted by the developer before being included.

a.sum: The developer discloses that some background images and illustrations are pre-generated with generative AI. The developer reviewed and, where needed, adjusted these assets before inclusion. No live or runtime generation is mentioned.

games.raw: Cover art, store page imagery and music were created with AI generation tools. All game design, writing and gameplay systems were created by the developer.

a.sum: AI tools were used to create cover art, store page imagery, and music. Game design, writing, and gameplay systems were created by the developer, and no live AI generation is described.

games.raw: Certain UI elements and regional logos were created with the assistance of AI.

a.sum: The developer discloses that certain UI elements and regional logos were created with AI assistance. The text does not say whether any content is generated live during play.

games.raw: All programming and game music (BGM) are generated by AI.

a.sum: Developer states that all programming and game background music (BGM) were generated by AI. The disclosure does not say whether the content is pre-generated or live-generated.

games.raw: Generative AI was used during development as an assistive tool for some 2D art including weapon reload animation frames and magazine props

a.sum: The developer disclosed that generative AI was used during development as an assistive tool for some 2D art, specifically weapon reload animation frames and magazine props. No live or in-game runtime generation is mentioned.

games.raw: The artwork in this game — the title screen, the application icon, the difficulty-selection backgrounds, the plate textures behind buttons and panels, and the store art — and background music tracks were created with generative AI tools, then selected and adjusted by the developer. The puzzle boards, pieces and target patterns are drawn procedurally, the sound effects are synthesized at runtime, and every puzzle is produced by a deterministic solver. No content is generated live during gameplay.

a.sum: Generative AI was used to create pre-generated artwork (title screen, app icon, difficulty-selection backgrounds, button and panel plate textures, store art) and background music tracks, which the developer then selected and adjusted. Puzzle boards, pieces, and target patterns are procedural, sound effects are synthesized at runtime, and puzzles come from a deterministic solver. No content is generated live during gameplay.

games.raw: The game's characters, environment tiles, and totem were created by the developer in Aseprite. Additional enemy variants and animation frames were produced with the help of an AI coding assistant that draws sprites programmatically from authored pixel data. The menu music was created with the help of AI music tools. All promotional and store artwork was created by a human artist. No content is generated by AI while the game is running.

a.sum: AI was used before release, not during play. An AI coding assistant programmatically drew extra enemy variants and animation frames from authored pixel data, and AI music tools helped create the menu music. Characters, tiles, and the totem are human-made, and all promotional and store art is by a human artist. The disclosure states no content is generated while the game runs.

games.raw: AI tools were used during development solely to assist with coding, including identifying and fixing bugs and making minor code corrections and improvements. AI does not generate any content for players during gameplay.

a.sum: AI was used during development only for coding assistance: identifying and fixing bugs and making minor code corrections and improvements. The developer states AI generates no content for players during gameplay.

games.raw: Used just in marketing materials. None used in-game.

a.sum: AI was used only in marketing materials. The developer states no AI-generated content is used in-game. The disclosure does not say whether the content is pre-generated or live-generated.

games.raw: Generative AI was used in two parts of this game's development, and a human reviewed everything it produced before it shipped. The soundtrack was created with the assistance of AI. Some writing was drafted with an AI assistant and then edited: in-game text such as card, interface and help text; the non-English translations; and the store page and marketing copy. Nothing else is model output. The logo, the app icon and every visual in the game are drawn by code in the project's own source, from its palette and geometry — there are no painted or generated image assets. The sound effects are synthesized as you play rather than shipped as recordings.

a.sum: AI was used to create the soundtrack and to draft writing (in-game card, interface and help text, non-English translations, and store page and marketing copy), all edited and reviewed by a human before shipping. Visuals (logo, app icon, in-game art) are code-drawn, and sound effects are synthesized procedurally in-game, not AI-generated. No live AI generation is declared.

games.raw: Some visual assets (sprites and promotional art) were created with generative AI tools and then edited. The game does not generate AI content at runtime.

a.sum: Sprites and promotional art were created with generative AI tools and then edited. No AI content is generated at runtime.

games.raw: This game includes content created with the help of generative AI. The base 3D animal models were generated using an AI 3D-modeling tool and then rigged, animated, and hand-finished by the developer. Non-English translations were initially AI-drafted and then reviewed and corrected by the developer. All content is final and reviewed before release — no AI content is generated while you play.

a.sum: Generative AI was used to create the base 3D animal models, which the developer then rigged, animated, and hand-finished. Non-English translations were AI-drafted and then reviewed and corrected by the developer. All AI content is pre-generated and reviewed before release, with no AI generation during play.

games.raw: AI is used only to translate the game description on the Steam store page into multiple languages.

a.sum: AI is used only to translate the Steam store page game description into multiple languages. No other AI use is declared, and no live or in-game generation is mentioned.

games.raw: Broken Rift: Dominion includes a packaged offline language model used within its diplomacy and faction-strategy systems. The model interprets structured game state to produce personality-consistent diplomatic communications and strategic preferences. Its outputs are constrained by the game’s rules. Processing occurs entirely on the player’s device, and no data is transmitted to external AI services. All pre-rendered visual artwork was created using generative AI under developer direction. This includes environment backgrounds, interface and menu artwork, branding, icons, and promotional/title-card images.

a.sum: Declares an offline, on-device language model that generates personality-consistent diplomatic communications and strategic preferences during play, constrained by game rules, with no data sent to external AI services. Pre-rendered artwork (environment backgrounds, interface and menu art, branding, icons, promotional and title-card images) was created with generative AI under developer direction.

games.raw: Some of the art assets in the game were created using AI.

games.raw: AI has been used to generate some of the text in game (for example tutorials, some chronicle entries) and was used as an assistance to coding and bug-fixing.

We also used AI assistance while writing and restructuring parts of our codebase. Everything players see and hear — art, animation, sound, music, game design and all original writing — was made by people.

a.sum: The developer declares AI use for French, Spanish, Italian, Japanese and Korean localisations, and for AI-assisted writing and restructuring of parts of the codebase. All art, animation, sound, music, game design and original writing are stated to be human-made. No runtime or live generation is mentioned.

games.raw: Music, backgrounds, and UI interfaces created using generative AI.

a.sum: The developer discloses generative AI use for music, backgrounds, and UI interfaces. The disclosure says these were 'created' with generative AI but does not state whether any content is generated live during play.

games.raw: Generative AI tools were used in creating the game's illustrations, artwork, cutscene images, map designs, and sound, as well as throughout development, and in writing and revising the story. All AI-assisted content was directed, reviewed, and finalized by our team.

a.sum: Developer discloses generative AI use for illustrations, artwork, cutscene images, map designs, and sound, plus development work and story writing and revision. All AI-assisted content was directed, reviewed, and finalized by the team. No live or runtime generation is mentioned.

games.raw: Generative AI was used to create some of the illustrations featured on collectible cards. The card layouts and designs were manually created and edited.

a.sum: Generative AI was used to create some illustrations on collectible cards. The card layouts and designs were manually created and edited by the developer. No live or runtime generation is mentioned.

games.raw: Some artwork and promotional images used on the Steam store page were created with assistance from generative AI and subsequently reviewed and approved by humans. The game’s narrative voice-over uses pre-generated text-to-speech audio. No content is generated in real time during gameplay.

a.sum: Developer discloses generative AI assistance for some store page artwork and promotional images, human-reviewed and approved. Narrative voice-over uses pre-generated text-to-speech audio. No content is generated in real time during gameplay.

games.raw: Generative AI was used in the development of some UI elements of the game.

a.sum: The developer discloses that generative AI was used in developing some UI elements. The disclosure does not say whether the content was pre-generated or generated live, and it does not specify which UI elements.

games.raw: This game uses AI generation tools at several stages of development. - Artwork: the card illustrations and key art use images produced with AI image-generation tools. The developer selected, cropped, and adjusted the outputs — and discarded the ones that did not fit — before integrating them into the game. - Text: card flavor text and story prose were drafted with AI assistance, then edited and finalized by the developer. The world setting and narrative structure were decided by the developer. - Localization: the English text was translated with AI assistance and reviewed by the developer. - Voice: the narration in the store trailers uses AI text-to-speech. - Voice: the narration in the store trailers and the voice lines of the in-game guide (the angel) use AI text-to-speech. No content is generated by AI while the game is running. Everything is pre-generated during development.

a.sum: AI image generation was used for card illustrations and key art, with the developer selecting, cropping, adjusting, and discarding outputs. AI assisted drafting of card flavor text and story prose, which the developer edited and finalized. AI assisted translation of English text, reviewed by the developer. AI text-to-speech produces store trailer narration and in-game guide (angel) voice lines. No content is generated while the game runs; everything is pre-generated during development.

games.raw: We used Artificial Intelligence tools as an aid during development and in the creation of some game content. All AI-assisted material was personally reviewed and adjusted by our team, who were involved throughout every stage of the creative process.

a.sum: The developer states AI tools were used as an aid during development and in creating some game content, with all AI-assisted material reviewed and adjusted by the team. The disclosure does not specify which content types were affected, and does not say whether content is pre-generated or generated live during play.

games.raw: The in-game voiceover is pre-recorded using a text-to-speech AI model. Assets including models, images, music, and UIs are generated by AI, then reviewed and adjusted by human professionals.

a.sum: Developer discloses AI use: in-game voiceover is pre-recorded with a text-to-speech model. Models, images, music, and UIs are AI-generated, then reviewed and adjusted by human professionals. No live or runtime generation is mentioned.

games.raw: Portions of this game were created with the assistance of generative AI tools: some 3D models and textures and the translations of in-game text from English into other languages. All AI-assisted content was reviewed, edited, and integrated by the development team, and no AI-generated content is created live at runtime.

a.sum: Developer discloses generative AI was used for some 3D models, some textures, and translating in-game text from English into other languages. All AI-assisted content was reviewed, edited, and integrated by the team; no content is generated live at runtime.

games.raw: This game uses generative AI for some background images and landscape assets. All AI-generated materials are reviewed and edited by the developer before being used in the game. Generative AI is not used during gameplay, and the game does not connect to external AI services to generate content.

a.sum: The developer declares generative AI for some background images and landscape assets. All AI-generated material is reviewed and edited by the developer before use. Generative AI is not used during gameplay, and the game does not connect to external AI services to generate content.

games.raw: Character artwork for Giusto’s characters that represent each tier of the player’s journey began as AI-generated concept art, conceptualized, directed and reviewed by our team to match the the art direction of the game. 3D character models were generated from this concept art using Tripo AI’s image-to-3D tool, then reviewed and integrated into the game by our development team. From which, the final 3D models were designed and styled within Unreal Engine 5 to fit the feel of our game. All game design, music and other content were built directly by our team and purchased and licensed human-made asset packs.

a.sum: AI was used before release to generate concept art for the game's character artwork, which the team directed and reviewed. Tripo AI's image-to-3D tool then produced 3D character models from that concept art, and the team refined them in Unreal Engine 5. Game design, music, and other content are stated to be human-made or licensed human-made asset packs. No live or runtime generation is mentioned.

games.raw: We’d like to be transparent about the localization of THE WRONG WAY ROUND. Some of the game’s translations have been created with the assistance of AI and then reviewed and adjusted by us. This allows us to make the game available to more players and support more languages than we could otherwise manage. We’re continuously improving the translations and really appreciate any feedback from native speakers.

a.sum: The developer discloses that some translations for THE WRONG WAY ROUND were created with AI assistance and then reviewed and adjusted by the team. AI use is limited to localization, and the text does not mention any live or runtime generation.

games.raw: AI was used to assist with localised translations.

a.sum: The developer discloses that AI was used to assist with localized translations. The disclosure does not say whether the output is pre-generated or generated live.

games.raw: AI-assisted coding and editor automation tools were used during development for workflow efficiency. Most of the art was hand-made by me. The remaining art generated by AI tools like icons or textures will be swapped to human-made art in the near future. AI translation tools were used to create localization drafts, that are being reviewed by speakers of the language.

a.sum: Developer discloses AI use for coding and editor automation during development, AI-generated icons and textures (to be replaced with human-made art), and AI translation drafts for localization that are being reviewed by native speakers. Most art is hand-made. No live-generated content is mentioned.

games.raw: We are team of two with a design and development background. We have a combined decades experience shipping production-quality code and art. We use AI along with our other tools, like Blender, Substance, Gaea etc. to help us build our vision. We use AI in the early stage of concept development, prototyping assets, and coding assistance. The music is played by hand using real instruments. All screen captures are 100% in-game with no alterations.

a.sum: Developers disclose AI use during development: early concept development, prototyping assets (asset types not specified), and coding assistance, alongside tools like Blender, Substance, and Gaea. games.raw: All shipped assets are first-party, come from CC0/OFL-licensed human-made packs, or are built from royalty-free licensed human-made sound recordings (Sonniss #GameAudioGDC). Two small engine-side pieces are MIT-licensed open-source material: Godot's built-in text-field menu labels and a shader routine adapted from AMD FidelityFX FSR 1. Some 3D meshes (enemy armor fused onto CC0 base rigs, the drone, weapon models), the entire soundtrack and the processing of the sound effects are produced by deterministic, first-party procedural build scripts; those scripts were written with the help of an AI code assistant. No image-, audio- or voice-generation model produced any shipped asset. The game's written text — squad comms, item and mission descriptions, narrative screens — and this store page's English copy were drafted with AI assistance under developer direction, then reviewed and edited by the developer. The translations of the game and of this store page into eleven other languages were produced with AI assistance under developer direction. The game contains no runtime or live AI generation.

a.sum: AI assistance was used for pre-release work only: an AI code assistant helped write the procedural build scripts that produce the soundtrack, sound-effect processing, and some 3D meshes; AI drafted the in-game text (squad comms, item and mission descriptions, narrative screens) and the English store page copy, which the developer reviewed and edited; and AI helped produce the eleven-language translations of the game and store page. No image, audio, or voice generation model produced any shipped asset, and the game has no runtime or live AI generation. Other assets are first-party, CC0/OFL, royalty-free licensed, or MIT-licensed open-source material.

games.raw: Generative AI tools were used during development to assist in creating some 2D graphics, visual effects, and sound effects. AI-generated outputs are reviewed and edited before being used in the game. The game does not use generative AI or generate AI content during gameplay.

games.raw: This game uses generative AI tools as part of its art creation process. All AI-assisted content is checked to ensure it meets our quality and originality standards.

games.raw: Some in-game card illustrations were created with the assistance of generative AI during development. No content is generated by AI during gameplay, and the game does not connect to any external AI services while playing.

AI was used only as a development tool (code assistance, regression tests, workflow tooling) and for placeholder visuals, which are included temporarily and will be replaced over time. Voice, SFX, VFX, music, and design are human-made. No live generation is declared.

In-game visuals, UI, wordmark and achievement icons are programmatic and contain no AI content. No generative AI runs at runtime.

games.raw: Fliprium contains visual artwork, music, and sound effects created with the assistance of generative AI tools. a.sum: Fliprium uses generative AI for visual artwork (OpenAI image tools), music (Suno), and sound effects (ElevenLabs). The developer selected, edited, and integrated these assets during production. No live or runtime generation is mentioned.

games.raw: CrashFest is a one-person game, built in Unity between coffee and complaints from playtesters. It started as a physics experiment about shoving a low-poly car off a ledge and got out of hand once six controllers were plugged in. I’m a software engineer, not an artist. So a good chunk of CrashFest was made together with Claude AI — art direction, shaders, menus, the visual bits I’d never have drawn on my own — and the soundtrack comes out of Suno. The code, the physics and every questionable design decision are mine.

a.sum: AI was used during development, not at runtime. Claude AI helped with art direction, shaders, and menus. Suno generated the soundtrack. The code, physics, and design are stated to be the developer's own.

games.raw: AI was used to assist with text translation into Italian, Portuguese, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Norwegian, Swedish and German. The translations are used in the store page and in-game. No other content in this game uses AI.

The developer states no other content uses AI. The disclosure does not say whether the translations are pre-generated or generated live.

games.raw: The background artwork in Hand Stretched — the shopfront, the kitchen and bar scenery, and the shop sign — was generated using Adobe Firefly, then edited and assembled by hand. Everything you actually interact with is drawn by the game itself: the pizzas, the dough, the drinks and the icons are rendered in code as you play, not painted images. The music is not AI-generated. It is four tracks licensed from human artists on Pixabay, credited by name in the game's settings. The game's code was written with AI assistance. Nothing is generated while you play, and the game connects to no AI service.

a.sum: Background artwork (shopfront, kitchen and bar scenery, shop sign) was generated with Adobe Firefly, then edited and assembled by hand. Interactive visuals (pizzas, dough, drinks, icons) are rendered in code, not AI images. Music is not AI-generated: four human-artist tracks licensed from Pixabay and credited in settings. Game code was written with AI assistance. Nothing is generated during play and no AI service is connected.

games.raw: AI-assisted tools were used during development to help refine and polish text localization.

games.raw: AI tools were used in development: core gameplay is the developer’s original design; story, dialogue and theme-song lyrics were written with AI text tools and reviewed by the developer; 3D models for characters, enemies, environment props and some items were generated with AI (Meshy); character motion reference videos were generated with an AI video tool (Jimeng), and some character animations with an AI pixel-animation tool (PixelLab), all adjusted by the team into pixel animation; character portraits, story CGs, codex illustrations and store art were generated with AI imaging (GPT Image) and selected and edited by the team; background music and the theme song were generated with AI (Suno); story voice-over and some sound effects were generated with AI voice and sound tools (ElevenLabs; voices are designed or licensed, not clones of real people). No AI content is generated at runtime.

a.sum: AI was used during development, pre-generating content. Story, dialogue and theme-song lyrics were AI-written and developer-reviewed. 3D models (characters, enemies, props, items) came from Meshy. Motion reference videos (Jimeng) and some pixel animations (PixelLab) were adjusted by the team. Portraits, story CGs, codex illustrations and store art were AI-generated (GPT Image) and curated. Background music and theme song were made with Suno. Voice-over and some sound effects came from ElevenLabs, with no clones of real people. Core gameplay is original, and no AI content is generated at runtime.

games.raw: Arcane Dash was developed by a solo developer with contractor support. AI generated content: Music, cutscene artwork, and the logo were created with generative AI tools and reviewed and edited by the developer before inclusion. Translations: Produced using machine translation tools and reviewed by the developer for basic consistency. Not verified by native speakers. Human created content: All levels, character sprites, sound effects, and marketing materials (other than the logo) were created entirely by the developer and contractors without AI involvement. Live generated AI content: None. No content is generated by AI during gameplay.

a.sum: Arcane Dash declares AI use for pre-generated music, cutscene artwork, and the logo (reviewed and edited by the developer), plus machine-translated text reviewed for basic consistency but not by native speakers. Levels, character sprites, sound effects, and other marketing materials are stated as human-made. No AI content is generated during gameplay.

games.raw: Portions of the UI, all character, monster and item icons, translations, BGM and some sound effects in this game are AI-generated.

a.sum: The developer discloses AI-generated content in portions of the UI, all character, monster and item icons, translations, BGM, and some sound effects. The disclosure does not say whether the content is pre-generated or generated live during play.

games.raw: Generative AI was used as a supporting tool for the creation and refinement of text content and graphical assets used in the game and/or on the Steam store page.

a.sum: Developer says generative AI supported the creation and refinement of text content and graphical assets used in the game and/or on the Steam store page. No live or runtime generation is mentioned.

games.raw: Used as a translation tool for localizing the game's text.

a.sum: The developer used an AI tool as a translation tool to localize the game's text. The disclosure does not mention live or runtime generation.

games.raw: Some art assets are generated by AI and then manually optimized and adjusted.

a.sum: The developer discloses that some art assets were generated by AI and then manually optimized and adjusted. The disclosure does not specify which asset types are affected and does not mention any live or runtime generation.

games.raw: AI-assisted coding tools were used during development to help write and debug game scripts. No AI-generated artwork, audio, dialogue, localization, or other player-facing content is included, and no AI content is generated during gameplay.

a.sum: AI-assisted coding tools were used during development to help write and debug game scripts. No AI-generated artwork, audio, dialogue, localization, or other player-facing content is included, and no AI content is generated during gameplay.

games.raw: Generative AI-assisted tools were used in parts of the development process, including selected visual assets, 3D models, music/audio, and promotional materials. These elements are reviewed and integrated by the developer as part of the game's overall creative direction. No generative AI is used to create content live during gameplay.

a.sum: The developer declares AI-assisted tools were used in parts of development for selected visual assets, 3D models, music/audio, and promotional materials, all reviewed and integrated by the developer. No generative AI creates content live during gameplay.

games.raw: Guildfire uses pre-generated AI-assisted content in parts of its visual art, localization, sound effects, and soundtrack. AI-generated material is manually selected, edited, and integrated by the developer. No generative AI is used during gameplay, and the game does not connect to external AI services at runtime.

a.sum: Guildfire discloses AI-assisted pre-generated content in parts of its visual art, localization, sound effects, and soundtrack, which the developer manually selects, edits, and integrates. No generative AI runs during gameplay and the game makes no runtime connections to external AI services.

games.raw: AI tools were used during development solely to assist with coding, including identifying and fixing bugs and making minor code corrections and improvements. AI does not generate any content for players during gameplay.

a.sum: AI tools were used during development only for coding tasks: identifying and fixing bugs and making minor code corrections and improvements. The developer states AI does not generate any content for players during gameplay.

games.raw: In a particularly fitting twist for a game about artificial intelligence whose protagonist is herself an artificial intelligence, generative AI tools were used during development to assist with some pre-generated visual assets, music, and portions of the text and localization. All AI-assisted content was reviewed, edited, and curated by the developer. No generative AI is used during gameplay.

a.sum: The developer used generative AI during development for pre-generated visual assets, music, and portions of text and localization. All AI-assisted content was reviewed, edited, and curated by the developer. No generative AI is used during gameplay.

games.raw: Generative AI is used for translation in this game.

a.sum: The developer discloses that generative AI is used for translation. The disclosure does not say whether translations are pre-generated or produced live.

games.raw: All historical data is researched and verified by the developer from published records. Some in-game descriptive text (event descriptions, class histories) and the player's guide were drafted with AI assistance under the developer's editorial control and review. No AI-generated artwork, audio or photographs are used.

a.sum: AI assisted in drafting some in-game descriptive text (event descriptions, class histories) and the player's guide, under developer editorial control and review. Historical data was researched by the developer. No AI-generated artwork, audio, or photographs are used. No runtime generation is mentioned.

games.raw: During the development of this game, generative AI was used to assist with the creation of some art assets, sound effects, music, text translations, and development reference materials. All AI-assisted generated content was manually reviewed, edited, integrated, and approved before being included in the game. No content is generated in real time based on player input during gameplay.

a.sum: Developer declares generative AI was used during development for some art assets, sound effects, music, text translations, and development reference materials. All such content was manually reviewed, edited, integrated, and approved. No content is generated in real time from player input during gameplay.

games.raw: This game uses generative AI during development to create some of the visual assets included in the game. AI-generated assets are reviewed and edited as needed before being incorporated into the final game. The game does not use generative AI to create content dynamically during gameplay.

a.sum: The developer uses generative AI during development to create some visual assets that are included in the game. These assets are reviewed and edited before inclusion. The game does not generate content dynamically during gameplay.

games.raw: Veil of Time is a hand-built game. The maps, the writing, the music, the interface, and the game design are all human work. Generative AI was used in five specific places, each reviewed and finished by hand: 1. Voice acting. Every line of dialogue and every in-game book can be spoken aloud (3,707 voice clips), synthesized with ElevenLabs from the game's own written script. We chose this so the story stays open to players with low vision or reading difficulties, and to younger players who are not fast readers yet. A voice cast of this size would otherwise be out of reach for a small studio. No performance was cloned from a real person without licence. 2. Character and bestiary portraits, generated from the game's original hand-made sprites and finished by hand. 3. Some character sprites and the party's battle animation sheets, produced with AI assistance from the project's own hand-drawn art, then hand-corrected and palette-locked. 4. The intro and outro cinematic stills, the title screen, and the store key art. 5. Ambient critters and butterflies, converted from hand-made source art. Everything else you see, read, and hear was made by people.

a.sum: AI is used in five pre-generated areas, each hand-reviewed and finished: (1) ElevenLabs synthesized voice for all dialogue and in-game books (3,707 clips) from the human-written script, with no unlicensed cloning of real performers; (2) character and bestiary portraits generated from hand-made sprites; (3) some character sprites and party battle animation sheets made with AI assistance from hand-drawn art, then hand-corrected; (4) intro/outro cinematic stills, the title screen, and store key art; (5) ambient critters and butterflies converted from hand-made source art. The developer states everything else is human-made. No live or runtime generation is mentioned.

games.raw: The booth announcer's voice (Chuck Baseball) is generated with ElevenLabs from a script written by the developers. AI tools also assisted with translating the game's text into Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Italian and French.

a.sum: AI generates the booth announcer's voice (Chuck Baseball) with ElevenLabs from a developer-written script. AI tools assisted translating the game's text into seven languages: Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Italian and French. No runtime generation is mentioned.

games.raw: The Settings and Guide Texts are partially generated by generative AI.

a.sum: The developer discloses that the game's Settings and Guide Texts are partially generated by generative AI. The disclosure does not say whether the content is pre-generated or generated live.

games.raw: This game was made with the help of generative AI. AI tools assisted in various parts of development, including code, art, and music.

a.sum: Developer declares generative AI assisted development, including code, art, and music. Art is not broken down by type or location, so it is mapped to 'other'. The disclosure does not say whether content is pre-generated or generated live during play.

games.raw: During the development process, we may use procedural- and AI-based tools to assist with content creation. In all such cases, the final product reflects the creativity and expression of our own development team.

a.sum: The developer says they 'may use' procedural and AI-based tools to assist with content creation during development, and that the final product reflects their team's creativity. The disclosure names no specific content types and does not say whether AI generates content before release or at runtime.

games.n: SUNSTONE: A Tale of the Briar King
games.raw: Translation: AI tools assisted with translating the game's text into Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Italian and French.

a.sum: AI tools assisted with translating the game's text into seven languages: Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Italian, and French. No live or runtime generation is mentioned.

games.raw: I am a solo developer trying to get my dream games built. I'm tired of working for big companies that don't care about the joy of making and playing games. AI is helping me make these games. - I know how to make games, so I did all of the game direction, production, design, VO, and (most of the) writing, However, I am not an artist, so I use AI art tools to help me create most of the art for the game. - I use AI code to help check my work, write code for me if I can't figure it out myself and help ensure that the game works correctly. - The music is a mix of human written and mastered with AI compositions.

a.sum: Solo developer used AI art tools for most of the game's art, AI code assistance for checking, writing, and debugging code, and a mix of human-written and AI-composed music that was AI-mastered. Direction, design, voice acting, and most writing are stated as human-made. No live or in-game generation is mentioned.

games.raw: AI tools were used to create artwork and audio assets, including store and marketing artwork. No AI content is generated during gameplay.

a.sum: AI tools were used to create artwork, including store and marketing art, and audio assets (type unspecified). No AI content is generated during gameplay.

games.raw: Some of the 2D artwork used for this game's branding and store page - including the app icon and the key art - was created with the help of generative AI image tools, then cropped, edited and finalized by hand. No AI-generated content is produced while you play: all gameplay, 3D models, animation and audio come from licensed or hand-authored assets.

a.sum: Some 2D branding and store-page artwork (app icon, key art) was created with generative AI image tools, then cropped, edited, and finalized by hand. No AI content is generated during gameplay; 3D models, animation, and audio come from licensed or hand-authored assets.

games.raw: AI was used to assist with the translation of the game's text into supported languages. No generative AI was used to create the game's art, music, or other game content.

a.sum: The developer disclosed that AI assisted with translating the game's text into supported languages. The disclosure states that no generative AI was used to create art, music, or other game content.

games.raw: Part of the game's code was generated and optimized with the assistance of AI development tools during the development process. Some store presentation materials (including the game logo, icon, and background images) were also created with the assistance of AI tools and have been manually reviewed to ensure they do not contain infringing content. All in-game art assets are legally purchased from third-party asset stores or obtained from open-source resources, and are used in accordance with the licenses provided by the respective authors.

a.sum: AI tools were used during development to generate and optimize part of the game's code, and to create store presentation materials (logo, icon, background images), which were manually reviewed for infringing content. All in-game art is stated to be purchased from third-party asset stores or taken from open-source resources and used under their licenses, so no AI use is declared for in-game art. No runtime or live-generated content is mentioned.

games.raw: Some 2D artwork was created with the assistance of AI image-generation tools (the mascot character portrait, generated with Recraft and then hand-edited; it appears in-game and in store artwork). All gameplay, code, design, text and audio are made by hand. The game does not use live/runtime AI generation.

a.sum: AI image-generation tools (Recraft) were used to create the mascot character portrait, which was then hand-edited. It appears in-game and in store artwork. All gameplay, code, design, text and audio are hand-made. No live/runtime AI generation.

games.raw: Generative AI is used for localization.

a.sum: The developer declares generative AI is used for localization. The disclosure does not say whether the content is pre-generated or generated live, so live generation is unstated.

games.raw: Some pre-generated visual and audio assets in AI Startup Simulator were created with the assistance of generative AI tools during development. This includes in-game desktop wallpapers, images used in vision-related tasks, and instrumental music loops for minigames. These assets were reviewed, edited, and integrated by the development team before release. The game does not use live generative AI and does not generate content with AI during gameplay.

a.sum: Generative AI was used during development to create some pre-generated visual and audio assets: desktop wallpapers, images for vision-related tasks, and instrumental music loops for minigames. The team reviewed, edited, and integrated these before release. The game does not use live generative AI and generates no content with AI during gameplay.

games.raw: Steam capsules are AI generated. SFXs are AI generated. Nothing else in the game is AI generated.

a.sum: The developer discloses AI-generated Steam capsules (store art) and sound effects. They state nothing else in the game is AI-generated. The text does not say whether the content is pre-generated or generated live.

games.raw: AI tools wer used to help with graphical assets on Steam page

a.sum: The developer says AI tools were used to help with graphical assets on the Steam page. The disclosure does not say whether content was pre-generated or generated live in-game.

games.raw: AI-assisted concept references, music, voice-over and short video clips; gameplay, levels and code are hand-made. Nothing is generated while playing.

a.sum: The developer discloses AI-assisted concept references, music, voice-over, and short video clips, all created before release. Gameplay, levels, and code are hand-made, and nothing is generated during play.

games.raw: This game uses AI-assisted tools in the development of certain in-game visuals and assets. Additionally, AI tools were used to assist in the localization and translation of in-game text content. All AI-generated content has been reviewed and edited by the development team. No AI is used to generate content during gameplay, and the game does not connect to any external AI services at runtime.

a.sum: AI tools were used during development for certain in-game visuals and assets and to assist localization/translation of in-game text. All AI output was reviewed and edited by the team. No AI generates content during gameplay and the game makes no runtime connection to external AI services.

games.raw: Generative AI was used in the creation of the background images and certain sound elements of this game.

a.sum: Generative AI was used to create the game's background images and certain sound elements. The disclosure describes creation of these assets, not runtime generation. 'Sound elements' is vague and may not mean strictly sound effects.

games.n: Potato.exe - A Game About Spinning a Wheel to Download Potatoes

games.raw: Game and Store Page localizations (excluding English) were AI-generated.

a.sum: The developer discloses that non-English localizations of the game and its Store Page were AI-generated. The disclosure does not say whether generation is pre-generated or live, and it does not mention English text or any other content.

games.raw: Generative AI was used to assist in creating select background artwork and visual assets for the game. All assets were manually edited and refined before being integrated.

a.sum: Generative AI assisted in creating select background artwork and visual assets, which were manually edited and refined before integration. The disclosure describes pre-generated static assets and does not mention live or runtime generation.

games.raw: Generative AI tools were used to assist in creating some pre-generated 3D models, textures, and promotional assets. All AI-assisted material is reviewed and edited by the developer before inclusion. The game does not generate AI content during gameplay.

a.sum: Developer declares generative AI was used to assist creating some pre-generated 3D models, textures, and promotional assets, all reviewed and edited by the developer. The game explicitly does not generate AI content during gameplay.

games.raw: Some character art and store artwork were created with generative AI tools and then human edited and composited. The game contains no AI generated content created at runtime.

a.sum: Some character art and store artwork were generated with AI tools, then human-edited and composited. No AI-generated content is created at runtime.

games.raw: Visual assets in this game — symbol icons, charm icons, user interface elements, machine and objective icons, and store artwork — were created with generative AI tools and then selected, edited, sized and integrated by hand. Game code was written with AI assistance under human direction. Design, balancing decisions and final text are authored by the developer.

a.sum: AI tools generated visual assets (symbol, charm, UI, machine and objective icons, and store artwork), which the developer then selected, edited, sized, and integrated by hand. Game code was written with AI assistance under human direction. Design, balancing, and final text are developer-authored. No runtime or live generation is mentioned.

games.raw: Generative AI tools helped create and refine some concept art, and marketing images for this game. The game does not generate new AI content while you play.

a.sum: Generative AI tools helped create and refine some concept art and marketing images. The game does not generate new AI content during play.

games.raw: AI was used to generate some game assets.

a.sum: The developer states that AI was used to generate some game assets. The disclosure does not specify the asset types, whether generation was pre-generated or live, or any other details.

games.raw: We used A.I. in some assets of our game.

a.sum: Developer states AI was used in some unspecified game assets. No asset types, generation timing, or live-generation use are given.

games.raw: I am a solo developer leveraging AI to improve my efficiency while moonlighting this project. Hence, many temporary AI-generated assets make their way into the game but I hope to replace over 90% of those with handcrafted assets over time.

a.sum: Solo developer uses AI to improve efficiency. Many temporary AI-generated assets are in the game, with a plan to replace over 90% with handcrafted assets over time. The specific asset types and whether generation is pre-generated or live are not stated.

games.raw: AI was used only for the capsule image creation, and localization.

a.sum: The developer states AI was used only for creating the capsule image (store art) and for localization. The disclosure does not say whether any content is generated live or pre-generated.

games.raw: We used A.I. in some assets of our game.

a.sum: Developer states AI was used in some unspecified game assets. No generation type or specific usage scope is given, and live generation is not mentioned.

games.raw: Artificial intelligence was used to help translate and improve the game's dialogue, as well as to generate some dialogue. AI was also used to create artwork for the game's Steam page and logo. No AI-generated artwork was used in the game itself.

a.sum: AI was used to translate and improve the game's dialogue, to generate some dialogue, and to create artwork for the Steam page and logo. The developer states no AI-generated artwork is used in the game itself. Live or runtime generation is not mentioned.

games.raw: Some 2D art in Kyle Coral — including certain background/scene art and store and marketing images — is created with the help of generative AI image tools and then reviewed and edited by the developer. The game's core gameplay visuals are generated procedurally in code.

a.sum: Some 2D art (background/scene art and store and marketing images) was created with generative AI image tools and then reviewed and edited by the developer. Core gameplay visuals are procedurally generated in code, which the disclosure does not describe as AI.

games.raw: Much of the art in Glims was made with the help of generative AI. Character reference art was produced with an AI image tool and turned into 3D meshes with Meshy; every model was then cleaned up, re-rigged, animated and hand-tuned by us. The collectible card illustrations and the 2D art for the Invasion mode were generated the same way. All game code, design, UI layout and animation work is human-made, and third-party art is credited in-game under Settings > Credits. No generative AI runs while you play - nothing is generated live.

a.sum: Developer declares generative AI was used before release for character reference art (AI image tool), 3D meshes (Meshy, then hand-cleaned, re-rigged, and animated), collectible card illustrations, and Invasion mode 2D art. Code, design, UI layout, and animation are stated as human-made. No AI runs during play.

games.raw: Generative artificial intelligence has been used to create store page thumbnails based on the developer's scene work.

a.sum: Generative AI was used to create store page thumbnails based on the developer's scene work. No in-game or live-generated content is mentioned.

games.raw: Generative AI tools were used in the development of this game, including character art and sprites, backgrounds and environment art, sound effects and music, in-game text and narrative content, and store page assets such as screenshots and marketing images. All AI-assisted content was reviewed and curated by the developer before being included in the game.

a.sum: The developer declares generative AI use for character art and sprites, backgrounds and environment art, sound effects and music, in-game text and narrative, and store page assets such as screenshots and marketing images. All AI-assisted content was reviewed and curated before inclusion, indicating pre-generated content. Live generation is not mentioned.

games.raw: AI was used in the creation of in-game graphics, music, and translations. All generated content was selected, reviewed, and edited by the developer before being included in the game.

a.sum: The developer discloses AI use for in-game graphics, music, and translations. All generated content was selected, reviewed, and edited by the developer before inclusion, which indicates pre-generated content. Live generation is not mentioned.
