games.raw: We use AI to create stylized versions of original artwork, generate character videos, and assist with translation and localization. These assets and translations are prepared during development. No AI content is generated during gameplay, and the game does not connect to external AI services during gameplay.

a.sum: The developer declares AI use for stylized versions of original artwork (scope not specified), character videos, and translation/localization. All AI content is prepared during development. No AI content is generated during gameplay, and the game does not connect to external AI services during gameplay.

games.raw: AI-assisted coding tools were used during development to support programming and code iteration. The visual assets, including tanks, ammunition, and vehicles are our own and come from our channels, Yarnub and Blue Paw Print.

a.sum: AI-assisted coding tools were used during development to support programming and code iteration. The visual assets (tanks, ammunition, vehicles) are described as the developer's own work from their channels, Yarnub and Blue Paw Print. The disclosure does not mention AI-generated art, text, audio, or live-generated content.

games.raw: Some game assets are AI-generated.

a.sum: Developer states that some game assets are AI-generated. The disclosure does not specify which assets, whether generation is pre-generated or live, or any other details.

games.raw: We used AI as a “support tool” in the creation of in-store visuals and certain in-game UI elements. We use AI solely as a support tool. We never leave the entire process to AI for any task.

a.sum: The developer declares AI use as a support tool for creating in-store visuals and certain in-game UI elements, and says AI is never used to handle an entire task alone. No live or runtime AI generation is mentioned.

games.raw: AI assistance was used for content during the development of this game.

a.sum: The developer discloses that AI assistance was used for 'content' during development. The specific content types, and whether generation is pre-generated or live, are not stated.

games.raw: AI for music and sound effects and store art. All AI content is pre-generated and shipped in the build. Nothing is generated live.

a.sum: Developer discloses AI use for music, sound effects, and store art. All AI content is pre-generated and shipped in the build; no content is generated live.

games.raw: The soundtrack of PERIHELIA was created with the assistance of generative AI music tools. All tracks were curated, edited and integrated by hand, and each ships with a hand-authored beatmap. All other content — art, code, visual effects — is authored directly and drawn procedurally, with no AI involvement.

a.sum: Soundtrack was created with generative AI music tools, then curated, edited, and integrated by hand, with a hand-authored beatmap per track. The developer states that art, code, and visual effects have no AI involvement and are authored directly or drawn procedurally. No live generation is mentioned.

games.raw: Some artwork in this game, including background images, was made with the help of generative AI tools.

a.sum: The developer discloses that some artwork, including background images, was made with the help of generative AI tools. The text does not say whether the content is pre-generated or generated live during play.

games.raw: Generative AI-assisted tools were used during development to assist with programming tasks and to create or refine selected 3D models. All AI-assisted code and 3D assets were reviewed, edited, tested, and integrated by the development team. AI-assisted tools were also used for selected Steam marketing artwork. The game does not generate content with AI during gameplay and does not connect to an external AI service.

a.sum: AI tools were used during development for programming assistance and to create or refine selected 3D models. AI was also used for selected Steam marketing artwork. All AI-assisted code and assets were reviewed, edited, tested, and integrated by the team. The game does not generate content with AI during gameplay and does not connect to an external AI service.

games.raw: Some in-game images, such as backgrounds and props, were created with generative AI (Adobe Firefly) and then edited and adjusted before use. All character illustrations and key art are hand-drawn. The background music consists of original tracks by our composer and royalty-free music; no AI-generated music is used. The scenario and in-game text are based on human-created concepts and structure; AI was used to assist with early drafts, and all final content was edited and finalized by hand. AI tools were also used to assist programming during development.

a.sum: AI (Adobe Firefly) generated some in-game backgrounds and props, later edited by hand. AI helped with early drafts of the scenario and in-game text, which were finalized by hand. AI assisted programming. Character illustrations, key art, and music are not AI-generated. No live generation is mentioned.

games.raw: Some artwork in this game—including character cards, chapter/key art, and certain battle VFX—was created with generative AI tools and then selected, cropped, and edited by the developer for the final game. AI is not used to generate content live during gameplay, and it is not used for player chat or user-generated content.

a.sum: Some artwork, including character cards, chapter/key art, and certain battle VFX, was created with generative AI, then selected, cropped, and edited by the developer. No live in-game generation, and no AI for player chat or user-generated content.

games.raw: To improve the game's visual quality and overall player experience, generative AI was used in the creation of some art assets.

a.sum: The developer discloses that generative AI was used to create some unspecified art assets, to improve visual quality and player experience. The text does not say whether generation was pre-generated or live, or which specific asset types were affected.

games.raw: All art in the base game is hand-made pixel art, drawn by the developer. An optional HD skins add-on was created with the help of AI tools. AI was also used to aid in translations into 11 languages. This game was coded by a human, and all gameplay, design, and core creative direction are fully handcrafted.

a.sum: AI tools were used to create the optional HD skins add-on and to aid translations into 11 languages. Base-game art is hand-made pixel art, and code, gameplay, design, and core creative direction are human-made. No live-generated content is mentioned.

games.raw: The store artwork (capsules and key art) was generated with an image model and then composed, cropped and combined with our own logo by hand. The game's ambient background music tracks were generated with an AI music tool and edited afterwards.

a.sum: The developer declares AI-generated store artwork (capsules and key art), image-model output that was then composed, cropped, and combined with their own logo by hand. They also declare AI-generated ambient background music tracks, edited afterward. Both are pre-generated assets; no live generation is mentioned.

games.raw: Some visual assets and 3D assets used in this game were created with the assistance of generative AI; the generated assets were edited and adjusted by the developer before being incorporated into the game. The background music was generated with the assistance of generative AI. No content is generated by AI in real time during gameplay.

a.sum: Generative AI assisted some visual and 3D assets, which the developer edited before inclusion, and background music. The developer states no content is generated by AI in real time during gameplay.

games.raw: AI generation was used in the concept art for the game that is currently on display with the game screenshots. We are currently working on making the real art for the game, but wanted to provide the artstyle that we are aiming towards. The game itself, including in-game current and future art, is human made.

a.sum: AI generation was used for concept art displayed alongside the game's store screenshots, as a style reference. The developer states the game itself, including current and future in-game art, is human made. No live-generated content is declared.

games.raw: Generative AI was used during development to assist with the creation of some visual and promotional assets, including artwork used on the Steam store page and marketing materials. All AI-assisted content was reviewed and curated by the developer. No generative AI is used during gameplay.

a.sum: Developer used generative AI during development to help create some visual and promotional assets, specifically Steam store page artwork and marketing materials. All such content was reviewed and curated by the developer. The disclosure states no generative AI is used during gameplay.

games.raw: Necromancer: The Fallen Serve is primarily developed by me as a solo indie developer. I use generative AI as one of the tools in the project, including for some 3D assets, character voice lines, music, and promotional artwork. I've also worked with freelance artists and animators on parts of the game, including the skeleton army and animation work. I personally go through, refine and rework the assets until they fit the game the way I want them to. No generative AI content is created during gameplay.

a.sum: Solo developer declares generative AI use for some 3D assets, character voice lines, music, and promotional artwork, all created before release. The developer refines these assets personally. Freelance artists and animators worked on the skeleton army and animation, which are not described as AI-generated. No generative AI content is created during gameplay.

games.raw: During the development of our game, generative AI tools were used to assist in creating certain 2D underwater background visuals, store page graphics. Additionally, AI-based language models were utilized for writing the store page descriptions and localizing the game into various languages. All AI-generated content was manually reviewed and edited before being implemented into the game or the store page.

a.sum: Generative AI assisted in creating 2D underwater background visuals (in-game art) and store page graphics. Language models wrote store page descriptions and localized the game into various languages. All AI output was manually reviewed and edited before use, implying pre-generated content with no live generation described.

games.raw: Some of this game's assets were created with the assistance of generative AI tools and were then reviewed, edited, and integrated by the developer. This includes: base meshes of some 3D character models, some 2D artwork such as card illustrations and icons, voice lines and sound effects created with AI voice/audio generation, and parts of the localized text. All such content was pre-generated during development — the game does not generate any content with AI at runtime.

a.sum: AI tools were used in pre-generation for some base 3D character meshes, 2D card illustrations and icons, AI-generated voice lines and sound effects, and parts of localized text. All were reviewed and edited by the developer. The developer states no AI content is generated at runtime.

games.raw: Some pre-generated visual assets in the game were created or assisted with generative AI tools, including environment artwork, interface illustrations, textures, and source material used for certain 3D assets. All such material was reviewed, edited, integrated, and tested by the developer. The game does not generate AI content during gameplay or connect to external AI services while running.

a.sum: Some pre-generated visual assets (environment artwork, interface illustrations, textures, and source material for certain 3D assets) were created or assisted with generative AI. The developer reviewed, edited, integrated, and tested all such material. The game does not generate AI content during gameplay or connect to external AI services at runtime.

games.raw: I am a solo developer with ten years of experience, who started out as a 3D artist. Every piece of 3D art in this game was made by me: the models, the UVs, the LODs. All of the game code and architecture was designed and programmed by me. I used AI to assist me with some of the textures and the music. This is a solo project with no funding and I wanted it to follow my vision so I needed any help I could get. If I ever could afford to hire people, that is what I am going to do, so we can deliver even better quality games! [UPDATE] Since many players requested, I replaced the AI music with human-made music. And one nice freelancer volunteered to help with textures. Not sure if we can make it until the release though but will try!

a.sum: Developer declares AI used to assist with some textures and music; all 3D art, code, and architecture are stated as human-made. Update says the AI music was replaced with human-made music and a freelancer volunteered to help with textures, but it does not say whether the AI-assisted textures were replaced. No live or runtime generation is mentioned.

games.raw: For translations within the game and on the Steam Store Page, we used a service based on machine learning. No assets, code or other aspects of development were created using AI or similar techniques.

a.sum: The developer used a machine-learning translation service for in-game text and Steam Store Page text. They state that no assets, code, or other development aspects used AI. The disclosure does not say whether translations are pre-generated or generated live.

games.raw: Generative AI also assisted in creating some promotional artwork and descriptive text for the Steam store page.

a.sum: The developer discloses that generative AI assisted in creating some promotional artwork and descriptive text for the Steam store page. No in-game or live-generated content is mentioned.

games.raw: We used generative AI to create artwork for this store page and for promotional materials. All generated material was reviewed and adjusted by humans before use. No content is generated by AI during gameplay.

a.sum: Generative AI was used to create artwork for the store page and promotional materials. Humans reviewed and adjusted all generated material before use. The disclosure states no content is generated by AI during gameplay.

games.raw: The game does not contain AI-generated content. AI-generated content is used just for Steam Images

a.sum: The developer first states the game contains no AI-generated content, then says AI-generated content is used only for Steam Images (store art). The disclosure is internally contradictory, and the generation method for the Steam Images is not described.

games.raw: Vestibule's pixel art was generated with an AI art tool, with every design directed, refined, and hand-edited by the developer. Individual trailer and cinematic clips were generated with an AI video tool, built from the game's own artwork and developer-written scene descriptions — the final edit, scene sequencing, and music timing were done manually by the developer in After Effects. All game design, systems, writing, and code are original work.

a.sum: AI was used to generate Vestibule's pixel art, which the developer directed, refined, and hand-edited. AI video tool clips were built from the game's artwork and developer-written scene descriptions for trailers and cinematics, then manually edited and sequenced in After Effects. Game design, systems, writing, and code are declared original. No live or runtime generation is mentioned.

games.n: Football with your life on the line

games.raw: Generative AI tools were used during development to assist with some pre-generated 2D visual assets, marketing artwork, and localized text. All AI-assisted content was reviewed and edited by the developer before inclusion. The game does not generate AI content or code during play and does not connect to external AI services.

a.sum: Developer declares generative AI was used during development for some pre-generated 2D visual assets, marketing artwork, and localized text, all reviewed and edited by the developer. The game does not generate AI content or code during play and does not connect to external AI services.

games.raw: Generative AI was used during development to create and refine some 2D visual assets, Steam store artwork, trailer imagery, background music, sound effects, and localization drafts. All output was reviewed and edited by the developer before inclusion. The game does not generate AI content during play and does not connect to external AI services.

a.sum: Generative AI was used during development for some 2D visual assets, Steam store art, trailer imagery, background music, sound effects, and localization drafts, all reviewed and edited by the developer. No AI content is generated during play, and the game does not connect to external AI services. The 2D visual assets are not specified as in-game or otherwise, so they are listed as 'other'.

games.raw: Generative AI was used solely as a support tool for language translation.

a.sum: Developer declares generative AI was used solely as a support tool for language translation. Scope is localization only; the disclosure does not state whether any content is generated live or pre-generated.

games.raw: AI tools were used during development solely to assist with coding, including identifying and fixing bugs and making minor code corrections and improvements. AI does not generate any content for players during gameplay.

a.sum: The developer declares AI use only during development, limited to coding tasks such as finding and fixing bugs and making minor code corrections and improvements. The developer states AI does not generate any content for players during gameplay.

games.n: The Idle Witch and Her Tower of BOOOOM!

games.raw: Some game artwork was created with the assistance of AI-generated concept art or reference images during development. These were used solely as creative references, and all artwork used in the final game was manually redrawn and processed. AI-generated images are not used directly. Some game text and its corresponding localized translations were generated using AI.

a.sum: The developer used AI-generated concept art and reference images during development, not directly in the final game, since all final artwork was manually redrawn. Some in-game text and its localized translations were AI-generated. No runtime or live generation is mentioned.

games.raw: Some background music tracks were created with the assistance of generative AI tools and subsequently edited and modified by the developer. No generative AI content is created during gameplay.

a.sum: Some background music tracks were created with generative AI tools, then edited and modified by the developer. No generative AI content is created during gameplay.

games.raw: Generative AI tools were used during development to assist with the creation and iteration of some pre-generated 2D visual assets, UI elements, and promotional materials. All AI-assisted content is reviewed and curated by the developer. No AI-generated content is created during gameplay.

a.sum: Developer used generative AI during development to help create and iterate on some pre-generated 2D visual assets, UI elements, and promotional materials. The developer reviews and curates all AI-assisted content. The disclosure states no AI-generated content is created during gameplay.

games.n: IT THINKS! - Build Your Own GPU
games.raw: i used some AI made images along with human made art. i may remove them before the full release.

a.sum: Developer says some images in the game are AI-generated, used alongside human-made art. These AI images may be removed before full release. Where the images appear in the game is not specified, and live generation is not mentioned.

games.raw: Some of the game's 2D art — backgrounds, obstacle textures, sticker illustrations and the logo — was created with the help of generative AI tools during development. All of it was reviewed, edited and assembled by the developer. Part of the game's source code was also written with AI assistance. The game itself contains no AI models and generates nothing at runtime: every asset ships as a fixed file.

a.sum: Developer declares generative AI was used during development for some 2D art (backgrounds, obstacle textures, sticker illustrations, and the logo), all reviewed, edited, and assembled by the developer, and for part of the source code. The game includes no AI models and generates no content at runtime; all assets are fixed files shipped with the game.

games.raw: Some of this game's assets — 3D models, textures and art, sound effects and voice, and cinematic video sequences — were created with the assistance of generative AI. All of it is pre-generated: every piece was curated, edited and integrated by hand before shipping. All design, code, writing and gameplay are the developer's own work. Nothing is generated while you play, and the game never connects to any AI service.

a.sum: Generative AI was used for some 3D models, textures, art, sound effects, voice, and cinematic video, all pre-generated and hand-curated before shipping. Design, code, writing, and gameplay are stated as the developer's own work. Nothing is generated during play, and the game does not connect to any AI service.

games.raw: Some 3D models and pictures in the game were created with generative AI tools. Store promotional images were generated with AI and then manually edited.

a.sum: The developer discloses generative AI use for some in-game 3D models and pictures, and for store promotional images that were AI-generated and then manually edited. No live or runtime generation is mentioned.

games.n: We, situated in a parallel world ~ Parallel Hearts ~
games.raw: During development, Google Gemini and OpenAI GPT were primarily used for programming assistance, debugging, and development workflow support. Nano Banana was used to generate some character sprite artwork and to redraw or adjust certain facial-expression variants of existing character sprites. All AI-assisted art assets were manually reviewed, selected, and edited by the developer before being included in the game.

a.sum: Google Gemini and OpenAI GPT were used for programming assistance, debugging, and workflow support. Nano Banana generated some character sprite artwork and redrew or adjusted facial-expression variants of existing sprites. The developer manually reviewed, selected, and edited all AI-assisted art before inclusion. No runtime or live generation is mentioned.

games.raw: This game uses generative AI tools to help create some visual assets (including art produced with SwarmUI / Z-Image Turbo). These assets may appear in the game, Steam store materials, and related community/marketing images. Gameplay systems such as procedural pixel sprites and real-time audio synthesis are rule-based/procedural, not generative AI. An optional Streamer mode can also show simulated “AI audience” chat when Twitch is not connected; this is scripted simulated chat for chaos events, not player-facing AI-generated stories or dialogue as the core game. All generative AI–assisted content is curated and integrated by the developer. No generative AI is required for players to create or upload content.

a.sum: Developer declares generative AI used for some pre-made visual assets (art made with SwarmUI / Z-Image Turbo) in the game, Steam store, and marketing/community images, all curated and integrated by the developer. Procedural pixel sprites, real-time audio synthesis, and scripted simulated Streamer-mode chat are explicitly not generative AI. No live generation; players need no AI tools.

games.raw: Generative AI was used in creating all pre-rendered artwork, including environment backgrounds, menu and branding art, icons, and promotional/title-card images. These assets were reviewed and integrated by the developer. No content is generated during gameplay, and the game does not connect to external AI services.

a.sum: Generative AI was used to create all pre-rendered artwork, including environment backgrounds, menu and branding art, icons, and promotional/title-card images, which the developer reviewed and integrated. No content is generated during gameplay, and the game does not connect to external AI services.

games.raw: The illustrations in this game (Battle Card art, faction emblems, Commander portraits and board imagery) were generated with Midjourney, working from the designer's own concept art and art direction. Each image was then selected, tone-matched to the card stock, fitted and composited into the game's frames. Card names, card text and the written rules were drafted with the assistance of a large language model, working from the designer's original hand-written rules and card designs, then edited and finalized by hand. The music and sound effects were generated with Suno. Voice recordings were performed by the creator. The game itself is a person's work: the rules, the mechanics, the economy and the balance decisions were designed by hand over many revisions, with AI used as a collaborator rather than an author. The physical board game came first. No content is generated by AI while you play. The computer opponents are conventional rule-based code, not a generative model.

a.sum: Pre-generated AI use only: Midjourney illustrations (Battle Card art, faction emblems, Commander portraits, board imagery) from the designer's concept art, selected and composited by hand; LLM-assisted drafting of card names, card text and rules, then hand-edited; Suno-generated music and sound effects. Voices are the creator's own recordings. No content is generated during play, and computer opponents are rule-based code, not generative AI.

games.raw: In the interest of transparency, illustrations were created with the help of AI-assisted tools, used as creative support within a human-led artistic process.

a.sum: The developer discloses that illustrations were made with AI-assisted tools as creative support within a human-led artistic process. The text does not say where the illustrations appear, and it does not mention live or runtime generation.

games.raw: This game’s player-facing art, writing, and audio were created with generative AI and then selected, edited, and directed by the developer. Store images and trailers use the same pre-generated assets. No content is generated live during gameplay.

a.sum: The developer declares that player-facing art, writing, and audio were generative-AI-created, then selected, edited, and directed by the developer. Store images and trailers reuse the same pre-generated assets. No content is generated live during gameplay.

games.raw: Mournhill is made by a solo developer. Some of the game's art is created with the help of generative AI tools and then edited and integrated by the developer. The game's writing, design and direction are the developer's own.

a.sum: Solo developer's Mournhill uses generative AI to help create some game art, which the developer then edits and integrates. Writing, design, and direction are described as the developer's own. No live or runtime generation is mentioned, and the art scope is not specified beyond 'the game's art'.

games.raw: Generative AI tools were used during development to assist in creating some 3D models, vector graphics, and sound effects, as well as to assist with programming and localization.

a.sum: The developer used generative AI during development to help create some 3D models, vector graphics, and sound effects, and to assist with programming and localization. No live or in-game generation is mentioned.

games.raw: AI was used to edit capsule artwork, create some background music tracks and generate market product illustrations.

a.sum: The developer discloses AI use for editing capsule artwork (store_art), creating background music tracks (music), and generating product illustrations for marketing (marketing_art). No live or in-game generated content is mentioned.

games.raw: Generative AI tools were used during development to assist with portions of programming code and to draft portions of the store-page text. All outputs were reviewed and edited by the development team. No AI-generated artwork, audio, or other visual assets are included in the released game or store materials. The game does not use generative AI during gameplay.

a.sum: AI tools were used during development to assist with some programming code and to draft some store-page text, with all outputs reviewed and edited by the team. No AI-generated artwork, audio, or other visual assets are included, and the game does not use generative AI during gameplay.

games.raw: AI was used only for localization and for generating some assets outside the game. The game itself does not use or integrate AI. Any AI use described in the game refers to players using their own external tools.

a.sum: The developer declares AI used for localization and for generating some assets outside the game, all before release. The game does not use or integrate AI at runtime. Mentions of AI in the game refer only to players' own external tools.

games.n: The Coast is Clear: Tidy up the Beach!

games.raw: Generative AI tools were used during development to create selected pre-generated textures, sound effects, and promotional artwork. These materials are used as individual components within the game and its marketing rather than being generated dynamically. AI-assisted materials are selected, edited, adapted, composed, and integrated by the developer to fit the game's original visual and audio direction. The game's design, gameplay systems, implementation, world building, and overall creative direction are developed by the developer. No generative AI is used during gameplay, and the game does not connect to external AI services while running.

a.sum: Developer declares generative AI used during development to create pre-generated textures, sound effects, and promotional artwork, which are edited and integrated as components. No generative AI is used during gameplay, and the game makes no connection to external AI services at runtime.

games.raw: Used for localization and promotional artwork.

a.sum: Developer discloses AI use for localization and promotional artwork. Does not state whether content is pre-generated or live-generated.

games.raw: AI was used as a supporting tool during development and localization. All final in-game artwork was drawn and finished by an artist. At certain stages, the artist used AI to create intermediate images from their own sketches, which they then reworked into the final assets. These intermediate AI outputs were not used directly as finished in-game assets. Some references used for inspiration and style development may also have been AI-generated.

a.sum: AI was used as a supporting tool in development and localization. Final in-game artwork was drawn by an artist. The artist used AI to make intermediate images from their own sketches, then reworked them into final assets, and those intermediate outputs were not used directly. Some AI-generated references may have been used for inspiration and style development. No live or runtime generation is mentioned.

games.raw: Generative AI was used as part of the creation process for some pre-generated promotional artwork and marketing materials for Siege of Akanor. All such content was reviewed, selected and edited by the developer. The game does not use generative AI to create content during gameplay.

a.sum: Generative AI was used to create some pre-generated promotional artwork and marketing materials, all reviewed, selected and edited by the developer. The game does not generate content with AI during gameplay.

games.raw: Translations were made with the help of AI tools and reviewed.

a.sum: The developer states that translations were made with the help of AI tools and then reviewed. Only localization is disclosed; the text does not indicate whether AI output is pre-generated or live.

games.raw: Ai-assisted tools were used during development for programming support. Some visuals and audio were created through developer-directed, deterministic code and exported as fixed assets—not generated by image, video, or audio models. Screenshots and trailers show actual gameplay footage.

a.sum: AI-assisted tools were used during development for programming support only. Visuals and audio were made with developer-directed deterministic code and exported as fixed assets, not generated by AI models. Screenshots and trailers show actual gameplay. No live-generated content is declared.

games.raw: I’m developing this game alongside my job and family life. So yes, I’ve used AI: without these tools, I probably would never have been able to bring a project of this scale to completion. I remain the creative lead, the developer, and the person making all the decisions about the game. I see AI as an employee or assistant that helps me on a daily basis: it allows me to work faster, solve certain problems, and accomplish things that would otherwise have taken much more time. Try the demo and make up your own mind: it’s up to you to decide whether it affects your enjoyment of the game in any way.

a.sum: Developer declares using AI as a daily assistant for development and says they remain creative lead and decision-maker. The text does not specify which content or systems AI generated, and does not mention live or in-game generated content.

games.raw: Some voice audio in EMPTYLAND was created using generative artificial intelligence tools. AI-generated voices are used as part of the game's narrative and in-game audio experience.

a.sum: Some voice audio in EMPTYLAND was created with generative AI tools and is used in the game's narrative and in-game audio. The disclosure does not say whether the voices are pre-generated or generated live during play.

games.raw: The game used generative AI for coding, and the machine translation of the game into languages other than English.

a.sum: The developer declares generative AI was used for coding and for machine translation of the game into non-English languages. The disclosure does not say whether the AI content was pre-generated or generated live during play.

games.raw: Generative AI tools were used during development to assist with portions of the game’s interface and narrative text, programming, procedurally constructed 2D visual elements, and marketing materials. All included content was reviewed, edited, and integrated by the developer. Tide & Crown does not generate AI content during gameplay and does not connect to external AI services.

a.sum: AI tools were used during development for portions of interface and narrative text, programming, procedurally constructed 2D visuals, and marketing materials, all reviewed and integrated by the developer. No AI content is generated during gameplay and the game does not connect to external AI services.

games.raw: AI-assisted tools were used to help create some splash screen visuals and store page promotional artwork. All assets were reviewed and finalized by the developer before being included in the game and store materials.

a.sum: AI-assisted tools helped create splash screen visuals and store page promotional artwork. The developer reviewed and finalized all assets before inclusion, so the content is pre-generated, not live.

games.raw: This game does not create or modify content during gameplay. A small portion of the assets (approximately 20%) were created using generative AI tools during development, such as text translation, some texture details, and some minor audio. We manually edited and reviewed all of these assets, then finalized them, to ensure their authenticity, quality, and compliance with copyright and safety standards.

a.sum: Developer declares generative AI was used during development, not during gameplay, for about 20% of assets: text translation (localization), some texture details, and some minor audio (category unspecified, so mapped to 'other'). All AI-generated assets were manually edited and reviewed before finalization. The game does not create or modify content during play.

games.raw: Generative AI tools were used during development to assist with game localization and code generation.

a.sum: Developer discloses generative AI used during development for game localization and code generation. No live or in-game generated content is mentioned.

games.raw: This game includes assets created with generative AI during development (official music, song artwork, and drum animations). Nothing is generated while you play, and the game does not connect to an AI service at runtime. Players cannot send prompts to any AI.

a.sum: The developer used generative AI during development for official music, song artwork, and drum animations. Nothing is generated during play, the game does not connect to an AI service at runtime, and players cannot send prompts to any AI.

games.raw: Generative AI formed part of the production workflow for Run Man: Wash the Dish, contributing to code, visual assets, written content, localization, and promotional materials. These contributions were incorporated through developer selection, revision, and integration, with creative direction and final implementation determined by the developer.

a.sum: The developer says generative AI was part of production for Run Man: Wash the Dish, contributing to code, visual assets, written content, localization, and promotional materials. The developer selected, revised, and integrated these outputs, and made the creative and implementation decisions. The disclosure does not mention live or runtime generation.

games.raw: Generative AI assisted with early dialogue and localization drafts and with selected pre-generated 2D artwork including the app icon and store key art. All AI-assisted output was edited and reviewed before inclusion. No content is generated and no AI service is contacted during gameplay.

a.sum: Generative AI assisted with early dialogue and localization drafts and with selected pre-generated 2D artwork, including the app icon and store key art. All AI-assisted output was edited and reviewed. No content is generated during gameplay and no AI service is contacted at runtime.

games.raw: Generative AI tools were used during development to create or assist in the creation of portions of the game's pre-generated 2D artwork, codework, and marketing assets. These artworks are created primarily using a local model, which has been designed and diluted toward the creators own artstyle. • All characters/locations/image assets are first sketched or designed by hand. • No sound effects/music/character voices are currently generated with AI. • Absolutely NO writing/story has, or ever will be, generated with AI.

a.sum: Developer discloses generative AI used during development for pre-generated 2D artwork, code, and marketing assets, primarily via a local model tuned to the creator's own style. Characters, locations, and image assets are first hand-sketched or designed. No AI sound effects, music, or character voices are currently used. No AI-generated writing or story, now or in the future. No live or runtime generation is mentioned.

games.raw: All visual assets, music tracks, and programming code in this game have been created with the assistance of generative AI tools. No AI-generated content is produced in real-time during gameplay; all such elements are pre-generated and finalized in the game build. We are committed to transparency and clearly disclose our use of AI in development to ensure players are fully informed.

a.sum: The developer discloses that all visual assets, music tracks, and programming code were created with generative AI assistance. No AI content is generated in real time during gameplay; all AI-generated elements are pre-generated and finalized in the build. The visual assets are not broken down into specific categories such as store art or textures, so they are classed as 'other'.

games.raw: The English translation and some store page materials (text and logo artwork) were created with the help of generative AI tools, then reviewed and edited by the developer The original Spanish game text was written by the developer. No AI is used while you play.

a.sum: The developer used generative AI before release to help create the English translation and some store page materials (store text and logo artwork), then reviewed and edited them. The original Spanish text was written by the developer. The game uses no AI during play.

games.raw: Some of the game's content was created with the help of generative AI tools and then reviewed and integrated by the developer: several 3D models and their textures, the logo and key art, some of the music and voices, and the English translation of the game's text. All of it is pre-generated: the game does not generate anything with AI while you play.

a.sum: The developer declares generative AI was used for pre-generated content, reviewed and integrated by the developer: some 3D models and their textures, the logo and key art, some music and voices, and the English translation of the game's text. The game generates nothing with AI during play.

games.raw: Translations to all languages except English and Spanish were generated by AI.

a.sum: The developer discloses that translations into all languages except English and Spanish were generated by AI. The disclosure does not say whether this content is pre-generated or generated live.

games.raw: Generative AI tools were used to create selected pre-generated sound effects and store/marketing artwork. All generated content was reviewed, edited, and integrated by the developer. The game does not use generative AI to generate content during gameplay.

a.sum: Developer declares generative AI was used to create selected pre-generated sound effects and store/marketing artwork, all reviewed and edited by the developer. The game does not generate content during gameplay.

games.raw: Part of the game were created with the help of generative AI tools, then reviewed, edited and assembled by the developer: • visual art — the ambient background images and the animated background loop • audio — background music and sound effects Generative AI is used only during development to produce these assets. The game does NOT use any AI at runtime — there is no live AI generation while you play. Puzzles and word lists are hand-curated, and level layouts are produced by our own deterministic algorithm (not AI).

a.sum: Developer used generative AI during development to create ambient background images, an animated background loop, background music, and sound effects, which were then reviewed, edited, and assembled by the developer. No runtime/live AI generation; puzzles, word lists, and level layouts are hand-curated or produced by a deterministic non-AI algorithm.

games.raw: AI was used to optimize core logic and resource management, and to create some assets. The developer also uses AI in various areas, including SFX, VFX, gameplay mechanics, UI, and UX, to improve the game's overall quality.

a.sum: The developer declares AI use for optimizing core logic and resource management (code), creating some assets (type unspecified), and across SFX, VFX, gameplay mechanics, UI, and UX. No live or in-game generation is mentioned.

games.raw: Generative AI was used only to help translate the game's text strings into other languages and to create the capsule artwork for the Steam store page.

a.sum: The developer states generative AI was used only to translate the game's text strings into other languages (localization) and to create the Steam store page capsule artwork (store_art). The disclosure does not say whether any content is generated live in the game.

games.raw: The 3D model are made by AI

a.sum: The developer discloses that the game's 3D models were made by AI. The disclosure does not say whether the models were pre-generated or generated live during play.

games.raw: Ai used to create the Steam page art and all the cards art in the game.

a.sum: The developer states AI was used to create the Steam page art and the card art in the game. The disclosure does not say whether the content is pre-generated or generated live.

games.raw: Pre-generated AI-assisted content: portions of the game's 2D art, music, sound effects, NPC voice lines, and promotional artwork were created with AI generation tools during development, then reviewed and finalized by the developer. No AI content is generated at runtime.

a.sum: Developer discloses AI-assisted pre-generated content: portions of 2D art, music, sound effects, NPC voice lines, and promotional artwork were created with AI tools during development and then reviewed and finalized by the developer. No AI content is generated at runtime.

games.raw: AI was used for code, art, and text translation.

a.sum: Developer declares AI use for code, art (type unspecified), and text translation (localization). Whether generation is pre-generated or live is not stated.

games.raw: As a solo developer, I used generative AI to help create the game’s 440 different jar labels and localization content. Every label was individually reviewed by me and edited where necessary.

a.sum: The developer used generative AI to help create 440 jar labels and related localization content before release. Each label was individually reviewed and edited by the solo developer. No live or runtime generation is mentioned.

games.n: Data.exe - An Automation Game About Feeding An AI

games.raw: AI assistance for store page images and localization data configuration.

a.sum: The developer discloses AI assistance for store page images and for localization data configuration. The text does not say whether the content is pre-generated or generated live in the game.

games.raw: AI was used to optimize core logic and resource management, and to create some assets. The developer also uses AI in various areas, including SFX, VFX, gameplay mechanics, UI, and UX, to improve the game's overall quality.

a.sum: Developer declares AI use for optimizing core logic and resource management (code), creating some unspecified assets, and in SFX, VFX, gameplay mechanics, UI, and UX. The disclosure does not say whether content is pre-generated or generated live during play.

Sound effects and fonts come from CC0 / open-licensed sources.

games.raw: A small language model (Google's Gemma 3 270M) runs entirely on the player's computer, with no network connection. It writes short lines of villager small talk, the ritual oracle's one- or two-sentence hint after a failed ritual, and routine filler records in the in-game archive, and it chooses which of our pre-written dialogue lines fits the moment. Guardrails: the player never types to the model — there is no text input anywhere in the game. Every prompt is a fixed template we wrote, filled in from game state such as a character's name, the time of day and the current quest. Output is short by construction (hard token caps, and lines over a few words are cut or discarded); lines that read as narration, stage directions or an assistant speaking are rejected; dialogue choices are constrained to our own authored lines. Any failure falls back to written lines. Players can turn the model off in Settings, and the game plays identically on written lines alone.

a.sum: Disclosure describes a small on-device language model (Gemma 3 270M) that runs offline at runtime. It generates short villager small talk, a ritual oracle hint after failed rituals, and routine archive filler records, and selects from developer-written dialogue lines. Prompts are fixed templates filled from game state, with no player text input. Output is length-capped and filtered, falls back to written lines on failure, and can be turned off in Settings.

a.sum: Developer discloses that generative AI was used to create some of the music in Breakremental. The AI-generated music is described as temporary, with plans to replace it with original music when possible. No live or in-game runtime generation is mentioned.

games.raw: Some monster and equipment assets, as well as images used on the Steam store page, were AI-generated and subsequently refined and edited manually.

a.sum: The developer discloses that some monster and equipment assets and Steam store page images were AI-generated, then refined and edited manually. No live or runtime generation is mentioned.

games.raw: Pre-generated content: the character voices, some sound effects, ambience and the music were generated with AI audio tools (ElevenLabs), then selected, edited and mixed by the developer. Most 3D models (props, tools, vehicles) and some 2D artwork (signs, posters, in-game documents, interface illustrations and store art) were generated with AI tools and then integrated, adjusted and reviewed in the game by the developer. The people are built with the open-source MakeHuman tools and animated with motion capture (CMU), not with AI. Translations were made with AI assistance and reviewed. The levels and code were built with AI-assisted tools and reviewed and tested by the developer. No content is generated by AI while you play.

a.sum: Developer declares AI use only for pre-generated content: character voices, sound effects, ambience and music (ElevenLabs, then edited and mixed); 3D props, tools and vehicles; 2D artwork (signs, posters, documents, interface illustrations, store art); translations; and AI-assisted level and code building, all reviewed by the developer. Characters use MakeHuman and CMU motion capture, not AI. No content is generated during play.
